+"""Disposable Ed25519 fixtures for the POSIX-only S2 dispatch trust boundary."""
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import base64
+import datetime as dt
+import os
+from pathlib import Path
+import shutil
+import subprocess
+import tempfile
+from typing import Any, Iterator
+
+import pytest
+
+from tools.vst.contracts import canonical_bytes
+from tools.vst.dispatch_instruction import (
+    DISPATCH_INSTRUCTION_DOMAIN,
+    DISPATCH_INSTRUCTION_PURPOSE,
+    dispatch_instruction_signing_bytes,
+)
+from tools.vst.execution_grant import _openssl_signature
+
+
+class DispatchInstructionKeyPair:
+    """Temporary synthetic-only issuer key; never use it as runtime evidence."""
+
+    def __init__(self, directory: tempfile.TemporaryDirectory[str], openssl_path: str):
+        self._directory = directory
+        self.root = Path(directory.name)
+        self.openssl_path = openssl_path
+        self.private_key_path = [REDACTED] / "synthetic-instruction-private.pem")
+        self.public_key_path = str(self.root / "synthetic-instruction-public.pem")
+        self.key_id = "synthetic-instruction-key"
+        self.principal = "Codex"
+        self.purpose = DISPATCH_INSTRUCTION_PURPOSE
+        self._signed_by_request: dict[str, dict[tuple[Any, ...], dict[str, Any]]] = {}
+        self._expiry_by_request: dict[str, str] = {}
+        self.trust_registry = {
+            self.key_id: {
+                "principal": self.principal,
+                "purpose": self.purpose,
+                "public_key_path": self.public_key_path,
+            },
+        }
+
+    def close(self) -> None:
+        self._directory.cleanup()
+
+    def sign(self, dispatch_fields: dict[str, Any], **overrides: Any) -> dict[str, Any]:
+        request_id = dispatch_fields["request_id"]
+        cache_key = tuple(dispatch_fields[field] for field in (
+            "request_id", "task_id", "slot", "attempt", "epoch", "run_id",
+        )) + tuple(sorted(overrides.items()))
+        cached = self._signed_by_request.get(request_id, {}).get(cache_key)
+        if cached is not None:
+            return dict(cached)
+        now = dt.datetime.now(dt.timezone.utc)
+        body = {
+            "version": 1,
+            "algorithm": "Ed25519",
+            "purpose": self.purpose,
+            "request_id": dispatch_fields["request_id"],
+            "task_id": dispatch_fields["task_id"],
+            "slot": dispatch_fields["slot"],
+            "attempt": dispatch_fields["attempt"],
+            "epoch": dispatch_fields["epoch"],
+            "run_id": dispatch_fields["run_id"],
+            "key_id": self.key_id,
+            "expires_at": self._expiry_by_request.setdefault(
+                request_id,
+                (now + dt.timedelta(minutes=15)).strftime("%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ"),
+            ),
+        }
+        body.update(overrides)
+        candidate = {**body, "signature": base64.urlsafe_b64encode(bytes(64)).decode("ascii").rstrip("=")}
+        payload = dispatch_instruction_signing_bytes(candidate)
+        result = self._sign_payload(body, payload)
+        self._signed_by_request.setdefault(request_id, {})[cache_key] = dict(result)
+        return result
+
+    def sign_arbitrary_envelope(self, body: dict[str, Any]) -> dict[str, Any]:
+        """Sign an intentionally malformed-schema envelope for negative tests."""
+        return self._sign_payload(body, DISPATCH_INSTRUCTION_DOMAIN + canonical_bytes(body))
+
+    def _sign_payload(self, body: dict[str, Any], payload: bytes) -> dict[str, Any]:
+        signature = _openssl_signature(
+            self.openssl_path, key_path=self.private_key_path,
+            payload=payload, private=True,
+        )
+        assert isinstance(signature, bytes)
+        return {
+            **body,
+            "signature": base64.urlsafe_b64encode(signature).decode("ascii").rstrip("="),
+        }
+
+
+@pytest.fixture
+def dispatch_instruction_keypair() -> Iterator[DispatchInstructionKeyPair]:
+    """Make/delete synthetic keys beneath protected WSL `/root`, not production storage."""
+    if (os.name != "posix" or not hasattr(os, "geteuid") or os.geteuid() != 0):
+        pytest.skip("S2 Ed25519 trust-boundary tests require the designated root-owned POSIX test environment")
+    openssl_path = shutil.which("openssl")
+    if not openssl_path:
+        pytest.skip("OpenSSL is unavailable for the synthetic Ed25519 fixture")
+    root = Path("/root")
+    try:
+        info = root.stat()
+    except OSError:
+        pytest.skip("protected temporary root is unavailable")
+    if info.st_uid != 0 or info.st_mode & 0o022:
+        pytest.skip("/root is not root-controlled for disposable test keys")
+
+    directory = tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix="vst-s2-dispatch-test-", dir=str(root))
+    try:
+        private_key_path = [REDACTED] / "synthetic-instruction-private.pem"
+        public_key_path = Path(directory.name) / "synthetic-instruction-public.pem"
+        subprocess.run(
+            [openssl_path, "genpkey", "-algorithm", "ED25519", "-out", str(private_key_path)],
+            check=True, cwd="/", stdin=subprocess.DEVNULL,
+            stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.PIPE, timeout=10,
+        )
+        os.chmod(private_key_path, 0o600)
+        subprocess.run(
+            [openssl_path, "pkey", "-in", str(private_key_path), "-pubout", "-out", str(public_key_path)],
+            check=True, cwd="/", stdin=subprocess.DEVNULL,
+            stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.PIPE, timeout=10,
+        )
+        os.chmod(public_key_path, 0o644)
+        yield DispatchInstructionKeyPair(directory, openssl_path)
+    except (OSError, subprocess.SubprocessError) as exc:
+        directory.cleanup()
+        pytest.skip(f"synthetic Ed25519 test key setup is unavailable: {type(exc).__name__}")
+    finally:
+        directory.cleanup()

+function git(cwd, ...args) {
+  const result = spawnSync("git", ["-C", cwd, ...args], { encoding: "utf8", windowsHide: true });
+  assert.equal(result.status, 0, `git ${args.join(" ")} failed: ${result.stderr}`);
+  return result.stdout.trim();
+}

+function makeRepo(t) {
+  const cwd = fs.mkdtempSync(path.join(os.tmpdir(), "vst-af-attachment-test-"));
+  t.after(() => fs.rmSync(cwd, { recursive: true, force: true }));
+  fs.mkdirSync(path.join(cwd, "docs", "sdlc"), { recursive: true });
+  git(cwd, "init", "--quiet");
+  git(cwd, "config", "user.name", "Functional Test Fixture");
+  git(cwd, "config", "user.email", "fixture@example.invalid");
+  fs.writeFileSync(path.join(cwd, "fixture.txt"), "base\n", "utf8");
+  git(cwd, "add", "fixture.txt");
+  git(cwd, "commit", "--quiet", "-m", "fixture base");
+  const baseSha = git(cwd, "rev-parse", "HEAD");
+  fs.writeFileSync(path.join(cwd, "fixture.txt"), "changed\n", "utf8");
+  git(cwd, "add", "fixture.txt");
+  git(cwd, "commit", "--quiet", "-m", "fixture change");
+  const headSha = git(cwd, "rev-parse", "HEAD");
+  return { cwd, baseSha, headSha };
+}

+function promptFor({ baseSha, headSha, body = "+synthetic review fixture\n" }) {
+  return Buffer.from(
+    `# PM-GPT code review request\n` +
+      `Reviewed range: ${baseSha}...${headSha}\n` +
+      `Exact HEAD under review: ${headSha}\n` +
+      `Reply format: first line VERDICT.\n\n` +
+      `Diff:\n\`\`\`diff\n${body}\n\`\`\`\n\n---\n\nsynthetic authority footer\n`,
+    "utf8",
+  );
+}

+function verdictParser(reply) {
+  const matches = [...String(reply ?? "").matchAll(/^\s*[#*>\- ]*VERDICT\s*:\s*(.*)$/gim)];
+  const line = matches[0]?.[1]?.trim() ?? null;
+  const severity = /^(APPROVE|MINOR|MAJOR|BLOCKER)\b/i.exec(line ?? "")?.[1]?.toUpperCase() ?? "UNRECOGNIZED";
+  return { found: matches.length > 0, line, verdictCount: matches.length, severity, contradiction: false };
+}

+function makeHarness({ repo, prompt, capability = true, jobMutation = (job) => job, failAfterSend = false, mutateAttachmentAfterSend = false } = {}) {
+  const calls = [];
+  let job = null;
+  let sendCount = 0;
+  let observedIntent = null;
+  const bridge = {
+    async resolveIdentityAssertedBinding() {
+      return { identityBinding: { projectId: PROJECT_ID, conversationId: CONVERSATION_ID } };
+    },
+    async isOrchestratorActive() {
+      return { capabilities: capability ? ["file-attachments"] : [] };
+    },
+    daemonRouting(project, options) {
+      return { project, repoPath: options.repoPath };
+    },
+    assertCanonicalDescriptor(descriptor) {
+      assert.equal(descriptor.requestId, job.requestId);
+      assert.ok(Array.isArray(descriptor.steps));
+      assert.ok(descriptor.steps.every((step) => step.kind !== "rotation-title"));
+      return descriptor;
+    },
+    applyWireTransforms(logicalText, descriptor) {
+      return `PROJECT: ${PROJECT_ID} | REPO: ${repo.cwd}\nREQUEST_ID: ${descriptor.requestId}\n${logicalText}`;
+    },
+    parseVerdict: verdictParser,
+    decideReviewFinal({ requestedFinal, reviewStatus, parsedVerdict, truncated, correlated }) {
+      const final = requestedFinal && reviewStatus === "RAN" && !truncated && correlated &&
+        ["APPROVE", "MINOR"].includes(parsedVerdict.severity);
+      return { final, finalOverridden: requestedFinal && !final };
+    },
+    async callOrchestrator(_active, endpoint, body, timeout) {
+      calls.push({ endpoint, body, timeout });
+      if (endpoint === "/job_status") {
+        if (job) return { ok: true, job };
+        throw Object.assign(new Error("fixture job not found"), { code: "JOB_NOT_FOUND" });
+      }
+      if (endpoint !== "/send_and_await") throw new Error(`unexpected endpoint: ${endpoint}`);
+      sendCount += 1;
+      const filePath = body.attachments?.[0];
+      assert.ok(filePath, "adapter must submit the full prompt as an attachment");
+      const bytes = fs.readFileSync(filePath);
+      const intentPath = path.join(repo.cwd, "docs", "sdlc", ".pm-review", `intent-${body.reviewInputHash}.json`);
+      observedIntent = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(intentPath, "utf8"));
+      assert.equal(observedIntent.phase, "sending", "durable intent must be fsynced before the send boundary");
+      assert.equal(observedIntent.requestId, body.requestId);
+      assert.equal(observedIntent.inputHash, body.reviewInputHash);
+      assert.equal(observedIntent.size, bytes.length);
+      assert.equal(observedIntent.instruction, body.text);
+      if (failAfterSend) throw Object.assign(new Error("simulated ambiguous transport response"), { code: "ECONNRESET" });
+      const wireDescriptor = {
+        requestId: body.requestId,
+        steps: [{ kind: "project-header" }, { kind: "request-envelope" }],
+      };
+      const wireText = bridge.applyWireTransforms(body.text, wireDescriptor);
+      const inputHash = body.reviewInputHash;
+      const headSha = repo.headSha;
+      const reply = [
+        "VERDICT: APPROVE",
+        `REVIEW_INPUT_SHA256:${inputHash}`,
+        `REVIEW_HEAD:${headSha}`,
+        `REVIEW_REQUEST_ID:${body.requestId}`,
+      ].join("\n");
+      job = {
+        jobId: "job-fixture-01",
+        idempotencyKey: `${body.requestId}:send-and-await`,
+        operation: "send-and-await",
+        projectId: PROJECT_ID,
+        conversationId: CONVERSATION_ID,
+        requestId: body.requestId,
+        status: "succeeded",
+        sendPhase: "sent",
+        userTurnId: "turn-fixture-01",
+        replyId: "reply-fixture-01",
+        correlated: true,
+        result: { reply, replyId: "reply-fixture-01", correlated: true },
+        sendSnapshot: {
+          text: wireText,
+          logicalText: body.text,
+          attachments: [{ name: path.basename(filePath), path: filePath, size: bytes.length, sha256: sha256(bytes) }],
+          conversationId: CONVERSATION_ID,
+          baseline: {
+            userTurnId: "turn-fixture-01",
+            wireEvidence: {
+              wireProtocolVersion: 2,
+              wireRequestId: body.requestId,
+              wireDescriptor,
+              wireHash: sha256(Buffer.from(wireText, "utf8")),
+            },
+          },
+        },
+      };
+      job = jobMutation(job);
+      if (mutateAttachmentAfterSend) {
+        bytes[0] ^= 1;
+        fs.writeFileSync(filePath, bytes);
+      }
+      return { ok: true, job };
+    },
+  };
+  const adapterOptions = {
+    bridgeLoader: async () => bridge,
+    nativeDump(_args, dumpPath) {
+      if (typeof prompt === "function") prompt = prompt();
+      fs.writeFileSync(dumpPath, prompt);
+      return { diagnostic: true };
+    },
+  };
+  return { bridge, calls, adapterOptions, get sendCount() { return sendCount; }, get job() { return job; }, get observedIntent() { return observedIntent; } };
+}
+
+function adapterArgs(repo) {
+  return ["--cwd", repo.cwd, "--base", repo.baseSha, "--project", PROJECT_ID, "--final"];
+}
+
+function withDebugDumpDisabled(fn) {
+  const previous = process.env.PM_BRIDGE_DEBUG_DUMP_PROMPT_ONLY;
+  delete process.env.PM_BRIDGE_DEBUG_DUMP_PROMPT_ONLY;
+  return Promise.resolve().then(fn).finally(() => {
+    if (previous === undefined) delete process.env.PM_BRIDGE_DEBUG_DUMP_PROMPT_ONLY;
+    else process.env.PM_BRIDGE_DEBUG_DUMP_PROMPT_ONLY = previous;
+  });
+}

+  });

+test("AFAT-06/08/09: durable job identity, correlation, attachment manifest, and acknowledgments are mandatory", async (t) => {

+def test_posix_worker_timeout_kills_descendant_across_uid_boundary():
+    """VST-013 / E4.1: the runner must clean up worker descendants across UIDs."""
+    if os.name != "posix":
+        pytest.skip("POSIX process-group acceptance runs only inside the provisioned sandbox distro")
+
+    import pwd
+    try:
+        runner_account = pwd.getpwnam("vst-runner")
+        worker_account = pwd.getpwnam("vst-worker")
+    except KeyError as exc:
+        pytest.skip(f"provisioned S2 runner/worker account is unavailable: {exc}")
+    if os.geteuid() != runner_account.pw_uid:
+        pytest.skip("must run as the provisioned vst-runner identity")
+    try:
+        with open("/proc/self/status", encoding="ascii") as status_file:
+            cap_eff_line = next(line for line in status_file if line.startswith("CapEff:"))
+    except (OSError, StopIteration) as exc:
+        pytest.skip(f"runner effective capabilities are unavailable: {exc}")
+    cap_eff = int(cap_eff_line.split(":", 1)[1].strip(), 16)
+    required_caps = (1 << 6) | (1 << 7)  # CAP_SETGID and CAP_SETUID for Popen identity switch
+    if cap_eff & required_caps != required_caps:
+        pytest.skip("runner lacks the provisioned CAP_SETGID/CAP_SETUID profile")
+    if not os.path.isfile("/usr/bin/setpriv"):
+        pytest.skip("the approved fixed-path /usr/bin/setpriv helper is unavailable")
+
+    # Use a unique child of the sandbox's private tmpfs; the runner-created
+    # directory is shared only so the switched worker can write its marker.
+    if not os.path.isdir("/tmp") or os.stat("/tmp").st_mode & 0o1777 != 0o1777:
+        pytest.skip("sandbox /tmp is not the expected private, sticky temporary filesystem")
+    work = tempfile.mkdtemp(prefix="vst-s2-posix-cleanup-", dir="/tmp")
+    os.chmod(work, 0o777)
+    beat = os.path.join(work, "descendant-beat.txt")
+    grandchild = (
+        "import time\n"
+        "deadline = time.monotonic() + 6\n"
+        "while time.monotonic() < deadline:\n"
+        f"    with open({beat!r}, 'a', encoding='ascii') as stream: stream.write('x')\n"
+        "    time.sleep(0.1)\n"
+    )
+    parent = (
+        "import os, subprocess, sys, time\n"
+        f"subprocess.Popen([sys.executable, '-c', {grandchild!r}],"
+        " stdin=subprocess.DEVNULL, stdout=subprocess.DEVNULL, stderr=subprocess.DEVNULL)\n"
+        f"deadline = time.monotonic() + 2\nwhile not os.path.exists({beat!r}) and time.monotonic() < deadline:\n"
+        "    time.sleep(0.02)\n"
+        "print('WORKER_UID', os.geteuid(), flush=True)\n"
+        "time.sleep(3.2)\n"
+    )
+
+    try:
+        code, stdout, info = runner._run_one(
+            pycmd(parent),
+            work,
+            3,
+            {"PATH": "/usr/bin:/bin", "PYTHONIOENCODING": "utf-8"},
+            4096,
+            worker_uid=worker_account.pw_uid,
+            worker_gid=worker_account.pw_gid,
+        )
+
+        assert f"WORKER_UID {worker_account.pw_uid}" in stdout
+        assert info["timed_out"] is True
+        assert info["capture_incomplete"] is False, f"runner did not confirm cleanup: {info!r}"
+        assert code == runner.EXIT_TIMEOUT
+        assert os.path.exists(beat), "worker descendant never started; test proves nothing"
+        final_size = os.path.getsize(beat)
+        deadline = time.monotonic() + 0.8
+        while time.monotonic() < deadline:
+            assert os.path.getsize(beat) == final_size, (
+                "worker descendant survived POSIX process-group timeout cleanup"
+            )
+            time.sleep(0.05)
+    finally:
+        shutil.rmtree(work, ignore_errors=True)
+

+):
+    """Exercise runner-to-receipt propagation with mocked Win32 APIs and no real kill."""
+    calls = []
+
+    def failed_api(*args):
+        calls.append(api_name)
+        if failure == "raises":
+            raise RuntimeError(f"{api_name} failed")
+        return False
+
+    class Kernel32:
+        TerminateJobObject = staticmethod(lambda *args: True)
+        CloseHandle = staticmethod(lambda *args: True)
+
+    setattr(Kernel32, api_name, staticmethod(failed_api))
+    api = type("Api", (), {"k32": Kernel32()})
+    fake_job = runner._JobObject(api, 321)
+    monkeypatch.setattr(runner._JobObject, "attach", classmethod(lambda cls, proc: fake_job))
+    monkeypatch.setattr(runner, "_spawn_kwargs", lambda **kwargs: {})
+    fallback = []
+    monkeypatch.setattr(runner, "_kill_tree", lambda proc: fallback.append(proc.pid))
+    monkeypatch.setattr(runner.os, "name", "nt")
+
+    report = {}
+    r = run(work, report=report, test_result_parser=ALL_IDS)
+
+    assert r["commands"][0]["exit_code"] == runner.EXIT_CAPTURE_INCOMPLETE == -4
+    assert report["capture_incomplete"] is True
+    assert report["commands"][0]["capture_incomplete"] is True
+    assert r["result"] == "FAIL" and signing.verify(r, KEY)
+    assert calls.count(api_name) == (1 if api_name == "TerminateJobObject" else 2)
+    assert len(fallback) >= 1
+    assert len(set(fallback)) == 1

+"""Synthetic Store contract tests for the S2 read-only assignment-basis candidate.
+
+These fixtures model an operation journal row that a future authenticated writer
+would persist. They are not evidence of a production writer, key, peer, or policy.

+def _policy(manifest: dict) -> dict:
+    now = int(time.time())
+    return {
+        "schema": POLICY_SCHEMA,
+        "policy_id": "synthetic-policy-1",
+        "repository": "Virtual_scrum_team",
+        "sprint_id": "39b7cc253f5d",
+        "source_head": "a" * 40,
+        "manifest_sha256": "b" * 64,
+        "owner_principal": "Codex",
+        "allowed_assignments": [{
+            "story_id": manifest["story_id"],
+            "task_id": manifest["task_id"],
+            "project_id": manifest["project_id"],
+            "phase": manifest["phase"],
+            "task_manifest_sha256": contracts.manifest_sha256(manifest),
+            "test_run_slots": ["tests"],
+        }],
+        "bootstrap_peer": {
+            "role": "assignment_bootstrap", "uid": 980, "gid": 982,
+            "cgroup": "/system.slice/vst-assignment-bootstrap.service",
+        },
+        "issuer_peer": {
+            "role": "delegated_issuer", "uid": 981, "gid": 983,
+            "cgroup": "/system.slice/vst-delegated-issuer.service",
+        },
+        "allowed_bootstrap_operations": ["open_story", "register_task", "acquire_epoch", "acquire_lease"],
+        "maximum_handoff_ttl_seconds": 300,
+        "runner_id": "runner-1",
+        "owner_ttl_seconds": 1800,
+        "lease_ttl_seconds": 1200,
+        "valid_from_utc": datetime.fromtimestamp(now - 60, timezone.utc).strftime("%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ"),
+        "expires_at_utc": datetime.fromtimestamp(now + 3600, timezone.utc).strftime("%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ"),
+        "revocation_id": "synthetic-revocation-1",
+    }

+def _readiness(manifest: dict, *, store_mutation: str | None = None,
+               journal_mutation: str | None = None, runner_id: str = "runner-1",
+               supervisor_run_id: str | None = RUN_ID,
+               handoff_generation: str = GENERATION):
+    """Create disposable live Store state and a synthetic completed handoff row."""
+    now = time.time()
+    manifest = copy.deepcopy(manifest)
+    manifest["task_id"] = "T-assignment-basis"
+    manifest["story_id"] = "story-assignment-basis"
+    manifest["required_receipts"] = [
+        {"slot": "tests", "receipt_type": "TestRun"},
+        {"slot": "review", "receipt_type": "IndependentReview"},
+    ]
+    # Rebuild derived manifest lists after replacing the receipt set.
+    manifest = base_manifest(
+        task_id=manifest["task_id"], story_id=manifest["story_id"],
+        required_receipts=manifest["required_receipts"],
+    )
+    policy = _policy(manifest)
+    policy_copy, policy_sha256 = validate_policy(policy)
+    store = Store(":memory:", clock=lambda: now, event_key=EVENT_KEY)
+    store.init_slots(1)
+    store.open_story(manifest["story_id"], manifest["project_id"], manifest["phase"])
+    epoch = store.acquire_epoch(manifest["story_id"], "Codex", ttl_sec=1800)
+    store.register_task(manifest)
+    store.acquire_lease(
+        manifest["task_id"], manifest["story_id"], runner_id, epoch, 1, 1200,
+        supervisor_key=SUPERVISOR_KEY,
+    )
+    store.ensure_preflight_consumed(RUN_ID, "synthetic-nonce-1", "d" * 64, PROBE_SHA256)
+
+    request = {
+        "schema": REQUEST_SCHEMA,
+        "request_id": "0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef",
+        "story_id": manifest["story_id"],
+        "task_id": manifest["task_id"],
+        "task_manifest": manifest,
+        "slot": "tests",
+        "attempt": 1,
+        "run_id": RUN_ID,
+    }
+    operation_id = assignment_operation_id(request, policy_sha256=policy_sha256)
+    lease_id = int(store._conn.execute(
+        "SELECT lease_id FROM leases WHERE task_id = ? AND attempt = 1", (manifest["task_id"],),
+    ).fetchone()[0])
+    issued = datetime.fromtimestamp(now, timezone.utc).replace(microsecond=0)
+    handoff = {
+        "schema": OPERATION,
+        "assignment_operation_id": operation_id,
+        "policy_id": policy_copy["policy_id"],
+        "policy_sha256": policy_sha256,
+        "repository": policy_copy["repository"],
+        "sprint_id": policy_copy["sprint_id"],
+        "source_head": policy_copy["source_head"],
+        "manifest_sha256": policy_copy["manifest_sha256"],
+        "bootstrap_peer": copy.deepcopy(policy_copy["bootstrap_peer"]),
+        "assignment_principal": "Codex",
+        "bootstrap_request": copy.deepcopy(request),
+        "task_id": manifest["task_id"],
+        "story_id": manifest["story_id"],
+        "project_id": manifest["project_id"],
+        "phase": manifest["phase"],
+        "task_manifest_sha256": contracts.manifest_sha256(manifest),
+        "slot": "tests",
+        "attempt": 1,
+        "epoch": epoch,
+        "lease_id": lease_id,
+        "runner_id": runner_id,
+        "run_id": RUN_ID,
+        "service_generation": handoff_generation,
+        "probe_sha256": PROBE_SHA256,
+        "issued_at_utc": issued.strftime("%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ"),
+        "expires_at_utc": datetime.fromtimestamp(now + 120, timezone.utc).replace(
+            microsecond=0,
+        ).strftime("%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ"),
+    }
+    if store_mutation == "stale_epoch":
+        handoff["epoch"] += 1
+    elif store_mutation == "stale_lease":
+        handoff["lease_id"] += 1
+    elif store_mutation == "missing_probe":
+        handoff["run_id"] = "absent-probe-run"
+        handoff["bootstrap_request"]["run_id"] = handoff["run_id"]
+        request = copy.deepcopy(handoff["bootstrap_request"])
+        handoff["assignment_operation_id"] = assignment_operation_id(
+            handoff["bootstrap_request"], policy_sha256=policy_sha256,
+        )
+        operation_id = handoff["assignment_operation_id"]
+    elif store_mutation == "wrong_runner":
+        handoff["runner_id"] = "runner-other"
+    if journal_mutation == "wrong_task_manifest_digest":
+        handoff["task_manifest_sha256"] = "f" * 64
+    elif journal_mutation == "wrong_policy_digest":
+        handoff["policy_sha256"] = "f" * 64
+    elif journal_mutation == "wrong_assignment_principal":
+        handoff["assignment_principal"] = "caller-selected"
+    elif journal_mutation == "changed_bootstrap_manifest":
+        handoff["bootstrap_request"]["task_manifest"]["scope"] = ["other.py"]
+    elif journal_mutation == "unknown_handoff_field":
+        handoff["unreviewed"] = "must not be stripped"
+    body = {key: value for key, value in handoff.items() if key != "handoff_sha256"}
+    handoff["handoff_sha256"] = hashlib.sha256(contracts.canonical_bytes(body)).hexdigest()
+    payload = {
+        "request": copy.deepcopy(handoff["bootstrap_request"]),
+        "bootstrap_peer": policy_copy["bootstrap_peer"],
+        "policy_sha256": policy_sha256,
+    }
+    if journal_mutation == "wrong_payload":
+        payload["request"] = {**request, "request_id": "f" * 32}
+
+    # This is only a synthetic future-writer journal fixture, not an authenticated
+    # production assignment or proof that a production writer currently exists.
+    if journal_mutation in {"wrong_actor", "duplicate_event"}:
+        result_text = contracts.canonical_bytes(handoff).decode("utf-8")
+        payload_sha = hashlib.sha256(contracts.canonical_bytes(payload)).hexdigest()
+        with store._tx() as conn:
+            conn.execute(
+                "INSERT INTO supervisor_operations(operation_key, operation, payload_sha256, result) "
+                "VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?)",
+                (operation_id, OPERATION, payload_sha, result_text),
+            )
+            event_actor = "unauthenticated" if journal_mutation == "wrong_actor" else "supervisor"
+            event = {
+                "event": "SUPERVISOR_OPERATION", "operation": OPERATION,
+                "payload_sha256": payload_sha,
+                "result_sha256": hashlib.sha256(result_text.encode("utf-8")).hexdigest(),
+            }
+            store._record_event_locked(conn, operation_id, event_actor, "NOTE", event)
+            if journal_mutation == "duplicate_event":
+                store._record_event_locked(conn, operation_id, "supervisor", "NOTE", event)
+    else:
+        store.execute_idempotent(operation_id, OPERATION, payload, lambda _conn: handoff)
+    supervisor = Supervisor(
+        store, operation_backend=object(), assignment_policy=policy_copy, run_id=supervisor_run_id,
+        assignment_policy_provider=lambda: policy_copy,
+    )
+    # Assignment-basis needs the active generation, whereas execution-grant
+    # signer configuration is intentionally absent from this source-only fixture.
+    supervisor.service_generation_provider = lambda: GENERATION
+    return store, supervisor, policy_copy, policy_sha256, operation_id, handoff
+

+def _snapshot(store: Store) -> tuple:
+    with store._read_tx() as conn:
+        tables = [row[0] for row in conn.execute(
+            "SELECT name FROM sqlite_master WHERE type = 'table' AND name NOT LIKE 'sqlite_%' ORDER BY name",
+        )]
+        return tuple(
+            (table, tuple(tuple(row) for row in conn.execute(f'SELECT * FROM "{table}"')))
+            for table in tables
+        )
+

+def test_assignment_basis_reads_verified_handoff_and_live_basis_without_store_mutation(monkeypatch):
+    manifest = base_manifest()
+    store, supervisor, _policy_obj, _policy_sha, operation_id, handoff = _readiness(manifest)

+    def observe_locked(conn, *args, **kwargs):
+        assert conn.in_transaction
+        observed_connections.append(conn)

+            "repository": "Virtual_scrum_team", "sprint_id": "39b7cc253f5d",

+            "task_id": handoff["task_id"], "story_id": handoff["story_id"],
+            "task_manifest_sha256": handoff["task_manifest_sha256"], "slot": "tests",
+            "attempt": 1, "epoch": handoff["epoch"], "lease_id": handoff["lease_id"],
+            "runner_id": "runner-1", "principal": "Codex", "run_id": RUN_ID,
+            "probe_sha256": PROBE_SHA256,
+            "authority_expires_at_utc": handoff["expires_at_utc"],
+            "service_generation": GENERATION,
+        }
+        assert len(observed_connections) == 1
+        assert _snapshot(store) == before
+    finally:
+        store.close()

+GENERATION = "bootstrap-generation-1"

+def _fresh_fixture(*, cost_cap: int = 0, anchor_path: str | None = None,
+                   store_path: str = ":memory:"):
+    manifest = base_manifest(task_id="T-bootstrap-fresh", story_id="S2-bootstrap-fresh",
+                             cost_cap=cost_cap, retry_cap=1)
+    policy = {
+        "schema": POLICY_SCHEMA, "policy_id": "policy-bootstrap-1",
+        "repository": "Virtual_scrum_team", "sprint_id": "39b7cc253f5d",
+        "source_head": "a" * 40, "manifest_sha256": "b" * 64,
+        "owner_principal": "Codex",
+        "allowed_assignments": [{
+            "story_id": manifest["story_id"], "task_id": manifest["task_id"],
+            "project_id": manifest["project_id"], "phase": manifest["phase"],
+            "task_manifest_sha256": contracts.manifest_sha256(manifest),
+            "test_run_slots": ["tests"],
+        }],
+        "bootstrap_peer": {"role": "assignment_bootstrap", "uid": 980, "gid": 982,
+                           "cgroup": "/system.slice/vst-assignment-bootstrap.service"},
+        "issuer_peer": {"role": "delegated_issuer", "uid": 981, "gid": 983,
+                         "cgroup": "/system.slice/vst-delegated-issuer.service"},
+        "allowed_bootstrap_operations": ["open_story", "register_task", "acquire_epoch", "acquire_lease"],
+        "maximum_handoff_ttl_seconds": 300,
+        "valid_from_utc": "2026-10-29T11:00:00Z", "expires_at_utc": "2026-10-29T13:00:00Z",
+        "revocation_id": "bootstrap-revocation-1", "runner_id": "runner-bootstrap-1",
+        "owner_ttl_seconds": 1800, "lease_ttl_seconds": 1200,
+    }
+    normalized_policy, policy_sha = validate_policy(policy)
+    store = Store(store_path, clock=lambda: NOW, event_key=EVENT_KEY, anchor_path=anchor_path)
+    store.init_slots(1)
+    store.ensure_preflight_consumed(RUN, "bootstrap-nonce", "d" * 64, "c" * 64)
+    request = {
+        "schema": "VST_S2_ASSIGNMENT_BOOTSTRAP_REQUEST_V1",
+        "request_id": "0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef",
+        "story_id": manifest["story_id"], "task_id": manifest["task_id"],
+        "task_manifest": manifest, "slot": "tests", "attempt": 1, "run_id": RUN,
+    }
+    peer = normalized_policy["bootstrap_peer"]
+    providers = {"policy_provider": lambda: normalized_policy,
+                 "generation_provider": lambda: GENERATION}
+    def invoke(req=request):
+        return store.bootstrap_assignment(
+            req, policy=normalized_policy, policy_sha256=policy_sha,
+            bootstrap_peer=peer, expected_run_id=RUN,
+            active_service_generation=GENERATION, **providers,
+        )
+    return store, manifest, normalized_policy, request, invoke
+
+
+def _snapshot(store: Store) -> tuple:
+    with store._read_tx() as conn:
+        tables = [row[0] for row in conn.execute(
+            "SELECT name FROM sqlite_master WHERE type='table' AND name NOT LIKE 'sqlite_%' ORDER BY name"
+        )]
+        return tuple((table, tuple(tuple(row) for row in conn.execute(f'SELECT * FROM "{table}"')))
+                     for table in tables)
+

+def test_fresh_bootstrap_commits_one_complete_epoch_two_zero_budget_handoff():
+    store, manifest, _policy, request, invoke = _fresh_fixture(cost_cap=0)
+    try:
+        handoff = invoke()
+        assert handoff["task_id"] == request["task_id"]
+        assert handoff["attempt"] == 1 and handoff["epoch"] == 2
+        assert handoff["service_generation"] == GENERATION
+        with store._read_tx() as conn:
+            story = conn.execute("SELECT epoch, owner FROM stories WHERE story_id=?",
+                                 (manifest["story_id"],)).fetchone()
+            task = conn.execute("SELECT task_id FROM tasks WHERE task_id=?",
+                                (manifest["task_id"],)).fetchone()
+            budget = conn.execute("SELECT cap, spent FROM budget WHERE task_id=?",
+                                  (manifest["task_id"],)).fetchone()
+            lease = conn.execute("SELECT attempt, epoch, status FROM leases WHERE task_id=?",
+                                 (manifest["task_id"],)).fetchone()
+            handoffs = conn.execute("SELECT COUNT(*) FROM supervisor_operations WHERE operation=?",
+                                    ("VST_S2_AUTHENTICATED_ASSIGNMENT_V1",)).fetchone()[0]
+            linked = conn.execute("SELECT COUNT(*) FROM events WHERE task_id=? AND actor='supervisor' AND kind='NOTE'",
+                                  (handoff["assignment_operation_id"],)).fetchone()[0]
+        assert tuple(story) == (2, "Codex")
+        assert task["task_id"] == manifest["task_id"]
+        assert tuple(budget) == (0, 0)
+        assert tuple(lease) == (1, 2, "LIVE")
+        assert handoffs == linked == 1
+    finally:
+        store.close()

+def test_exact_bootstrap_replay_returns_same_bytes_and_conflicting_payload_has_no_effect():

+def test_precommit_exception_rolls_back_every_assignment_row_event_and_anchor(monkeypatch, tmp_path):
+    anchor = str(tmp_path / "anchor.json")
+    database = str(tmp_path / "store.sqlite3")

+    original = store._acquire_initial_assignment_lease_locked
+    def fail_after_story_task_epoch_and_budget(*args, **kwargs):
+        raise RuntimeError("injected ordinary precommit failure")

+                        fail_after_story_task_epoch_and_budget)

+        with pytest.raises(RuntimeError, match="injected ordinary precommit failure"):
+            invoke()

+@pytest.mark.parametrize("history", [
+    "story", "task", "event", "budget", "lease", "receipt", "terminal", "handoff",
+])
+def test_bootstrap_rejects_prior_assignment_history_without_adopting_it(history: str):
+    store, manifest, _policy, _request, invoke = _fresh_fixture()
+    try:
+        if history == "story":
+            store.open_story(manifest["story_id"], manifest["project_id"], manifest["phase"])
+        elif history == "task":
+            store.open_story(manifest["story_id"], manifest["project_id"], manifest["phase"])
+            store.register_task(manifest)
+        elif history == "event":
+            with store._tx() as conn:
+                store._record_event_locked(conn, manifest["task_id"], "Codex", "NOTE", {"prior": True})
+        elif history == "budget":
+            store.open_story(manifest["story_id"], manifest["project_id"], manifest["phase"])
+            store.register_task(manifest)
+        elif history == "lease":
+            store.open_story(manifest["story_id"], manifest["project_id"], manifest["phase"])
+            epoch = store.acquire_epoch(manifest["story_id"], "Codex", ttl_sec=1800)
+            store.register_task(manifest)
+            store.acquire_lease(manifest["task_id"], manifest["story_id"], "runner-bootstrap-1",
+                                epoch, 1, 1200, supervisor_key=SUPERVISOR_KEY)
+        elif history in {"receipt", "terminal"}:
+            store.open_story(manifest["story_id"], manifest["project_id"], manifest["phase"])
+            epoch = store.acquire_epoch(manifest["story_id"], "Codex", ttl_sec=1800)
+            store.register_task(manifest)
+            if history == "receipt":
+                store.acquire_lease(manifest["task_id"], manifest["story_id"], "runner-bootstrap-1",
+                                    epoch, 1, 1200, supervisor_key=SUPERVISOR_KEY)
+                receipt = bound(
+                    manifest, key=KEY, task_id=manifest["task_id"],
+                    epoch=epoch, attempt=1, runner_id="runner-bootstrap-1",
+                    slot="tests", receipt_type="TestRun",
+                )
+                store.append_receipt(receipt, manifest["story_id"], KEY)
+            else:
+                marker = supervisor_receipt(
+                    "RETRY_EXHAUSTED", task_id=manifest["task_id"],
+                    manifest_sha256=contracts.manifest_sha256(manifest),
+                    role_sha256=manifest["role_sha256"], epoch=epoch,
+                )
+                store.append_supervisor_receipt(marker, manifest["story_id"],
+                                                supervisor_key=SUPERVISOR_KEY)
+        elif history == "handoff":
+            prior = invoke()
+            changed = copy.deepcopy(_request)
+            changed["request_id"] = "f" * 32
+            before = _snapshot(store)
+            with pytest.raises(StoreError):
+                invoke(changed)
+            assert prior["task_id"] == manifest["task_id"]
+            assert _snapshot(store) == before
+            return
+        before = _snapshot(store)
+        with pytest.raises(StoreError):
+            invoke()
+        assert _snapshot(store) == before
+    finally:
+        store.close()
+

+"""Focused S2 inactive bootstrap selector behavior in disposable POSIX fixtures.
+
+These tests never invoke the production CLI or use /etc, /opt, /run, the real Store,
+or systemd. They skip on Windows because the production contract depends on POSIX links,
+UID/GID/modes, fcntl, and root-owned fixture artifacts.
+"""
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import contextlib
+import hashlib
+import json
+import os
+import stat
+from pathlib import Path
+from types import SimpleNamespace
+
+import pytest

+from tools.vst import bootstrap_runtime as runtime
+from tools.vst import runtime_bundle as bundle
+from tools.vst.contracts import ContractError
+
+pytestmark = pytest.mark.skipif(os.name != "posix", reason="POSIX filesystem identity contract")
+
+HEAD_OLD = "1" * 40
+HEAD_NEW = "2" * 40
+HELPER_HEAD = "3" * 40
+ARCHIVE_SHA = "4" * 64
+SPEC_SHA = "5" * 64
+HELPER_SOURCE_SHA = "6" * 64
+UNITS = bundle.UNITS

+def _write(path: Path, data: bytes, mode: int = 0o644) -> None:
+    path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
+    path.write_bytes(data)
+    path.chmod(mode)
+
+
+def _make_tree(path: Path, head: str, archive: str, *, unit_tag: bytes) -> None:
+    path.mkdir(parents=True)
+    (path / "tools/vst/systemd").mkdir(parents=True)
+    (path / "docs").mkdir()
+    for unit in UNITS:
+        _write(path / "tools/vst/systemd" / unit, unit_tag + unit.encode())
+    _write(path / "docs/SANDBOX_SPEC.md", b"spec fixture")
+    marker = {"archive_sha256": archive, "head": head, "schema": 1}
+    _write(path / ".vst-runtime-manifest.json", json.dumps(marker, sort_keys=True, separators=(",", ":")).encode())
+    for directory in sorted((p for p in path.rglob("*") if p.is_dir()), reverse=True):
+        directory.chmod(0o755)
+    path.chmod(0o755)
+
+
+class _PathMap:
+    """Map only the selector's fixed /opt namespace into a disposable fixture."""
+    def __init__(self, root: Path):
+        self.root = str(root)
+
+    def _map(self, value):
+        if isinstance(value, str) and (value == "/opt" or value.startswith("/opt/")):
+            return self.root + value
+        return value
+
+    def __getattr__(self, name):
+        import posixpath
+        attr = getattr(posixpath, name)
+        if name in {"exists", "lexists", "isdir", "isfile", "islink", "getsize"}:
+            return lambda path, *args, **kwargs: attr(self._map(path), *args, **kwargs)
+        return attr
+
+
+class _OSMap:
+    def __init__(self, root: Path):
+        self._root = str(root)
+        self.path = _PathMap(root)
+
+    def _map(self, value):
+        if isinstance(value, str) and (value == "/opt" or value.startswith("/opt/")):
+            return self._root + value
+        return value
+
+    def __getattr__(self, name):
+        attr = getattr(os, name)
+        if name in {"lstat", "stat", "open", "readlink", "listdir", "scandir",
+                    "chmod", "chown", "mkdir", "remove", "unlink", "rmdir"}:
+            return lambda path, *args, **kwargs: attr(self._map(path), *args, **kwargs)
+        if name in {"replace", "rename", "symlink", "link"}:
+            if name == "symlink":
+                return lambda target, link_name, *args, **kwargs: attr(
+                    target, self._map(link_name), *args, **kwargs)
+            return lambda src, dst, *args, **kwargs: attr(self._map(src), self._map(dst), *args, **kwargs)
+        if name == "walk":
+            def walk(path, *args, **kwargs):
+                physical = self._map(path)
+                prefix = self._root
+                for current, dirs, files in attr(physical, *args, **kwargs):
+                    logical = ("/opt" + current[len(prefix) + len("/opt"):]
+                               if current.startswith(prefix + "/opt") else current)
+                    yield logical, dirs, files
+            return walk
+        return attr
+
+
+@pytest.fixture
+def host(tmp_path: Path, monkeypatch: pytest.MonkeyPatch):
+    if os.geteuid() != 0:
+        pytest.skip("fixture requires root to model root-owned runtime artifacts")
+    root = tmp_path / "host"
+    opt = root / "opt"
+    units_dir = root / "etc/systemd/system"
+    helper_dir = root / "usr/local/libexec"

+        directory.mkdir(parents=True)
+        directory.chmod(0o755)

+    new_path = opt / ("vst-runtime-" + HEAD_NEW)
+    _make_tree(old_path, HEAD_OLD, "7" * 64, unit_tag=b"old:")
+    _make_tree(new_path, HEAD_NEW, ARCHIVE_SHA, unit_tag=b"new:")
+    selector = opt / "vst-runtime"
+    # Preserve the real fixed target spelling while the path adapter redirects /opt.
+    selector.symlink_to("/opt/" + old_path.name)

+    for unit in UNITS:
+        _write(units_dir / unit, b"old:" + unit.encode())

+    helper = helper_dir / ("vst-s4-worker-exec-" + HELPER_HEAD)
+    _write(helper, b"synthetic helper bytes", 0o4750)
+    os.chown(helper, 0, 988)
+    helper.chmod(0o4750)
+
+    parents = {str(opt): (0, 0, 0o755), str(units_dir): (0, 0, 0o755),
+               str(helper_dir): (0, 0, 0o755)}
+    monkeypatch.setattr(bundle, "PARENTS", parents)
+    monkeypatch.setattr(bundle, "UNIT_DIR", str(units_dir))
+    monkeypatch.setattr(bundle, "RUNTIME_LINK", str(selector))
+    monkeypatch.setattr(bundle, "HELPER_BASE", str(helper_dir))
+    monkeypatch.setattr(runtime, "PARENTS", parents)
+    monkeypatch.setattr(runtime, "UNIT_DIR", str(units_dir))
+    monkeypatch.setattr(runtime, "RUNTIME_LINK", str(selector))
+    monkeypatch.setattr(runtime, "HELPER_BASE", str(helper_dir))
+    # Production paths remain fixed; module-local filesystem adapters redirect only /opt
+    # into this disposable fixture so apply/recover execute their real logic safely.
+    monkeypatch.setattr(bundle, "os", _OSMap(root))
+    monkeypatch.setattr(runtime, "os", _OSMap(root))
+    original_bundle_fingerprint = bundle._fingerprint
+    def mapped_fingerprint(path: str, *, absent: bool = False):
+        if path == "/opt" or path.startswith("/opt/"):
+            path = str(root) + path
+        return original_bundle_fingerprint(path, absent=absent)
+    monkeypatch.setattr(bundle, "_fingerprint", mapped_fingerprint)

+                        lambda _path: json.loads((new_path / ".vst-runtime-manifest.json").read_bytes()))
+    journal = root / "var/lib/vst-bootstrap-transitions"
+    journal.parent.mkdir(parents=True)

+    monkeypatch.setattr(runtime, "_require_root", lambda: None)
+    monkeypatch.setattr(runtime, "_require_fixed_parents", lambda: None)
+    monkeypatch.setattr(runtime, "_require_unconfigured_and_inactive", lambda: None)
+    monkeypatch.setattr(runtime, "_sync_dir", lambda _path: None)
+
+    helper_fp = bundle._fingerprint(str(helper))
+    assert (helper_fp["kind"], helper_fp["uid"], helper_fp["gid"], helper_fp["mode"],
+            helper_fp["nlink"]) == ("file", 0, 988, 0o4750, 1)
+    manifest = bundle.build_manifest(source_head=HEAD_NEW, archive_sha256=ARCHIVE_SHA,
+                                     spec_sha256=hashlib.sha256(b"spec fixture").hexdigest(),
+                                     helper_head=HELPER_HEAD, helper_source_sha256=HELPER_SOURCE_SHA)
+    return SimpleNamespace(root=root, selector=selector, old=old_path, new=new_path,

+def test_apply_selects_exact_staged_tree_without_starting_services(host, capsys):

+def test_recovery_restores_old_selector_and_units_and_retains_new_files(host):
+    runtime.apply(host.manifest, host.digest)
+    txid = host.digest[:32]
+    runtime.recover(txid, host.digest)
+    assert os.readlink(host.selector) == "/opt/vst-runtime-" + HEAD_OLD
+    for unit in UNITS:
+        assert (host.units / unit).read_bytes() == b"old:" + unit.encode()
+    retained = host.units / ".vst-bootstrap-retained"
+    for unit in UNITS:
+        copies = list(retained.glob(unit + "-new-" + host.digest[:16] + "-*"))
+        assert len(copies) == 1
+        assert copies[0].read_bytes() == (host.new / "tools/vst/systemd" / unit).read_bytes()
+    assert host.new.exists()

+def test_recovery_preflights_whole_set_before_any_restore(host):
+    runtime.apply(host.manifest, host.digest)
+    damaged = host.units / UNITS[-1]
+    damaged.write_bytes(b"third-party bytes")
+    with pytest.raises(ContractError, match="unknown state"):
+        runtime.recover(host.digest[:32], host.digest)
+    # Selector and earlier paths stay on the selected revision: no partial rollback occurred.
+    assert os.readlink(host.selector) == "/opt/vst-runtime-" + HEAD_NEW
+    assert all((host.units / unit).read_bytes() == (host.new / "tools/vst/systemd" / unit).read_bytes()
+               for unit in UNITS[:-1])
+    assert damaged.read_bytes() == b"third-party bytes"

+def test_interrupted_apply_is_recovered_from_actual_fingerprints(host, monkeypatch):
+    original = runtime._atomic_file
+    calls = 0
+
+    def fail_once(path: str, data: bytes) -> None:
+        nonlocal calls
+        calls += 1
+        if calls == 1:
+            raise OSError("injected ordinary exception before unit rename")
+        original(path, data)
+
+    monkeypatch.setattr(runtime, "_atomic_file", fail_once)
+    with pytest.raises(OSError, match="injected"):
+        runtime.apply(host.manifest, host.digest)
+    assert os.readlink(host.selector) == "/opt/vst-runtime-" + HEAD_NEW
+    monkeypatch.setattr(runtime, "_atomic_file", original)
+    runtime.recover(host.digest[:32], host.digest)
+    assert os.readlink(host.selector) == "/opt/vst-runtime-" + HEAD_OLD
+    assert all((host.units / unit).read_bytes() == b"old:" + unit.encode() for unit in UNITS)
+
+
+def test_partial_journal_state_write_does_not_strand_next_apply(host, monkeypatch):
+    original_write = runtime.os.write
+    injected = False
+
+    def partial_state_write(fd: int, data: bytes) -> int:
+        nonlocal injected
+        opened_path = os.readlink(f"/proc/self/fd/{fd}")
+        if not injected and "/.state-" in opened_path:
+            injected = True
+            original_write(fd, data[:max(1, len(data) // 2)])
+            raise OSError("injected ordinary exception during journal state write")
+        return original_write(fd, data)
+
+    monkeypatch.setattr(runtime.os, "write", partial_state_write)
+    with pytest.raises(OSError, match="during journal state write"):
+        runtime.apply(host.manifest, host.digest)
+    assert injected
+
+    monkeypatch.setattr(runtime.os, "write", original_write)
+    runtime.apply(host.manifest, host.digest)
+    state = json.loads((host.journal / host.digest[:32] / "state.json").read_bytes())
+    assert state["status"] == "complete"
+    assert os.readlink(host.selector) == "/opt/vst-runtime-" + HEAD_NEW
+
+
+def test_partial_retained_copy_does_not_strand_recovery(host, monkeypatch):
+    runtime.apply(host.manifest, host.digest)
+    original_write = runtime.os.write
+    injected = False
+
+    def partial_retained_write(fd: int, data: bytes) -> int:
+        nonlocal injected
+        opened_path = os.readlink(f"/proc/self/fd/{fd}")
+        if not injected and "/.vst-bootstrap-retained/" in opened_path:
+            injected = True
+            original_write(fd, data[:max(1, len(data) // 2)])
+            raise OSError("injected ordinary exception during retained copy")
+        return original_write(fd, data)
+
+    monkeypatch.setattr(runtime.os, "write", partial_retained_write)
+    with pytest.raises(OSError, match="during retained copy"):
+        runtime.recover(host.digest[:32], host.digest)
+    assert injected
+
+    monkeypatch.setattr(runtime.os, "write", original_write)
+    runtime.recover(host.digest[:32], host.digest)
+    assert os.readlink(host.selector) == "/opt/vst-runtime-" + HEAD_OLD
+    retained = host.units / ".vst-bootstrap-retained"
+    for unit in UNITS:
+        assert (host.units / unit).read_bytes() == b"old:" + unit.encode()
+        copies = list(retained.glob(unit + "-new-" + host.digest[:16] + "-*"))
+        expected = (host.new / "tools/vst/systemd" / unit).read_bytes()
+        if unit == UNITS[0]:
+            # The injected partial artifact is retained; retry uses a fresh exclusive name.
+            assert len(copies) == 2
+            assert any(copy.read_bytes() == expected[:max(1, len(expected) // 2)] for copy in copies)
+        else:
+            assert len(copies) == 1
+        assert any(copy.read_bytes() == expected for copy in copies)
+
+
+def test_runtime_manifest_rejects_unknown_fields_and_wrong_old_tree(host):
+    extra = dict(host.manifest, surprise=True)
+    with pytest.raises(ContractError, match="fields"):
+        bundle.validate_manifest(extra)
+    stale = dict(host.manifest)
+    stale["old_runtime_tree_sha256"] = "0" * 64
+    assert bundle.validate_manifest(stale) == stale
+    with pytest.raises(ContractError, match="previous immutable runtime"):
+        runtime._current_old_state(stale)

+def _valid_v2_receipt(receipt_type):
+    item = unsigned_receipt(receipt_type, contract_version=2)
+    if receipt_type == "IndependentReview":
+        item["reviewer_key_id"] = "reviewer-x-key"
+    elif receipt_type == "TestRun":
+        parser_id, parser_version, parser_sha = next(iter(TRUSTED_PARSER_CATALOG))
+        parsed = {"executed_test_ids": ["t1", "t2"], "skipped_test_ids": [], "xfail_test_ids": []}
+        parser_results = [{"argv": ["pytest", "-q"], "parser_id": parser_id,
+                          "parser_version": parser_version, "parser_sha256": parser_sha,
+                          "parser_result": parsed}]
+        diff = {"manifest_sha256": contracts.manifest_sha256(_v2_manifest()),
+                "candidate_head": HEAD, "diff_sha256": "e" * 64, "changed_paths": [],
+                "verdict": "PASS", "reason": "PASS", "signature": "f" * 64}
+        request = {"request_id": "req-1", "task_id": "T1", "slot": "tests", "attempt": 1,
+                   "epoch": EPOCH, "manifest_sha256": diff["manifest_sha256"],
+                   "candidate_head": HEAD, "commands": [{"argv": ["pytest", "-q"], "exit_code": 0}],
+                   "parser_results": parser_results, "artifact_digests": {}}
+        item.update({"parser_results": parser_results, "diff_gate": diff,
+                     "runner_attestation": {"request": request, "signature": "a" * 64}})
+    unsigned = {k: v for k, v in item.items() if k != "signature"}
+    item["signature"] = signing.sign(unsigned, KEY, signing.RECEIPT_V2_LABEL)

+@pytest.mark.parametrize("corruption", [
+    "missing", "wrong_manifest", "wrong_head", "fail_verdict", "bad_signature",
+])
+def test_gate_rejects_missing_stale_or_inconsistent_diff_gate_evidence(corruption):
+    m, registry, reviewer_key, keys = _authority_fixture()
+    receipt = _authority_receipt("TestRun", "tests", keys["signer"], m)
+
+    if corruption == "missing":
+        receipt.pop("diff_gate")
+    else:
+        diff = dict(receipt["diff_gate"])
+        diff.pop("signature")
+        if corruption == "wrong_manifest":
+            diff["manifest_sha256"] = "f" * 64
+        elif corruption == "wrong_head":
+            diff["candidate_head"] = "b" * 40
+        elif corruption == "fail_verdict":
+            diff["verdict"] = "FAIL"
+            diff["reason"] = "OUT_OF_SCOPE_PATH"
+        elif corruption == "bad_signature":
+            diff["changed_paths"] = ["src/changed.py"]
+        if corruption == "bad_signature":
+            diff["signature"] = "0" * 64
+        else:
+            diff["signature"] = signing.sign(diff, keys["signer"], signing.DIFF_GATE_LABEL)
+        receipt["diff_gate"] = diff
+
+    decision = gate.evaluate(
+        m, [receipt], HEAD, EPOCH, KEY,
+        supervisor_key=SUPERVISOR_KEY, operator_key=OPERATOR_KEY,
+        reviewer_registry=registry, reviewer_keys={"reviewer-key-1": reviewer_key},
+        signer_key=SIGNER_KEY, event_key=keys["event"],
+    )
+    assert decision["verdict"] != "APPROVE"
+    expected_reason = (
+        "missing field(s): diff_gate" if corruption == "missing"
+        else "diff gate evidence is absent, stale, failing, or unsigned"
+    )
+    assert any(expected_reason in reason for reason in decision["reasons"]), decision["reasons"]

+"""S2 E6: deterministic diff gate rejects unsafe worker changes."""
+
+import hashlib
+import subprocess
+
+import pytest
+
+from tools.vst import diffgate, runner, signing
+from tools.vst.contracts import ContractError, TRUSTED_PARSER_CATALOG
+from tests.vst.e1e4_helpers import manifest as base_manifest
+
+
+MANIFEST = "a" * 64
+BASE = "b" * 40
+HEAD = "c" * 40
+RUNNER_KEY = b"s2-diff-evidence-runner-key-0123456789"
+
+
+def check(paths, *, allowed=("src/app.py",), renames=(), symlinks=()):
+    return diffgate.check_diff(
+        manifest_sha256=MANIFEST, base_head=BASE, candidate_head=HEAD,
+        changed_paths=paths, allowed_paths=allowed, diff_bytes=b"stable diff",
+        rename_pairs=renames, symlink_paths=symlinks,
+    )
+
+
+def _init_git_candidate(path, *, ignored_patterns=()):
+    path.mkdir()
+
+    def git(*args):
+        return subprocess.run(
+            ["git", "-C", str(path), *args], check=True,
+            stdin=subprocess.DEVNULL, stdout=subprocess.PIPE,
+            stderr=subprocess.PIPE, text=True,
+        ).stdout.strip()
+
+    git("init")
+    git("config", "user.name", "Synthetic DiffGate")
+    git("config", "user.email", "diffgate@example.invalid")
+    if ignored_patterns:
+        (path / ".gitignore").write_text(
+            "".join(f"{pattern}\n" for pattern in ignored_patterns), encoding="utf-8",
+        )
+    (path / "tracked.txt").write_bytes(b"committed baseline\n")
+    git("add", "--", "tracked.txt", *([".gitignore"] if ignored_patterns else []))
+    git("commit", "-m", "synthetic baseline")
+    return git("rev-parse", "--verify", "HEAD")
+
+
+def _v2_diff_manifest(base_head, allowed_paths):
+    parser_id, parser_version, parser_sha256 = next(iter(TRUSTED_PARSER_CATALOG))
+    manifest = base_manifest()
+    manifest.update({
+        "base_head": base_head,
+        "contract_version": 2,
+        "reviewer_registry": {"version": "registry-1", "sha256": "d" * 64},
+        "mandatory_commands": [{
+            "slot": "tests", "argv": ["pytest", "-q"],
+            "parser_id": parser_id, "parser_version": parser_version,
+            "parser_sha256": parser_sha256,
+        }],
+        "change_scope": {"allowed_paths": list(allowed_paths)},
+    })
+    return manifest
+
+
+def _signed_runner_diff(repo, base_head, allowed_paths):
+    diff_bytes, changed_paths, rename_pairs, symlink_paths = runner._diff_paths(
+        str(repo), base_head,
+    )
+    manifest = _v2_diff_manifest(base_head, allowed_paths)
+    evidence = diffgate.git_diff_evidence(
+        str(repo), manifest, runner._derive_head(str(repo)), diff_bytes, changed_paths,
+        symlink_paths=symlink_paths, rename_pairs=rename_pairs,
+    )
+    signed = diffgate.sign_diff_evidence(evidence, RUNNER_KEY)
+    assert signing.verify(signed, RUNNER_KEY, diffgate.DIFF_GATE_LABEL)
+    assert signed["diff_sha256"] == hashlib.sha256(diff_bytes).hexdigest()
+    return diff_bytes, signed
+
+
+def test_runner_untracked_out_of_scope_file_is_in_signed_fail_evidence(tmp_path):
+    base_head = _init_git_candidate(tmp_path / "candidate")
+    outside = "docs/outside.md"
+    (tmp_path / "candidate" / outside).parent.mkdir()
+    (tmp_path / "candidate" / outside).write_bytes(b"out of scope\n")
+
+    _diff_bytes, signed = _signed_runner_diff(
+        tmp_path / "candidate", base_head, ["src/app.py"],
+    )
+
+    assert signed["verdict"] == "FAIL"
+    assert signed["reason"] == "OUT_OF_SCOPE_PATH"
+    assert signed["changed_paths"] == [outside]
+
+
+def test_runner_untracked_blocked_file_is_in_signed_fail_evidence(tmp_path):
+    base_head = _init_git_candidate(tmp_path / "candidate")
+    blocked = "install.ps1"
+    (tmp_path / "candidate" / blocked).write_bytes(b"synthetic installer\n")
+
+    _diff_bytes, signed = _signed_runner_diff(
+        tmp_path / "candidate", base_head, ["src/app.py"],
+    )
+
+    assert signed["verdict"] == "FAIL"
+    assert signed["reason"] == "BLOCKED_PATH_CLASS"
+    assert signed["changed_paths"] == [blocked]
+
+
+def test_runner_allowed_untracked_file_content_is_bound_to_signed_digest(tmp_path):
+    base_head = _init_git_candidate(tmp_path / "candidate")
+    path = "src/app.txt"
+    candidate_file = tmp_path / "candidate" / path
+    candidate_file.parent.mkdir()
+    candidate_file.write_bytes(b"first candidate bytes\n")
+
+    first_diff, first_signed = _signed_runner_diff(
+        tmp_path / "candidate", base_head, [path],
+    )
+    assert first_signed["verdict"] == "PASS"
+    assert first_signed["changed_paths"] == [path]
+    assert b"first candidate bytes\n" in first_diff
+
+    candidate_file.write_bytes(b"different candidate bytes\n")
+    second_diff, second_signed = _signed_runner_diff(
+        tmp_path / "candidate", base_head, [path],
+    )
+    assert b"different candidate bytes\n" in second_diff
+    assert first_signed["diff_sha256"] != second_signed["diff_sha256"]
+
+
+def test_runner_includes_ignored_and_ordinary_untracked_files_in_scope_evidence(tmp_path):
+    base_head = _init_git_candidate(tmp_path / "candidate", ignored_patterns=("ignored/",))
+    ignored_path = "ignored/allowed.txt"
+    ordinary_path = "src/ordinary.txt"
+    ignored_file = tmp_path / "candidate" / ignored_path
+    ordinary_file = tmp_path / "candidate" / ordinary_path
+    ignored_file.parent.mkdir()
+    ordinary_file.parent.mkdir()
+    ignored_file.write_bytes(b"ignored bytes\n")

+    intent_event = {"type": "SUPERVISOR_DISPATCH_ISSUANCE_INTENT",

+def test_s2_admission_latch_creation_is_exclusive_durable_root_root_and_0644(monkeypatch):
+    events = []
+    descriptors = iter((31, 32))
+
+    def fake_stat(path, *, follow_symlinks=True):
+        events.append(("stat", path, follow_symlinks))
+        return SimpleNamespace(st_mode=stat.S_IFDIR | 0o755, st_uid=0, st_gid=0)
+
+    def fake_open(path, flags, *args):
+        fd = next(descriptors)
+        events.append(("open", path, flags, args, fd))
+        return fd
+
+    def fake_write(fd, payload):
+        events.append(("write", fd, bytes(payload)))
+        return len(payload)
+
+    monkeypatch.setattr(latch_module.os, "stat", fake_stat)
+    monkeypatch.setattr(latch_module.os, "open", fake_open)
+    monkeypatch.setattr(latch_module.os, "fchown", lambda fd, uid, gid: events.append(("fchown", fd, uid, gid)), raising=False)
+    monkeypatch.setattr(latch_module.os, "fchmod", lambda fd, mode: events.append(("fchmod", fd, mode)))
+    monkeypatch.setattr(latch_module.os, "write", fake_write)
+    monkeypatch.setattr(latch_module.os, "fsync", lambda fd: events.append(("fsync", fd)))
+    monkeypatch.setattr(latch_module.os, "close", lambda fd: events.append(("close", fd)))
+
+    latch_module._write_latch("timeout", "exited", "75")
+
+    latch_open = next(event for event in events if event[0] == "open" and event[1] == latch_module.LATCH_PATH)
+    assert latch_open[2] & os.O_CREAT
+    assert latch_open[2] & os.O_EXCL
+    if hasattr(os, "O_NOFOLLOW"):
+        assert latch_open[2] & os.O_NOFOLLOW
+    assert latch_open[3] == (0o644,)
+    assert ("fchown", latch_open[4], 0, 0) in events
+    assert ("fchmod", latch_open[4], 0o644) in events
+    payload = next(event[2] for event in events if event[0] == "write" and event[1] == latch_open[4])
+    assert json.loads(payload) == {
+        "exit_code": "exited",
+        "exit_status": "75",
+        "service_result": "timeout",
+        "state": "BLOCKED",
+        "unit": "vst-dispatch-owner.service",
+        "version": 1,
+    }
+    fsyncs = [event[1] for event in events if event[0] == "fsync"]
+    assert fsyncs == [latch_open[4], 32]
+    assert ("close", latch_open[4]) in events
+    assert ("close", 32) in events

+"""Acceptance tests for the isolated S2 signed dispatch-owner service contract."""
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import json
+import hashlib
+import os
+import socket
+import struct
+import stat
+from io import StringIO
+
+import pytest
+
+from tools.vst.contracts import ContractError, canonical_bytes
+from tools.vst import dispatch_owner_service as service_module
+
+
+_HEADER = struct.Struct("!I")
+
+
+def _fields() -> dict:
+    return {
+        "request_id": "a" * 32,
+        "task_id": "task-owner-service",
+        "slot": "tests",
+        "attempt": 1,
+        "epoch": 7,
+        "run_id": "run-owner-service",
+    }
+
+
+def _service(keypair, supervisor):
+    config = service_module.DispatchOwnerServiceConfig(
+        principal="Codex", openssl_path=keypair.openssl_path,
+        trust_registry=keypair.trust_registry,
+    )
+    return service_module.DispatchOwnerService(config, supervisor=supervisor)
+
+
+def _exchange(service, raw: bytes, *, half_close: bool = True, include_status: bool = False):
+    """Send one framed request through the actual service socket handler."""
+    server, client = socket.socketpair()
+    try:
+        client.sendall(raw)
+        if half_close:
+            client.shutdown(socket.SHUT_WR)
+        outcome_unknown = service._handle(server)
+        header = client.recv(_HEADER.size)
+        assert len(header) == _HEADER.size
+        size = _HEADER.unpack(header)[0]
+        response = bytearray()
+        while len(response) < size:
+            chunk = client.recv(size - len(response))
+            assert chunk
+            response.extend(chunk)
+        decoded = json.loads(response)
+        return (decoded, outcome_unknown) if include_status else decoded
+    finally:
+        server.close()
+        client.close()
+
+
+def _frame(payload: bytes) -> bytes:
+    return _HEADER.pack(len(payload)) + payload
+
+
+class _Supervisor:
+    def __init__(self, *, result=None, error=None, ack_error=None, replay_result=None):
+        self.calls = []
+        self.replay_calls = []
+        self.ack_calls = []
+        self.result = result
+        self.error = error
+        self.ack_error = ack_error
+        self.replay_result = replay_result
+
+    def submit_dispatch_intent(self, **kwargs):
+        self.calls.append(kwargs)
+        if self.error is not None:
+            raise self.error
+        return self.result
+
+    def ack_dispatch_intent(self, **kwargs):
+        self.ack_calls.append(kwargs)
+        if self.ack_error is not None:
+            raise self.ack_error
+        return kwargs
+
+    def replay_dispatch_outcome(self, **kwargs):
+        self.replay_calls.append(kwargs)
+        return self.replay_result
+
+
+def _bound_result(envelope, key_id):
+    return {
+        "instruction": envelope,
+        "key_id": key_id,
+        "principal": "Codex",
+        "event_seq": 7,
+        "payload_digest": "a" * 64,
+        "service_generation": "generation-test",
+        **{name: envelope[name] for name in (
+            "request_id", "task_id", "slot", "attempt", "epoch", "run_id",
+        )},
+    }
+
+
+def test_s2_owner_service_accepts_only_one_bounded_canonical_instruction_frame(
+    dispatch_instruction_keypair,
+):
+    keypair = dispatch_instruction_keypair
+    envelope = keypair.sign(_fields())
+    supervisor = _Supervisor(result=_bound_result(envelope, keypair.key_id))
+    service = _service(keypair, supervisor)
+    payload = canonical_bytes({"instruction": envelope})
+
+    response = _exchange(service, _frame(payload))
+
+    assert response == {"ok": True, "result": _bound_result(envelope, keypair.key_id)}
+    assert supervisor.calls == [{"instruction": envelope}]
+    result = _bound_result(envelope, keypair.key_id)
+    assert supervisor.ack_calls == [{
+        "request_id": result["request_id"],
+        "payload_digest": result["payload_digest"],
+        "event_seq": result["event_seq"],
+        "result_sha256": hashlib.sha256(canonical_bytes(result)).hexdigest(),
+        "service_generation": result["service_generation"],
+    }]
+    assert len(payload) <= service_module.MAX_REQUEST_BYTES
+

+def test_relay_does_not_ack_when_local_response_forwarding_fails(dispatch_instruction_keypair):
+    keypair = dispatch_instruction_keypair
+    envelope = keypair.sign(_fields())
+    supervisor = _Supervisor(result=_bound_result(envelope, keypair.key_id))
+    service = _service(keypair, supervisor)
+    server, client = socket.socketpair()
+    client.sendall(_frame(canonical_bytes({"instruction": envelope})))
+    client.shutdown(socket.SHUT_WR)
+
+    class FailingSend:
+        def settimeout(self, timeout):
+            server.settimeout(timeout)
+
+        def recv(self, size):
+            return server.recv(size)
+
+        def sendall(self, _data):
+            raise OSError("injected local forwarding failure")
+
+    try:
+        assert service._handle(FailingSend()) is True
+        assert len(supervisor.calls) == 1
+        assert supervisor.ack_calls == []
+    finally:
+        server.close()
+        client.close()
+

+@pytest.mark.parametrize(

+    real_read = service_module.os.read
+    real_close = service_module.os.close

+            "st_gid": 0,

+    monkeypatch.setattr(service_module.os, "read", real_read)
+    monkeypatch.setattr(service_module.os, "close", real_close)
+
+    with pytest.raises(ContractError, match="owner, mode, or size"):
+        service_module._read_root_json(

+def test_s2_owner_service_loader_uses_fixed_shared_registry_path_and_permissions(
+    monkeypatch,
+):
+    registry = {"test-key": {
+        "principal": "Codex", "purpose": service_module.DISPATCH_INSTRUCTION_PURPOSE,
+        "public_key_path": "/etc/vst-runner/test-public.pem",
+    }}
+    calls = []
+    monkeypatch.setattr(service_module.os.path, "lexists", lambda path: False)
+    monkeypatch.setattr(service_module.os, "geteuid", lambda: 1500)
+    monkeypatch.setattr(service_module.os, "getgid", lambda: 1501)

+    import builtins
+    real_open = builtins.open

+            return StringIO("0::/system.slice/vst-dispatch-owner.service\n")
+        return real_open(path, *args, **kwargs)
+
+    monkeypatch.setattr(builtins, "open", fake_open)
+
+    def read_root_json(path, *, expected_mode, expected_gid, max_bytes):
+        calls.append((path, expected_mode, expected_gid, max_bytes))
+        return registry if path == service_module.TRUST_REGISTRY_PATH else {
+            "principal": "Codex", "openssl_path": "/usr/bin/openssl",
+        }

+    loaded = service_module.load_dispatch_owner_config()
+
+    assert loaded.trust_registry == registry
+    assert calls == [
+        (service_module.DEFAULT_CONFIG_PATH, 0o640, 1501, 65536),
+        (service_module.TRUST_REGISTRY_PATH, 0o644, 0, 65536),
+    ]
+    assert service_module.TRUST_REGISTRY_PATH == "/etc/vst-runner/dispatch-instruction-trust.json"

+@pytest.mark.parametrize(
+    "metadata",
+    [
+        {"uid": 0, "gid": 0, "mode": 0o644, "regular": True},
+        {"uid": 1, "gid": 0, "mode": 0o644},
+        {"uid": 0, "gid": 1, "mode": 0o644},
+        {"uid": 0, "gid": 0, "mode": 0o600},
+        {"uid": 0, "gid": 0, "mode": 0o644, "regular": False},
+    ],
+    ids=[
+        "root-owned-group-mode-accepted", "nonroot-key-owner", "wrong-key-group",
+        "unsafe-key-mode", "key-not-regular",
+    ],
+)
+def test_s2_owner_service_public_key_requires_root_owner_group_and_mode(
+    monkeypatch, metadata,
+):
+    def fake_stat(path, *, follow_symlinks=True):
+        if path == "/etc/vst-runner/key.pem":
+            mode = stat.S_IFREG if metadata.get("regular", True) else stat.S_IFDIR
+            mode |= metadata["mode"]
+            return type("Info", (), {
+                "st_mode": mode, "st_uid": metadata["uid"], "st_gid": metadata["gid"],
+                "st_size": 32,
+            })()
+        return type("Info", (), {"st_mode": stat.S_IFDIR | 0o755, "st_uid": 0, "st_gid": 0})()
+
+    monkeypatch.setattr(service_module.os, "stat", fake_stat)
+    monkeypatch.setattr(service_module.os, "open", lambda path, flags: 13)
+    monkeypatch.setattr(service_module.os, "fstat", lambda fd: type("Info", (), {
+        "st_mode": (stat.S_IFREG if metadata.get("regular", True) else stat.S_IFDIR)
+        | metadata["mode"], "st_uid": metadata["uid"],
+        "st_gid": metadata["gid"], "st_size": 32,
+    })())
+    monkeypatch.setattr(service_module.os, "close", lambda fd: None)
+
+    if metadata.get("uid") != 0 or metadata.get("gid") != 0 or metadata.get("mode") != 0o644 or not metadata.get("regular", True):
+        with pytest.raises(ContractError, match="owner, mode, or size"):
+            service_module._validate_root_public_key("/etc/vst-runner/key.pem")
+    else:
+        service_module._validate_root_public_key("/etc/vst-runner/key.pem")
+

+@pytest.mark.parametrize(
+    "invalid",
+    ["bad-signature", "expired", "wrong-principal", "revoked-key", "malformed"],
+    ids=["signature", "expired-instruction", "wrong-principal", "revoked-key", "malformed-envelope"],
+)
+def test_s2_owner_service_refuses_invalid_instruction_before_supervisor_rpc(
+    dispatch_instruction_keypair, invalid,
+):
+    keypair = dispatch_instruction_keypair
+    envelope = keypair.sign(_fields())
+    registry = {key: dict(value) for key, value in keypair.trust_registry.items()}
+    if invalid == "bad-signature":
+        envelope = {**envelope, "signature": "A" * len(envelope["signature"])}
+    elif invalid == "expired":
+        from datetime import datetime, timedelta, timezone
+        past = (datetime.now(timezone.utc) - timedelta(minutes=2)).strftime("%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ")
+        envelope = keypair.sign(_fields(), expires_at=past)
+    elif invalid == "wrong-principal":
+        registry[keypair.key_id]["principal"] = "GPT-PM"
+    elif invalid == "revoked-key":
+        registry = {}
+    elif invalid == "malformed":
+        envelope = {**envelope, "worker": "vst-worker"}
+    supervisor = _Supervisor(result=_bound_result(envelope, keypair.key_id))
+    config = service_module.DispatchOwnerServiceConfig(
+        principal="Codex", openssl_path=keypair.openssl_path,
+        trust_registry=registry,
+    )
+    service = service_module.DispatchOwnerService(config, supervisor=supervisor)
+    wire = _frame(canonical_bytes({"instruction": envelope}))
+
+    response = _exchange(service, wire)
+
+    assert response == {"ok": False, "error": "refused"}
+    assert supervisor.calls == []
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize(
+    "outcome",
+    ["timeout", "explicit-error", "malformed-result", "response-binding-mismatch"],
+    ids=["timeout", "explicit-error", "malformed-result", "response-binding-mismatch"],
+)
+def test_s2_owner_service_requires_reconciliation_after_ambiguous_supervisor_outcome(
+    dispatch_instruction_keypair, outcome,
+):
+    keypair = dispatch_instruction_keypair
+    envelope = keypair.sign(_fields())
+    if outcome == "timeout":
+        supervisor = _Supervisor(error=TimeoutError("response lost after possible acceptance"))
+    elif outcome == "explicit-error":
+        supervisor = _Supervisor(error=RuntimeError("Supervisor rejected after dispatch"))
+    elif outcome == "malformed-result":
+        supervisor = _Supervisor(result={"unexpected": True})
+    else:
+        wrong = {**envelope, "task_id": "different-task"}
+        supervisor = _Supervisor(result=_bound_result(wrong, keypair.key_id))
+    service = _service(keypair, supervisor)
+    server_conn, client_conn = socket.socketpair()
+    queued_server_conn, queued_client_conn = socket.socketpair()
+    wire = _frame(canonical_bytes({"instruction": envelope}))
+    client_conn.sendall(wire)
+    client_conn.shutdown(socket.SHUT_WR)
+    queued_client_conn.sendall(wire)
+    queued_client_conn.shutdown(socket.SHUT_WR)
+
+    class Listener:
+        family = socket.AF_UNIX
+
+        def __init__(self):
+            self.accept_count = 0
+            self.pending = [(server_conn, None), (queued_server_conn, None)]
+
+        def getsockopt(self, level, option):
+            return socket.SOCK_STREAM if option == socket.SO_TYPE else 1
+
+        def getsockname(self):
+            return service_module.OWNER_SOCKET_PATH
+
+        def settimeout(self, timeout):
+            pass
+
+        def accept(self):
+            self.accept_count += 1
+            return self.pending.pop(0)
+
+    listener = Listener()
+    try:
+        service.serve_forever(listener)
+        header = client_conn.recv(_HEADER.size)
+        assert len(header) == _HEADER.size
+        size = _HEADER.unpack(header)[0]
+        response_bytes = bytearray()
+        while len(response_bytes) < size:
+            chunk = client_conn.recv(size - len(response_bytes))
+            assert chunk
+            response_bytes.extend(chunk)
+        response = json.loads(response_bytes)
+        queued_client_conn.settimeout(0.01)
+        with pytest.raises(socket.timeout):
+            queued_client_conn.recv(1)
+    finally:
+        server_conn.close()
+        client_conn.close()
+        queued_server_conn.close()
+        queued_client_conn.close()
+
+    assert response == {"ok": False, "error": "reconciliation_required"}
+    assert supervisor.calls == [{"instruction": envelope}]
+    assert listener.accept_count == 1
+    assert service._shutdown.is_set()
+

+"""Functional transport tests for the S2-DISPATCH-M01 source integration slice."""

+import stat
