+#!/usr/bin/env node
+/**
+ * PROJECT-OWNED AF adapter for the native PM Bridge review CLI.
+ *
+ * The native CLI remains the authority for prompt construction, routing, daemon
+ * authentication and verdict parsing. This adapter only replaces its inline send
+ * with the daemon's existing real-file-attachment path so complete S2 inputs can
+ * exceed the HTTP JSON body limit without changing the review bytes.
+ */
+import crypto from "node:crypto";
+import fs from "node:fs";
+import path from "node:path";
+import { spawnSync } from "node:child_process";
+import { pathToFileURL } from "node:url";
+
+const NATIVE_REVIEW = "D:/Repo/pm-bridge/src/cli/review.js";
+const BRIDGE_ROOT = "D:/Repo/pm-bridge/src";
+const MAX_PROMPT_BYTES = 64 * 1024 * 1024;
+const NATIVE_MAX_DIFF_CHARS = 100_000_000;
+const OPERATION = "send-and-await";
+const ATTACHMENT_PREFIX = "s2-review-input-";
+
+const sha256 = (bytes) => crypto.createHash("sha256").update(bytes).digest("hex");
+const canonicalPath = (p) => path.resolve(p);
+
+export function validateCommitRange({ cwd, base, head }) {
+  const git = (...args) => {
+    const r = spawnSync("git", ["-C", cwd, ...args], { encoding: "utf8", windowsHide: true });
+    if (r.status !== 0) throw new Error(`git ${args.join(" ")} failed: ${(r.stderr || "").trim()}`);
+    return r.stdout.trim();
+  };
+  const headSha = git("rev-parse", "--verify", `${head || "HEAD"}^{commit}`);
+  const baseSha = git("rev-parse", "--verify", `${base}^{commit}`);
+  const ancestor = spawnSync("git", ["-C", cwd, "merge-base", "--is-ancestor", baseSha, headSha], { windowsHide: true });
+  if (ancestor.status !== 0) throw new Error(`base ${baseSha} is not an ancestor of HEAD ${headSha}`);
+  const diff = spawnSync("git", ["-C", cwd, "diff", "--quiet", `${baseSha}...${headSha}`], { windowsHide: true });
+  if (diff.status === 0) throw new Error("review range is empty");
+  if (diff.status !== 1) throw new Error("git diff range validation failed");
+  return { baseSha, headSha };
+}
+
+export function verifyRegularAttachment(filePath, expectedSha, expectedSize) {
+  const st = fs.lstatSync(filePath);
+  if (!st.isFile() || st.isSymbolicLink() || st.nlink !== 1) throw new Error("review attachment must be a regular single-link file");
+  if (st.size <= 0 || st.size > MAX_PROMPT_BYTES || st.size !== expectedSize) throw new Error("review attachment size is invalid or changed");
+  const bytes = fs.readFileSync(filePath);
+  if (bytes.length !== st.size || sha256(bytes) !== expectedSha) throw new Error("review attachment bytes do not match the canonical prompt hash");
+  const text = new TextDecoder("utf-8", { fatal: true }).decode(bytes);
+  if (!Buffer.from(text, "utf8").equals(bytes)) throw new Error("review prompt is not canonical UTF-8");
+  return bytes;
+}
+
+export function assertPromptBinding(prompt, { headSha, baseSha, baseRef }) {
+  const diffAt = prompt.indexOf("Diff:\n```diff\n");
+  if (diffAt < 0) throw new Error("native prompt is missing the complete diff envelope");
+  const preDiff = prompt.slice(0, diffAt).split(/\r?\n/);
+  if (!preDiff.includes(`Exact HEAD under review: ${headSha}`) ||
+      !(preDiff.includes(`Reviewed range: ${baseSha}...${headSha}`) ||
+        preDiff.includes(`Reviewed range: ${baseRef}...${headSha}`))) {
+    throw new Error("native scope prompt does not bind the exact HEAD and reviewed base range before the diff");
+  }
+}
+
+function parseArgs(argv) {
+  const out = { argv: [...argv], cwd: null, base: null, head: "HEAD", project: null, final: false };
+  for (let i = 0; i < argv.length; i++) {
+    const a = argv[i];
+    if (a === "--cwd") out.cwd = argv[++i];
+    else if (a === "--base") out.base = argv[++i];
+    else if (a === "--head") out.head = argv[++i];
+    else if (a === "--project") out.project = argv[++i];
+    else if (a === "--final") out.final = true;
+  }
+  if (!out.cwd || !out.base || argv.includes("--uncommitted") || argv.includes("--commit")) {
+    throw new Error("AF attachment review requires native --cwd and --base commit-range arguments");
+  }
+  out.cwd = canonicalPath(out.cwd);
+  return out;
+}
+
+function runNativeDump(args, dumpPath, env = process.env) {
+  const result = spawnSync(process.execPath, [NATIVE_REVIEW, ...args.argv], {
+    cwd: args.cwd,
+    encoding: "utf8",
+    windowsHide: true,
+    env: { ...env, PM_BRIDGE_DEBUG_DUMP_PROMPT: dumpPath, PM_BRIDGE_DEBUG_DUMP_PROMPT_ONLY: "1" },
+    maxBuffer: 2 * 1024 * 1024,
+  });
+  if (result.error) throw result.error;
+  if (result.status !== 0) throw new Error(`native review dump exited ${result.status}: ${(result.stderr || result.stdout || "").slice(-1500)}`);
+  if (!fs.existsSync(dumpPath)) throw new Error(`native review dump failed (exit ${result.status}): ${(result.stderr || result.stdout || "").slice(-1500)}`);
+  const diagnostic = [...(result.stdout || "").trim().split(/\r?\n/)].reverse().find((line) => line.startsWith("{"));
+  if (!diagnostic) throw new Error("native review dump did not return its diagnostic JSON");
+  const parsed = JSON.parse(diagnostic);
+  if (parsed.diagnostic !== true) throw new Error(`native review preflight failed: ${parsed.error || "unknown failure"}`);
+  return parsed;
+}
+
+function artifactDirectory(cwd) {
+  return path.join(cwd, "docs", "sdlc", ".pm-review");
+}
+
+function ensurePrivateArtifactDirectory(cwd) {
+  const target = artifactDirectory(cwd);
+  fs.mkdirSync(target, { recursive: true });
+  for (const candidate of [path.join(cwd, "docs"), path.join(cwd, "docs", "sdlc"), target]) {
+    const st = fs.lstatSync(candidate);
+    if (!st.isDirectory() || st.isSymbolicLink()) throw new Error(`review artifact directory is not a real directory: ${candidate}`);
+  }
+  return target;
+}
+
+function publishPrompt(dir, promptBytes, inputHash) {
+  fs.mkdirSync(dir, { recursive: true });
+  const filePath = path.join(dir, `${ATTACHMENT_PREFIX}${inputHash}.txt`);
+  if (fs.existsSync(filePath)) {
+    verifyRegularAttachment(filePath, inputHash, promptBytes.length);
+  } else {
+    const temporary = path.join(dir, `.${ATTACHMENT_PREFIX}${crypto.randomUUID()}.tmp`);
+    const fd = fs.openSync(temporary, "wx", 0o600);
+    try { fs.writeFileSync(fd, promptBytes); fs.fsyncSync(fd); } finally { fs.closeSync(fd); }
+    try { fs.linkSync(temporary, filePath); }
+    catch (err) {
+      if (err.code !== "EEXIST") throw err;
+      verifyRegularAttachment(filePath, inputHash, promptBytes.length);
+    } finally { fs.unlinkSync(temporary); }
+    verifyRegularAttachment(filePath, inputHash, promptBytes.length);
+  }
+  return filePath;
+}
+
+function atomicJson(filePath, value) {
+  const temporary = `${filePath}.${crypto.randomUUID()}.tmp`;
+  const fd = fs.openSync(temporary, "wx", 0o600);
+  try { fs.writeFileSync(fd, `${JSON.stringify(value, null, 2)}\n`, "utf8"); fs.fsyncSync(fd); } finally { fs.closeSync(fd); }
+  fs.renameSync(temporary, filePath);
+}
+
+function readOwnedIntent(filePath) {
+  const st = fs.lstatSync(filePath);
+  if (!st.isFile() || st.isSymbolicLink() || st.nlink !== 1 || st.size > 64 * 1024) throw new Error("persisted review intent is not a bounded regular single-link file");
+  return JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(filePath, "utf8"));
+}
+
+function createIntentExclusive(filePath, candidate) {
+  const fd = fs.openSync(filePath, "wx", 0o600);
+  try {
+    fs.writeFileSync(fd, `${JSON.stringify(candidate, null, 2)}\n`, "utf8");
+    fs.fsyncSync(fd);
+  } finally { fs.closeSync(fd); }
+  return candidate;
+}
+
+function validateIntent(intent, expected) {
+  if (!intent || intent.operation !== OPERATION ||
+      typeof intent.requestId !== "string" || !/^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-4[0-9a-f]{3}-[89ab][0-9a-f]{3}-[0-9a-f]{12}$/i.test(intent.requestId) ||
+      intent.inputHash !== expected.inputHash || intent.headSha !== expected.headSha || intent.baseSha !== expected.baseSha ||
+      intent.projectId !== expected.projectId || intent.conversationId !== expected.conversationId ||
+      intent.size !== expected.size || canonicalPath(intent.attachmentPath) !== canonicalPath(expected.attachmentPath) ||
+      !["prepared", "sending", "succeeded"].includes(intent.phase)) {
+    throw new Error("persisted review intent schema or immutable identity fields do not match this canonical request");
+  }
+  if ((intent.instruction !== undefined && typeof intent.instruction !== "string") ||
+      (intent.instructionSha256 !== undefined && (typeof intent.instruction !== "string" ||
+       intent.instructionSha256 !== sha256(Buffer.from(intent.instruction, "utf8"))))) {
+    throw new Error("persisted review intent instruction hash does not match its immutable instruction");
+  }
+  return intent;
+}
+
+export function parseAcknowledgements(reply, expected) {
+  const fields = [
+    ["REVIEW_INPUT_SHA256", expected.inputHash],
+    ["REVIEW_HEAD", expected.headSha],
+    ["REVIEW_REQUEST_ID", expected.requestId],
+  ];
+  const lines = String(reply ?? "").split(/\r?\n/);
+  const outsideFence = [];
+  let fence = null;
+  for (const line of lines) {
+    const fenceMatch = /^\s{0,3}(`{3,}|~{3,})/.exec(line);
+    if (fenceMatch) {
+      const marker = fenceMatch[1][0];
+      if (fence === null) fence = marker;
+      else if (fence === marker) fence = null;
+      continue;
+    }
+    if (fence === null) outsideFence.push(line);
+  }
+  for (const [label, value] of fields) {
+    const token = `[REDACTED]`;
+    const occurrences = String(reply ?? "").split(token).length - 1;
+    const exact = outsideFence.filter((line) => line === `${token}${value}`);
+    if (occurrences !== 1 || exact.length !== 1) throw new Error(`GPT reply lacks one unique standalone ${label} acknowledgment or contains conflicting/quoted/code-fenced copies`);
+  }
+  return true;
+}
+
+export function validateTopLevelVerdict(reply, parseVerdict) {
+  const firstLine = String(reply ?? "").split(/\r?\n/, 1)[0];
+  if (!/^VERDICT: [^\r\n]+$/.test(firstLine)) throw new Error("GPT reply must begin with one unquoted top-level VERDICT line");
+  const parsed = parseVerdict(reply);
+  if (!parsed?.found || parsed.verdictCount !== 1 || firstLine !== `VERDICT: ${String(parsed.line ?? "").trim()}`) {
+    throw new Error("GPT reply contains a missing, repeated, echoed, or conflicting VERDICT line");
+  }
+  return parsed;
+}
+
+export function nativePromptWasTruncated(prompt, { requestedFinal }) {
+  // review.js's --final path refuses before prompt emission when buildDiff exceeds
+  // MAX_DIFF_CHARS. Non-final reviews use this exact marker only after slicing that
+  // diff to MAX_DIFF_CHARS; require the native shape and an over-limit total.
+  const open = "Diff:\n```diff\n";
+  const openAt = prompt.indexOf(open);
+  if (openAt < 0) throw new Error("native prompt is missing the diff envelope");
+  const footerAt = prompt.lastIndexOf("\n\n---\n\n");
+  const closeSearchEnd = footerAt > openAt ? footerAt : prompt.length;
+  const closeAt = prompt.lastIndexOf("\n```", closeSearchEnd);
+  if (closeAt < openAt + open.length) throw new Error("native prompt diff envelope is incomplete");
+  const diffTail = prompt.slice(openAt + open.length, closeAt);
+  const marker = /\n\[\.\.\. truncated, ([1-9]\d*) chars total \.\.\.\]$/.exec(diffTail);
+  if (!marker) return false;
+  if (Number(marker[1]) <= NATIVE_MAX_DIFF_CHARS) throw new Error("prompt contains a truncation marker inconsistent with native review.js limits");
+  if (requestedFinal) throw new Error("native final review prompt contains its non-final truncation marker");
+  return true;
+}
+
+function assertManifest(job, filePath, inputHash, size, expectedText) {
+  const snapshot = job?.sendSnapshot;
+  const entries = snapshot?.attachments;
+  if (!Array.isArray(entries) || entries.length !== 1) throw new Error("durable send snapshot lacks exactly one attachment descriptor");
+  const entry = entries[0];
+  if (entry.name !== path.basename(filePath) || entry.size !== size || entry.sha256 !== inputHash || canonicalPath(entry.path) !== canonicalPath(filePath)) {
+    throw new Error("durable daemon attachment manifest differs from the canonical prompt file");
+  }
+  if (snapshot.logicalText !== expectedText) throw new Error("durable logical sent text differs from the persisted short instruction");
+  const wire = snapshot.baseline?.wireEvidence;
+  if (!snapshot.baseline?.userTurnId || snapshot.baseline.userTurnId !== job.userTurnId || !wire || wire.wireRequestId !== job.requestId ||
+      wire.wireDescriptor?.requestId !== job.requestId || wire.wireHash !== sha256(Buffer.from(snapshot.text ?? "", "utf8")) ||
+      typeof snapshot.text !== "string" || !snapshot.text.includes(job.requestId)) {
+    throw new Error("durable wire text lacks the native request-ID and user-turn evidence contract");
+  }
+  return entry;
+}
+
+export function validateCompletedJob({ job, intent, filePath, promptBytes }) {
+  if (!job || job.status !== "succeeded" || job.operation !== OPERATION || job.sendPhase !== "sent") throw new Error("durable review job is not a completed sent send-and-await");
+  if (job.requestId !== intent.requestId || job.projectId !== intent.projectId || job.conversationId !== intent.conversationId) throw new Error("durable job identity does not match persisted intent");
+  const snapshot = job.sendSnapshot;
+  if (!snapshot || !job.userTurnId || !job.replyId || job.result?.replyId !== job.replyId || job.correlated !== true || job.result?.correlated !== true) throw new Error("durable job lacks sent-turn and correlated reply evidence");
+  if (job.idempotencyKey !== `${intent.requestId}:send-and-await`) throw new Error("durable job idempotency key differs from persisted intent");
+  if (snapshot.conversationId !== intent.conversationId) throw new Error("durable sent snapshot conversation differs from persisted intent");
+  const descriptor = assertManifest(job, filePath, intent.inputHash, promptBytes.length, intent.instruction);
+  const reply = job.result.reply;
+  if (typeof reply !== "string") throw new Error("durable review result has no textual reply");
+  parseAcknowledgements(reply, { inputHash: intent.inputHash, headSha: intent.headSha, requestId: intent.requestId });
+  return { descriptor, reply, replyId: job.result.replyId };
+}
+
+async function loadBridge() {
+  const at = (name) => pathToFileURL(path.join(BRIDGE_ROOT, name)).href;
+  const [client, routing, identity, verdict, wireEnvelope] = await Promise.all([
+    import(at("orchestratorClient.js")), import(at("callerRouting.js")),
+    import(at("projectAutoRegister.js")), import(at("reviewVerdict.js")), import(at("wireEnvelope.js")),
+  ]);
+  return { ...client, ...routing, ...identity, ...verdict, ...wireEnvelope };
+}
+
+async function runAdapter(argv, { bridgeLoader = loadBridge, nativeDump = runNativeDump } = {}) {
+  if (process.env.PM_BRIDGE_DEBUG_DUMP_PROMPT_ONLY) {
+    const forwarded = spawnSync(process.execPath, [NATIVE_REVIEW, ...argv], {
+      cwd: process.cwd(), encoding: "utf8", windowsHide: true,
+      env: process.env, maxBuffer: 2 * 1024 * 1024,
+    });
+    if (forwarded.error) throw forwarded.error;
+    if (forwarded.stdout) process.stdout.write(forwarded.stdout);
+    if (forwarded.stderr) process.stderr.write(forwarded.stderr);
+    process.exitCode = forwarded.status ?? 2;
+    return null;
+  }
+  const args = parseArgs(argv);
+  const initial = validateCommitRange(args);
+  const dir = ensurePrivateArtifactDirectory(args.cwd);
+  const dump = path.join(dir, `.prompt-${crypto.randomUUID()}.tmp`);
+  let promptBytes;
+  let inputHash;
+  let truncated = false;
+  try {
+    nativeDump(args, dump);
+    promptBytes = fs.readFileSync(dump);
+    if (!promptBytes.length || promptBytes.length > MAX_PROMPT_BYTES) throw new Error("canonical prompt is empty or exceeds 64 MiB");
+    const prompt = new TextDecoder("utf-8", { fatal: true }).decode(promptBytes);
+    if (!Buffer.from(prompt, "utf8").equals(promptBytes)) throw new Error("native prompt dump is not canonical UTF-8");
+    inputHash = sha256(promptBytes);
+    assertPromptBinding(prompt, { ...initial, baseRef: args.base });
+    truncated = nativePromptWasTruncated(prompt, { requestedFinal: args.final });
+  } finally { if (fs.existsSync(dump)) fs.unlinkSync(dump); }
+  const rangeAfterDump = validateCommitRange(args);
+  if (rangeAfterDump.headSha !== initial.headSha || rangeAfterDump.baseSha !== initial.baseSha) throw new Error("repository HEAD/base moved while building the canonical review input");
+
+  const attachmentPath = publishPrompt(dir, promptBytes, inputHash);
+  const intentPath = path.join(dir, `intent-${inputHash}.json`);
+  const bridge = await bridgeLoader();
+  const { identityBinding } = await bridge.resolveIdentityAssertedBinding(args.cwd, "--cwd", args.project, "--project", "AF attachment review routing");
+  const active = await bridge.isOrchestratorActive();
+  if (!active) throw new Error("no compatible PM Bridge daemon is active; attachment review refuses direct transport");
+  if (!Array.isArray(active.capabilities) || !active.capabilities.includes("file-attachments")) throw new Error("active PM Bridge daemon does not advertise file-attachments capability");
+
+  let intent;
+  const expectedIntent = { inputHash, headSha: initial.headSha, baseSha: initial.baseSha,
+    projectId: identityBinding.projectId, conversationId: identityBinding.conversationId,
+    size: promptBytes.length, attachmentPath };
+  if (fs.existsSync(intentPath)) {
+    const prior = readOwnedIntent(intentPath);
+    intent = validateIntent(prior, expectedIntent);
+  } else {
+    const requestId = crypto.randomUUID();
+    const candidate = { requestId, operation: OPERATION, inputHash, headSha: initial.headSha, baseSha: initial.baseSha, size: promptBytes.length, attachmentPath, projectId: identityBinding.projectId, conversationId: identityBinding.conversationId, createdAt: new Date().toISOString(), phase: "prepared" };
+    try { intent = validateIntent(createIntentExclusive(intentPath, candidate), expectedIntent); }
+    catch (err) {
+      if (err.code !== "EEXIST") throw err;
+      intent = validateIntent(readOwnedIntent(intentPath), expectedIntent);
+    }
+  }
+  verifyRegularAttachment(attachmentPath, inputHash, promptBytes.length);
+  const instruction = [
+    "Review the attached complete canonical PM Bridge input as one adversarial S2 code-and-tests review, including its evidence. Do not claim review of historical documentation lines outside the attached input. Put the VERDICT line first, then the findings, then the three exact acknowledgement lines below.",
+    `Exact HEAD under review: ${intent.headSha}`, `Reviewed range: ${intent.baseSha}...${intent.headSha}`,
+    `Full attachment SHA-256: ${inputHash}`, `Attachment bytes: ${promptBytes.length}`,
+    `Request ID: ${intent.requestId}`,
+    "Your reply must include exactly identifiable acknowledgements on separate lines:",
+    `REVIEW_INPUT_SHA256:${inputHash}`, `REVIEW_HEAD:${intent.headSha}`, `REVIEW_REQUEST_ID:${intent.requestId}`,
+  ].join("\n");
+  if (intent.instruction && intent.instruction !== instruction) throw new Error("persisted short instruction differs from this request");
+  if (!intent.instruction) {
+    intent = { ...intent, instruction, instructionSha256: sha256(Buffer.from(instruction, "utf8")) };
+    atomicJson(intentPath, intent);
+  }
+  intent = validateIntent(intent, expectedIntent);
+
+  const status = async () => bridge.callOrchestrator(active, "/job_status", { requestId: intent.requestId, operation: OPERATION }, 10000);
+  let durable;
+  let recovered = false;
+  try {
+    const previous = await status();
+    if (previous.job) { durable = previous.job; recovered = true; }
+  } catch (err) { if (err.code !== "JOB_NOT_FOUND") throw err; }
+  const claimPath = path.join(dir, `claim-${inputHash}.json`);
+  if (!durable && (intent.phase !== "prepared" || fs.existsSync(claimPath))) {
+    throw new Error(`request ${intent.requestId} was already marked sending but has no visible durable job; refusing to resend or mint a new ID, reconcile this exact request via job status`);
+  }
+  if (!durable) {
+    try {
+      createIntentExclusive(claimPath, { requestId: intent.requestId, inputHash, createdAt: new Date().toISOString() });
+    } catch (err) {
+      if (err.code !== "EEXIST") throw err;
+      throw new Error(`another invocation already claimed send boundary for request ${intent.requestId}; reconcile this exact request via job status`);
+    }
+    intent = { ...intent, phase: "sending" };
+    atomicJson(intentPath, intent);
+    try {
+      await bridge.callOrchestrator(active, "/send_and_await", {
+        ...bridge.daemonRouting(args.project, { repoPath: args.cwd }),
+        text: instruction, attachments: [attachmentPath], waitForCompletionControls: true,
+        reviewInputHash: inputHash, reviewRequestId: intent.requestId,
+        requestId: intent.requestId, idempotencyKey: `${intent.requestId}:send-and-await`,
+      }, null);
+    } catch (sendError) {
+      try { durable = (await status()).job; }
+      catch (recoveryError) { throw new Error(`send response was ambiguous (${sendError.message}); durable status unavailable (${recoveryError.message}); resume same request ${intent.requestId}`); }
+      if (!durable) throw new Error(`send response was ambiguous (${sendError.message}); no durable job exists; retry same intent ${intent.requestId}`);
+    }
+  }
+  if (!durable || !["succeeded", "failed", "cancelled", "uncertain"].includes(durable.status)) durable = (await status()).job;
+  if (!durable || durable.status !== "succeeded") throw new Error(`durable review request ${intent.requestId} is ${durable?.status ?? "unknown"}; inspect/resume this same request, never create another one`);
+  verifyRegularAttachment(attachmentPath, inputHash, promptBytes.length);
+  const proof = validateCompletedJob({ job: durable, intent, filePath: attachmentPath, promptBytes });
+  const wireDescriptor = durable.sendSnapshot.baseline.wireEvidence.wireDescriptor;
+  bridge.assertCanonicalDescriptor(wireDescriptor);
+  if (wireDescriptor.steps.some((step) => step.kind === "rotation-title")) throw new Error("conversation-rotation wire snapshots are outside this adapter's authorized recovery contract");
+  const reproducedWireText = bridge.applyWireTransforms(intent.instruction, wireDescriptor, {});
+  if (reproducedWireText !== durable.sendSnapshot.text) throw new Error("durable wire text does not reproduce from logical instruction and canonical native descriptor");
+  if (validateCommitRange(args).headSha !== intent.headSha) throw new Error("repository HEAD changed while PM Bridge review was running");
+  intent = { ...intent, phase: "succeeded", jobId: durable.jobId, replyId: proof.replyId };
+  atomicJson(intentPath, intent);
+
+  const parsed = validateTopLevelVerdict(proof.reply, bridge.parseVerdict);
+  const finalDecision = bridge.decideReviewFinal({ requestedFinal: args.final, reviewStatus: "RAN", reply: proof.reply, parsedVerdict: parsed, truncated, correlated: true });
+  const result = {
+    ok: true, error: null, review_status: "RAN", round: 1,
+    final: finalDecision.final, truncated, final_overridden: finalDecision.finalOverridden,
+    verdict: parsed.severity, verdict_contradiction: parsed.contradiction === true,
+    correlated: true, replyId: proof.replyId, reviewRequestId: intent.requestId,
+    reviewInputHash: proof.descriptor.sha256, conversation: identityBinding.conversationId,
+    recovered, reply: proof.reply, receipt_written: durable.sendPhase === "sent",
+    attachment: { path: attachmentPath, name: proof.descriptor.name, size: proof.descriptor.size, sha256: proof.descriptor.sha256 },
+    durableJobId: durable.jobId, projectId: identityBinding.projectId, baseSha: intent.baseSha, headSha: intent.headSha,
+  };
+  console.log(JSON.stringify(result));
+  return result;
+}
+
+export { runAdapter };
+
+if (process.argv[1] && import.meta.url === pathToFileURL(path.resolve(process.argv[1])).href) {
+  runAdapter(process.argv.slice(2)).catch((err) => {
+    console.log(JSON.stringify({ ok: false, error: err.message, review_status: "NOT_RUN", final: false, truncated: false, final_overridden: false, verdict: "UNRECOGNIZED", correlated: false, receipt_written: false }));
+    process.exitCode = 2;
+  });
+}

+function Read-BoundedProcessOutput {
+    param([System.Diagnostics.Process]$Process, [int]$MaximumBytes)
+    $buffer = New-Object byte[] 65536
+    $memory = New-Object System.IO.MemoryStream
+    while (($count = $Process.StandardOutput.BaseStream.Read($buffer, 0, $buffer.Length)) -gt 0) {
+        if (($memory.Length + $count) -gt $MaximumBytes) {
+            try { $Process.Kill() } catch { }
+            throw "Source archive exceeds the $MaximumBytes-byte transfer limit."
+        }
+        $memory.Write($buffer, 0, $count)
+    }
+    return ,$memory.ToArray()
+}

+def require_root_file(path, expected, expected_mode=0o644):
+    if not os.path.lexists(path):

+def source_tree(root, installed=False):

+"""Prepare an unsigned, non-secret source plan; never install or approve a bundle."""
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import argparse
+import hashlib
+import io
+import json
+import re
+import subprocess
+import tarfile
+from pathlib import Path
+
+CANONICAL_ROOT = Path("D:/Repo/Virtual_scrum_team")
+ARCHIVE_PATHS = (
+    "tools/vst", "tools/qa/install_wsl_runner_runtime.sh",
+    "tools/qa/install_wsl_worker_helper.sh", "tools/qa/worker_exec.c",
+    "docs/SANDBOX_SPEC.md",
+)
+UNITS = (
+    "vst-supervisor.service", "vst-signer.service", "vst-runner.service",
+    "vst-dispatcher.service", "vst-dispatch-owner.service", "vst-dispatch-owner.socket",
+)
+MAX_ARCHIVE_BYTES = 64 * 1024 * 1024
+
+
+def _git(root: Path, *arguments: str) -> bytes:
+    # Archive paths and revision are fixed or validated; no shell evaluation.
+    result = subprocess.run(
+        ["git", "-c", "core.autocrlf=false", "-c", "core.eol=lf",
+         "-C", str(root), "--no-replace-objects", *arguments],
+        stdin=subprocess.DEVNULL, capture_output=True, timeout=60, check=False,
+    )
+    if result.returncode:
+        raise ValueError("git source inspection failed: " + result.stderr.decode("utf-8", "replace")[:2048])
+    if len(result.stdout) > MAX_ARCHIVE_BYTES:
+        raise ValueError("source output exceeds the 64 MiB limit")
+    return result.stdout
+
+
+def prepare_source_plan(root: Path, expected_head: str) -> dict:
+    """Describe committed source; returned candidate is not staging authorization.
+
+    Dirty working files are not inputs. The Windows handoff independently requires
+    its working script to equal the committed version before executing anything.
+    Target inventory and compiler provenance must be attached and reviewed later.
+    """
+    root = root.resolve(strict=True)
+    if root != CANONICAL_ROOT.resolve(strict=True):
+        raise ValueError("source plan requires the canonical project checkout")
+    if not re.fullmatch(r"[0-9a-f]{40}", expected_head):
+        raise ValueError("expected HEAD must be 40 lowercase hex characters")
+    actual = _git(root, "rev-parse", "--verify", "HEAD").decode("ascii").strip()
+    if actual != expected_head:
+        raise ValueError("checkout HEAD differs from requested source revision")
+    archive = _git(root, "archive", "--format=tar", expected_head, "--", *ARCHIVE_PATHS)
+    if not archive:
+        raise ValueError("empty source archive")
+    files: dict[str, str] = {}
+    entries: set[str] = set()
+    total = 0
+    with tarfile.open(fileobj=io.BytesIO(archive), mode="r:") as stream:
+        for member in stream:
+            name = member.name.rstrip("/")
+            if (not name or name.startswith("/") or "\\" in name
+                    or any(part in ("", ".", "..") for part in name.split("/"))
+                    or name in entries or not (member.isdir() or member.isreg())):
+                raise ValueError("unsafe or duplicate source archive member")
+            entries.add(name)
+            if len(entries) > 50000:
+                raise ValueError("too many archive entries")
+            if member.isreg():
+                total += member.size
+                if member.size < 0 or total > MAX_ARCHIVE_BYTES:
+                    raise ValueError("expanded source archive exceeds limit")
+                content = stream.extractfile(member)
+                if content is None:
+                    raise ValueError("unreadable archive member")
+                files[name] = hashlib.sha256(content.read()).hexdigest()
+    required = {"docs/SANDBOX_SPEC.md", "tools/qa/worker_exec.c",
+                "tools/qa/install_wsl_worker_helper.sh", "tools/qa/install_wsl_runner_runtime.sh"}
+    required.update("tools/vst/systemd/" + name for name in UNITS)
+    if not required <= files.keys():
+        raise ValueError("source archive lacks a required runtime artifact")
+    return {
+        "schema": "VST_S2_RUNTIME_SOURCE_PLAN_V1",
+        "status": "UNSIGNED_REVIEW_CANDIDATE",
+        "source_head": expected_head,
+        "archive_sha256": hashlib.sha256(archive).hexdigest(),
+        "sandbox_spec_sha256": files["docs/SANDBOX_SPEC.md"],
+        "archive_files": files,
+        "unit_sha256": {name: files["tools/vst/systemd/" + name] for name in UNITS},
+        "runtime_path": "/opt/vst-runtime-" + expected_head,
+        "helper": {
+            "path": "/usr/local/libexec/vst-s4-worker-exec-" + expected_head,
+            "source_sha256": files["tools/qa/worker_exec.c"],
+            "build_recipe_sha256": files["tools/qa/install_wsl_worker_helper.sh"],
+            "compiler_path": "/usr/bin/cc",
+            "compiler_provenance": "NOT_VERIFIED",
+            "binary_sha256": None,
+            "uid": 0, "gid": 988, "mode": "4750",
+        },
+        "target_inventory": "NOT_VERIFIED",
+        "store_disposition": "UNKNOWN",
+        "permitted_operation": "stage-only-after-source-tests-and-exact-plan-review",
+        "selection": "separate-post-staging-manifest-review-required",
+        "activation": "NOT_AUTHORIZED_BY_THIS_PLAN",
+        "unresolved": ["current target/identity collision inventory", "compiler provenance",
+                       "source/test approval and exact staging-plan review"],
+    }
+
+
+def main() -> None:
+    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
+    parser.add_argument("--expected-head", required=True)
+    args = parser.parse_args()
+    try:
+        plan = prepare_source_plan(Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2], args.expected_head)
+    except (ValueError, OSError, subprocess.SubprocessError, tarfile.TarError) as exc:
+        parser.exit(1, "source plan refused: " + str(exc) + "\n")
+    print(json.dumps(plan, sort_keys=True, separators=(",", ":"), ensure_ascii=True))
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    main()

+ * Fixed WSL test helper: vst-runner (997:988) -> vst-worker (999:989).
+ * It does not accept a UID, GID, executable path, environment or shell command.
+ */
+#define _GNU_SOURCE

+#include <errno.h>

+#include <grp.h>

+#ifndef HELPER_BUILD_HEAD
+#error "helper build must bind a committed source HEAD"
+#endif
+#ifndef HELPER_SOURCE_SHA256
+#error "helper build must bind the source digest"
+#endif
+
+extern char **environ;
+
+enum {
+    RUNNER_UID = 997,
+    RUNNER_GID = 988,
+    WORKER_UID = 999,
+    WORKER_GID = 989,
+    MAX_ARGUMENTS = 64,
+    MAX_ARGUMENT_BYTES = 131072,
+};
+
+static const char PYTHON[] = "/usr/bin/python3.12";
+
+static int refuse(const char *message) {
+    (void)dprintf(STDERR_FILENO, "vst-s4-worker-exec: %s\n", message);
+    return 126;
+}
+
+static int valid_invocation(int argc, char *const argv[]) {
+    size_t total = 0;
+    char *end = NULL;
+    long env_fd;
+    long gate_fd;
+
+    if (argc < 7 || argc > MAX_ARGUMENTS || strcmp(argv[1], "-I") != 0 ||
+        strcmp(argv[2], "-c") != 0 || argv[3][0] == '\0') {
+        return 0;
+    }
+    errno = 0;
+    env_fd = strtol(argv[4], &end, 10);
+    if (errno != 0 || end == argv[4] || *end != '\0' || env_fd < 3 || env_fd > INT_MAX) {
+        return 0;
+    }
+    errno = 0;
+    gate_fd = strtol(argv[5], &end, 10);
+    if (errno != 0 || end == argv[5] || *end != '\0' || gate_fd < 3 || gate_fd > INT_MAX ||
+        gate_fd == env_fd) {
+        return 0;
+    }
+    for (int index = 1; index < argc; ++index) {
+        size_t length = strnlen(argv[index], MAX_ARGUMENT_BYTES + 1U);
+        if (length >= MAX_ARGUMENT_BYTES || total > MAX_ARGUMENT_BYTES - length - 1U) {
+            return 0;
+        }
+        total += length + 1U;
+    }
+    return 1;
+}
+
+static int clear_capability_sets(void) {
+    struct __user_cap_header_struct header = {
+        .version = _LINUX_CAPABILITY_VERSION_3,
+        .pid = 0,
+    };
+    struct __user_cap_data_struct capabilities[_LINUX_CAPABILITY_U32S_3] = {{0}};
+
+    if (prctl(PR_CAP_AMBIENT, PR_CAP_AMBIENT_CLEAR_ALL, 0, 0, 0) != 0 ||
+        syscall(SYS_capset, &header, capabilities) != 0) {
+        return 0;
+    }
+    memset(capabilities, 0, sizeof(capabilities));
+    if (syscall(SYS_capget, &header, capabilities) != 0) {
+        return 0;
+    }
+    for (size_t index = 0; index < (size_t)_LINUX_CAPABILITY_U32S_3; ++index) {
+        if (capabilities[index].effective != 0 ||
+            capabilities[index].permitted != 0 ||
+            capabilities[index].inheritable != 0) {
+            return 0;
+        }
+    }
+    return 1;
+}
+
+int main(int argc, char **argv) {
+    uid_t real_uid = (uid_t)-1;
+    uid_t effective_uid = (uid_t)-1;
+    uid_t saved_uid = (uid_t)-1;
+    gid_t real_gid = (gid_t)-1;
+    gid_t effective_gid = (gid_t)-1;
+    gid_t saved_gid = (gid_t)-1;
+    gid_t supplementary[1];
+    int supplementary_count;
+    char **child_argv;
+    int env_source;
+    int gate_source;
+    int env_copy;
+    int gate_copy;
+    struct stat env_stat;
+    struct stat gate_stat;
+
+    if (argc == 2 && strcmp(argv[1], "--version") == 0) {
+        (void)printf("schema=1 head=%s source_sha256=%s\n",
+                     HELPER_BUILD_HEAD, HELPER_SOURCE_SHA256);
+        return 0;
+    }
+    if (!valid_invocation(argc, argv)) {
+        return refuse("usage is fixed: vst-s4-worker-exec -I -c SCRIPT ENV_FD GATE_FD ARG...");
+    }
+    env_source = (int)strtol(argv[4], NULL, 10);
+    gate_source = (int)strtol(argv[5], NULL, 10);
+    if (fstat(env_source, &env_stat) != 0 || fstat(gate_source, &gate_stat) != 0 ||
+        !S_ISFIFO(env_stat.st_mode) || !S_ISFIFO(gate_stat.st_mode) ||
+        env_stat.st_ino == gate_stat.st_ino) {
+        return refuse("environment and release descriptors must be distinct pipes");
+    }
+    if (getresuid(&real_uid, &effective_uid, &saved_uid) != 0 ||
+        getresgid(&real_gid, &effective_gid, &saved_gid) != 0 ||
+        real_uid != RUNNER_UID || real_gid != RUNNER_GID ||
+        effective_uid != 0 || saved_uid != 0 ||
+        effective_gid != RUNNER_GID || saved_gid != RUNNER_GID) {
+        return refuse("caller identity or installed setuid state does not match 997:988");
+    }
+
+    if (setgroups(0, NULL) != 0 ||
+        setresgid(WORKER_GID, WORKER_GID, WORKER_GID) != 0 ||
+        setresuid(WORKER_UID, WORKER_UID, WORKER_UID) != 0 ||
+        !clear_capability_sets() ||
+        prctl(PR_SET_NO_NEW_PRIVS, 1, 0, 0, 0) != 0) {
+        return refuse("could not irreversibly drop to the fixed worker identity and capabilities");
+    }
+    supplementary_count = getgroups(1, supplementary);
+    if (getresuid(&real_uid, &effective_uid, &saved_uid) != 0 ||
+        getresgid(&real_gid, &effective_gid, &saved_gid) != 0 ||
+        real_uid != WORKER_UID ||
+        effective_uid != WORKER_UID || saved_uid != WORKER_UID ||
+        real_gid != WORKER_GID || effective_gid != WORKER_GID ||
+        saved_gid != WORKER_GID || supplementary_count != 0) {
+        return refuse("post-drop identity verification failed");
+    }
+    env_copy = fcntl(env_source, F_DUPFD_CLOEXEC, 5);
+    gate_copy = fcntl(gate_source, F_DUPFD_CLOEXEC, 5);
+    if (env_copy < 0 || gate_copy < 0 || dup2(env_copy, 3) < 0 || dup2(gate_copy, 4) < 0 ||
+        close_range(5U, UINT_MAX, 0U) != 0) {
+        return refuse("could not close inherited file descriptors");
+    }
+
+    if (clearenv() != 0 || setenv("PATH", "/usr/bin:/bin", 1) != 0 ||
+        setenv("HOME", "/nonexistent", 1) != 0 ||
+        setenv("LANG", "C.UTF-8", 1) != 0 ||
+        setenv("LC_ALL", "C.UTF-8", 1) != 0 ||
+        setenv("PYTHONNOUSERSITE", "1", 1) != 0 ||
+        setenv("PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE", "1", 1) != 0 ||
+        setenv("TMPDIR", "/tmp", 1) != 0) {
+        return refuse("could not create the fixed child environment");
+    }
+    (void)umask(0077);
+
+    child_argv = calloc((size_t)argc + 1U, sizeof(*child_argv));
+    if (child_argv == NULL) {
+        return refuse("could not allocate child arguments");
+    }
+    child_argv[0] = (char *)PYTHON;
+    child_argv[1] = argv[1];
+    child_argv[2] = argv[2];
+    child_argv[3] = argv[3];
+    child_argv[4] = "3";
+    child_argv[5] = "4";
+    for (int index = 6; index < argc; ++index) {
+        child_argv[index] = argv[index];
+    }
+    child_argv[argc] = NULL;
+    execve(PYTHON, child_argv, environ);
+    (void)dprintf(STDERR_FILENO, "vst-s4-worker-exec: execve failed: %s\n", strerror(errno));
+    free(child_argv);
+    return 127;
+}

+"""Closed schemas for the read-only authenticated assignment-basis contract.
+
+This module deliberately contains no signing, persistence, or assignment writer.
+"""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import copy
+import hashlib
+import posixpath
+import re
+from datetime import datetime, timezone
+from typing import Any
+
+from .contracts import ContractError, canonical_bytes, manifest_sha256, validate_task_manifest
+
+POLICY_SCHEMA = "VST_S2_ASSIGNMENT_DELEGATION_POLICY_V1"
+HANDOFF_SCHEMA = "VST_S2_AUTHENTICATED_ASSIGNMENT_V1"
+REQUEST_SCHEMA = "VST_S2_ASSIGNMENT_BASIS_REQUEST_V1"
+RESPONSE_SCHEMA = "VST_S2_ASSIGNMENT_BASIS_RESPONSE_V1"
+OPERATION = HANDOFF_SCHEMA
+POLICY_PATH = "/etc/vst-runner/assignment-delegation-policy.json"
+_SHA = re.compile(r"^[0-9a-f]{64}$")
+_HEAD = re.compile(r"^[0-9a-f]{40}$")
+_ID = re.compile(r"^[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9_.:-]{0,127}$")
+_POLICY_FIELDS = {
+    "schema", "policy_id", "repository", "sprint_id", "source_head", "manifest_sha256",
+    "owner_principal", "allowed_assignments", "bootstrap_peer", "issuer_peer",
+    "allowed_bootstrap_operations", "maximum_handoff_ttl_seconds", "valid_from_utc",
+    "expires_at_utc", "revocation_id", "runner_id", "owner_ttl_seconds", "lease_ttl_seconds",
+}
+_ASSIGNMENT_FIELDS = {
+    "story_id", "task_id", "project_id", "phase", "task_manifest_sha256", "test_run_slots",
+}
+_PEER_FIELDS = {"role", "uid", "gid", "cgroup"}
+_HANDOFF_FIELDS = {
+    "schema", "assignment_operation_id", "policy_id", "policy_sha256", "repository",
+    "sprint_id", "source_head", "manifest_sha256", "bootstrap_peer", "assignment_principal",
+    "bootstrap_request", "task_id", "story_id", "project_id", "phase",
+    "task_manifest_sha256", "slot", "attempt",
+    "epoch", "lease_id", "runner_id", "run_id", "service_generation", "probe_sha256", "issued_at_utc",
+    "expires_at_utc", "handoff_sha256",
+}
+_REQUEST_FIELDS = {"schema", "assignment_operation_id"}
+_BOOTSTRAP_REQUEST_FIELDS = {
+    "schema", "request_id", "story_id", "task_id", "task_manifest", "slot", "attempt", "run_id",
+}
+_REQUEST_ID = re.compile(r"^[0-9a-f]{32}$")
+MAX_ASSIGNMENT_TTL_SECONDS = 3600
+_RESPONSE_FIELDS = {
+    "schema", "assignment_operation_id", "handoff_sha256", "policy_id", "policy_sha256",
+    "repository", "sprint_id", "source_head", "manifest_sha256", "task_id", "story_id",
+    "task_manifest_sha256", "slot", "attempt", "epoch", "lease_id", "runner_id", "principal",
+    "run_id", "probe_sha256", "authority_expires_at_utc", "service_generation",
+}
+
+
+def _object(value: Any, fields: set[str], name: str) -> dict:
+    if not isinstance(value, dict) or set(value) != fields:
+        raise ContractError(f"{name} fields do not match the closed schema")
+    return value
+
+
+def _text(value: Any, name: str, *, pattern: re.Pattern[str] | None = None) -> str:
+    if not isinstance(value, str) or not value or value.strip() != value:
+        raise ContractError(f"{name} must be a non-empty canonical string")
+    if pattern is not None and pattern.fullmatch(value) is None:
+        raise ContractError(f"{name} has an invalid format")
+    return value
+
+
+def _integer(value: Any, name: str, minimum: int, maximum: int | None = None) -> int:
+    if type(value) is not int or value < minimum or (maximum is not None and value > maximum):
+        raise ContractError(f"{name} is outside its integer bounds")
+    return value
+
+
+def _utc(value: Any, name: str) -> datetime:
+    text = _text(value, name)
+    try:
+        parsed = datetime.strptime(text, "%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ").replace(tzinfo=timezone.utc)
+    except ValueError as exc:
+        raise ContractError(f"{name} must be canonical UTC") from exc
+    if parsed.strftime("%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ") != text:
+        raise ContractError(f"{name} must be canonical UTC")
+    return parsed
+
+
+def _peer(value: Any, role: str) -> dict:
+    peer = _object(value, _PEER_FIELDS, f"{role} peer")
+    if peer["role"] != role:
+        raise ContractError(f"peer role must be {role}")
+    _integer(peer["uid"], f"{role}.uid", 1)
+    _integer(peer["gid"], f"{role}.gid", 1)
+    _text(peer["cgroup"], f"{role}.cgroup")
+    if (not peer["cgroup"].startswith("/") or ".." in peer["cgroup"].split("/")
+            or posixpath.normpath(peer["cgroup"]) != peer["cgroup"]):
+        raise ContractError(f"{role}.cgroup is not an absolute normalized path")
+    return copy.deepcopy(peer)
+
+
+def validate_policy(value: Any) -> tuple[dict, str]:
+    policy = _object(value, _POLICY_FIELDS, "assignment policy")
+    if policy["schema"] != POLICY_SCHEMA or policy["owner_principal"] != "Codex":
+        raise ContractError("assignment policy schema or owner principal is invalid")
+    _text(policy["policy_id"], "policy_id", pattern=_ID)
+    if policy["repository"] != "Virtual_scrum_team":
+        raise ContractError("assignment policy repository is not fixed")
+    _text(policy["sprint_id"], "sprint_id", pattern=_ID)
+    _text(policy["source_head"], "source_head", pattern=_HEAD)
+    _text(policy["manifest_sha256"], "manifest_sha256", pattern=_SHA)
+    _text(policy["revocation_id"], "revocation_id", pattern=_ID)
+    _text(policy["runner_id"], "runner_id", pattern=_ID)
+    for field in ("owner_ttl_seconds", "lease_ttl_seconds"):
+        ttl = policy[field]
+        if type(ttl) is not int or ttl < 1 or ttl > MAX_ASSIGNMENT_TTL_SECONDS:
+            raise ContractError(f"{field} must be an integer in [1, {MAX_ASSIGNMENT_TTL_SECONDS}]")
+    if policy["lease_ttl_seconds"] > policy["owner_ttl_seconds"]:
+        raise ContractError("lease_ttl_seconds cannot exceed owner_ttl_seconds")
+    assignments = policy["allowed_assignments"]
+    if not isinstance(assignments, list) or not assignments:
+        raise ContractError("assignment policy must contain a non-empty assignment allowlist")
+    seen: set[tuple[str, str]] = set()
+    seen_story_ids: set[str] = set()
+    seen_task_ids: set[str] = set()
+    for entry in assignments:
+        entry = _object(entry, _ASSIGNMENT_FIELDS, "allowed assignment")
+        story = _text(entry["story_id"], "story_id", pattern=_ID)
+        task = _text(entry["task_id"], "task_id", pattern=_ID)
+        _text(entry["project_id"], "project_id", pattern=_ID)
+        _integer(entry["phase"], "phase", 1, 10)
+        _text(entry["task_manifest_sha256"], "task_manifest_sha256", pattern=_SHA)
+        key = (story, task)
+        if key in seen:
+            raise ContractError("assignment policy contains a duplicate story/task pair")
+        if story in seen_story_ids or task in seen_task_ids:
+            raise ContractError("assignment policy reuses a story or task identifier")
+        seen.add(key)
+        seen_story_ids.add(story)
+        seen_task_ids.add(task)
+        slots = entry["test_run_slots"]
+        if (not isinstance(slots, list) or not slots or any(
+                not isinstance(slot, str) or not _ID.fullmatch(slot) for slot in slots)
+                or len(slots) != len(set(slots))):
+            raise ContractError("assignment slots must be unique non-empty TestRun slot names")
+    bootstrap = _peer(policy["bootstrap_peer"], "assignment_bootstrap")
+    issuer = _peer(policy["issuer_peer"], "delegated_issuer")
+    if (bootstrap["uid"] == issuer["uid"] or bootstrap["gid"] == issuer["gid"]
+            or bootstrap["cgroup"] == issuer["cgroup"]):
+        raise ContractError("assignment peers must have distinct process identities")
+    expected_ops = ["open_story", "register_task", "acquire_epoch", "acquire_lease"]
+    if policy["allowed_bootstrap_operations"] != expected_ops:
+        raise ContractError("assignment bootstrap operation set is not fixed")
+    _integer(policy["maximum_handoff_ttl_seconds"], "maximum_handoff_ttl_seconds", 1, 300)
+    valid_from = _utc(policy["valid_from_utc"], "valid_from_utc")
+    expires = _utc(policy["expires_at_utc"], "expires_at_utc")
+    if expires <= valid_from:
+        raise ContractError("assignment policy expiry must follow validity start")
+    digest = hashlib.sha256(canonical_bytes(policy)).hexdigest()
+    return copy.deepcopy(policy), digest
+
+
+def validate_request(value: Any) -> str:
+    request = _object(value, _REQUEST_FIELDS, "assignment-basis request")
+    if request["schema"] != REQUEST_SCHEMA:
+        raise ContractError("assignment-basis request schema is invalid")
+    return _text(request["assignment_operation_id"], "assignment_operation_id", pattern=_SHA)
+
+
+def validate_bootstrap_request(value: Any, *, policy: dict) -> dict:
+    request = _object(value, _BOOTSTRAP_REQUEST_FIELDS, "authenticated bootstrap request")
+    if request["schema"] != "VST_S2_ASSIGNMENT_BOOTSTRAP_REQUEST_V1":
+        raise ContractError("authenticated bootstrap request schema is invalid")
+    _text(request["request_id"], "request_id", pattern=_REQUEST_ID)
+    story_id = _text(request["story_id"], "story_id", pattern=_ID)
+    task_id = _text(request["task_id"], "task_id", pattern=_ID)
+    slot = _text(request["slot"], "slot", pattern=_ID)
+    _integer(request["attempt"], "attempt", 1)
+    if request["attempt"] != 1:
+        raise ContractError("fresh assignment bootstrap only permits attempt 1")
+    run_id = _text(request["run_id"], "run_id", pattern=_ID)
+    manifest = validate_task_manifest(request["task_manifest"])
+    if (manifest["task_id"] != task_id or manifest["story_id"] != story_id
+            or manifest_sha256(manifest) != manifest_sha256(request["task_manifest"])):
+        raise ContractError("bootstrap request task manifest identity or canonical digest is invalid")
+    allowed = [entry for entry in policy["allowed_assignments"]
+               if entry["task_id"] == task_id and entry["story_id"] == story_id]
+    if len(allowed) != 1 or allowed[0]["task_manifest_sha256"] != manifest_sha256(manifest):
+        raise ContractError("bootstrap request task is outside the root assignment allowlist")
+    if manifest["project_id"] != allowed[0]["project_id"] or manifest["phase"] != allowed[0]["phase"]:
+        raise ContractError("bootstrap request project or phase differs from root assignment")
+    test_run_slots = {
+        entry["slot"] for entry in manifest["required_receipts"]
+        if entry["receipt_type"] == "TestRun"
+    }
+    if slot not in test_run_slots or slot not in allowed[0]["test_run_slots"]:
+        raise ContractError("bootstrap request slot is outside the root TestRun assignment allowlist")
+    return {
+        "schema": request["schema"], "request_id": request["request_id"],
+        "story_id": story_id, "task_id": task_id, "task_manifest": manifest,
+        "slot": slot, "attempt": request["attempt"], "run_id": run_id,
+    }
+
+
+def assignment_operation_id(request: dict, *, policy_sha256: str) -> str:
+    identity = {
+        "policy_sha256": policy_sha256, "task_id": request["task_id"],
+        "story_id": request["story_id"],
+        "task_manifest_sha256": manifest_sha256(request["task_manifest"]),
+        "request_id": request["request_id"],
+    }
+    domain = b"VST_S2_AUTHENTICATED_ASSIGNMENT_V1\0"
+    return hashlib.sha256(domain + canonical_bytes(identity)).hexdigest()
+
+
+def assignment_payload_sha256(request: dict, *, policy: dict, policy_sha256: str) -> str:
+    payload = {
+        "request": request, "bootstrap_peer": policy["bootstrap_peer"],
+        "policy_sha256": policy_sha256,
+    }
+    return hashlib.sha256(canonical_bytes(payload)).hexdigest()
+
+
+def validate_handoff(value: Any, *, policy: dict, policy_sha256: str, now: datetime) -> dict:
+    handoff = _object(value, _HANDOFF_FIELDS, "assignment handoff")
+    if handoff["schema"] != HANDOFF_SCHEMA:
+        raise ContractError("assignment handoff schema is invalid")
+    for field in ("assignment_operation_id", "policy_sha256", "manifest_sha256",
+                  "task_manifest_sha256", "probe_sha256", "handoff_sha256"):
+        _text(handoff[field], field, pattern=_SHA)
+    if handoff["policy_sha256"] != policy_sha256:
+        raise ContractError("assignment handoff policy digest differs from root policy")
+    fixed = ("policy_id", "repository", "sprint_id", "source_head", "manifest_sha256")
+    if any(handoff[field] != policy[field] for field in fixed):
+        raise ContractError("assignment handoff differs from root policy identity")
+    if handoff["assignment_principal"] != policy["owner_principal"]:
+        raise ContractError("assignment handoff principal differs from root policy")
+    bootstrap = _peer(handoff["bootstrap_peer"], "assignment_bootstrap")
+    if bootstrap != policy["bootstrap_peer"]:
+        raise ContractError("assignment handoff bootstrap peer differs from root policy")
+    bootstrap_request = validate_bootstrap_request(handoff["bootstrap_request"], policy=policy)
+    _text(handoff["task_id"], "task_id", pattern=_ID)
+    _text(handoff["story_id"], "story_id", pattern=_ID)
+    _text(handoff["project_id"], "project_id", pattern=_ID)
+    _integer(handoff["phase"], "phase", 1, 10)
+    _text(handoff["slot"], "slot", pattern=_ID)
+    _text(handoff["runner_id"], "runner_id", pattern=_ID)
+    _text(handoff["run_id"], "run_id", pattern=_ID)
+    _text(handoff["service_generation"], "service_generation", pattern=_ID)
+    _integer(handoff["attempt"], "attempt", 1)
+    _integer(handoff["epoch"], "epoch", 1)
+    _integer(handoff["lease_id"], "lease_id", 1)
+    if (bootstrap_request["task_id"] != handoff["task_id"]
+            or bootstrap_request["story_id"] != handoff["story_id"]
+            or bootstrap_request["task_manifest"]["project_id"] != handoff["project_id"]
+            or bootstrap_request["task_manifest"]["phase"] != handoff["phase"]
+            or handoff["runner_id"] != policy["runner_id"]
+            or manifest_sha256(bootstrap_request["task_manifest"]) != handoff["task_manifest_sha256"]
+            or bootstrap_request["slot"] != handoff["slot"]
+            or bootstrap_request["attempt"] != handoff["attempt"]
+            or bootstrap_request["run_id"] != handoff["run_id"]
+            or assignment_operation_id(bootstrap_request, policy_sha256=policy_sha256)
+            != handoff["assignment_operation_id"]):
+        raise ContractError("assignment handoff differs from its canonical bootstrap request identity")
+    allowed = [entry for entry in policy["allowed_assignments"]
+               if entry["task_id"] == handoff["task_id"] and entry["story_id"] == handoff["story_id"]]
+    if (len(allowed) != 1 or allowed[0]["task_manifest_sha256"] != handoff["task_manifest_sha256"]
+            or allowed[0]["project_id"] != handoff["project_id"]
+            or allowed[0]["phase"] != handoff["phase"]):
+        raise ContractError("assignment handoff is outside the root assignment allowlist")
+    if handoff["slot"] not in allowed[0]["test_run_slots"]:
+        raise ContractError("assignment handoff slot is outside the root assignment allowlist")
+    issued = _utc(handoff["issued_at_utc"], "issued_at_utc")
+    expires = _utc(handoff["expires_at_utc"], "expires_at_utc")
+    if (expires <= issued or issued > now or expires <= now
+            or (expires - issued).total_seconds() > policy["maximum_handoff_ttl_seconds"]
+            or issued < _utc(policy["valid_from_utc"], "valid_from_utc")
+            or expires > _utc(policy["expires_at_utc"], "expires_at_utc")):
+        raise ContractError("assignment handoff is expired or outside policy validity")
+    body = {key: item for key, item in handoff.items() if key != "handoff_sha256"}
+    if hashlib.sha256(canonical_bytes(body)).hexdigest() != handoff["handoff_sha256"]:
+        raise ContractError("assignment handoff digest is invalid")
+    return {
+        **copy.deepcopy(handoff),
+        "bootstrap_request": bootstrap_request,
+        "payload_sha256": assignment_payload_sha256(
+            bootstrap_request, policy=policy, policy_sha256=policy_sha256,
+        ),
+    }
+
+
+def build_response(handoff: dict, *, policy: dict, policy_sha256: str, authority_expires_at: float,
+                   service_generation: str) -> dict:
+    expires = datetime.fromtimestamp(authority_expires_at, timezone.utc).replace(microsecond=0)
+    result = {
+        "schema": RESPONSE_SCHEMA,
+        "assignment_operation_id": handoff["assignment_operation_id"],
+        "handoff_sha256": handoff["handoff_sha256"],
+        "policy_id": policy["policy_id"], "policy_sha256": policy_sha256,
+        "repository": policy["repository"], "sprint_id": policy["sprint_id"],
+        "source_head": policy["source_head"], "manifest_sha256": policy["manifest_sha256"],
+        "task_id": handoff["task_id"], "story_id": handoff["story_id"],
+        "task_manifest_sha256": handoff["task_manifest_sha256"], "slot": handoff["slot"],
+        "attempt": handoff["attempt"], "epoch": handoff["epoch"], "lease_id": handoff["lease_id"],
+        "runner_id": handoff["runner_id"], "principal": policy["owner_principal"],
+        "run_id": handoff["run_id"], "probe_sha256": handoff["probe_sha256"],
+        "authority_expires_at_utc": expires.strftime("%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ"),
+        "service_generation": _text(service_generation, "service_generation"),
+    }
+    _object(result, _RESPONSE_FIELDS, "assignment-basis response")
+    if expires.strftime("%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ") > handoff["expires_at_utc"]:
+        raise ContractError("assignment-basis response exceeds handoff expiry")
+    return validate_response(result, policy=policy, policy_sha256=policy_sha256, handoff=handoff)
+
+
+def validate_response(value: Any, *, policy: dict, policy_sha256: str, handoff: dict) -> dict:
+    response = _object(value, _RESPONSE_FIELDS, "assignment-basis response")
+    if response["schema"] != RESPONSE_SCHEMA:
+        raise ContractError("assignment-basis response schema is invalid")
+    for field in ("assignment_operation_id", "handoff_sha256", "policy_sha256",
+                  "manifest_sha256", "task_manifest_sha256", "probe_sha256"):
+        _text(response[field], field, pattern=_SHA)
+    expected = {
+        "assignment_operation_id": handoff["assignment_operation_id"],
+        "handoff_sha256": handoff["handoff_sha256"], "policy_id": policy["policy_id"],
+        "policy_sha256": policy_sha256, "repository": policy["repository"],
+        "sprint_id": policy["sprint_id"], "source_head": policy["source_head"],
+        "manifest_sha256": policy["manifest_sha256"], "task_id": handoff["task_id"],
+        "story_id": handoff["story_id"], "task_manifest_sha256": handoff["task_manifest_sha256"],
+        "slot": handoff["slot"], "attempt": handoff["attempt"], "epoch": handoff["epoch"],
+        "lease_id": handoff["lease_id"], "runner_id": handoff["runner_id"],
+        "principal": policy["owner_principal"], "run_id": handoff["run_id"],
+        "probe_sha256": handoff["probe_sha256"],
+    }
+    if any(response[key] != item for key, item in expected.items()):
+        raise ContractError("assignment-basis response differs from its verified inputs")
+    for field in ("task_id", "story_id", "slot", "runner_id", "principal", "run_id",
+                  "service_generation"):
+        _text(response[field], field, pattern=_ID if field != "principal" else None)
+    for field in ("attempt", "epoch", "lease_id"):
+        _integer(response[field], field, 1)
+    authority_expiry = _utc(response["authority_expires_at_utc"], "authority_expires_at_utc")
+    if authority_expiry > _utc(handoff["expires_at_utc"], "expires_at_utc"):
+        raise ContractError("assignment-basis response exceeds handoff expiry")
+    return copy.deepcopy(response)

+#!/usr/bin/env python3.12
+"""Select or recover one reviewed S2 runtime on a pristine bootstrap host.
+
+This root-only command never starts/reloads units and never opens the Store.
+Its manifest digest is an external review pin, not a signature or self-approval.
+"""
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import argparse
+import contextlib
+import ctypes
+import hashlib
+import json
+import os
+import re
+import secrets
+import stat
+import subprocess
+import sys
+from typing import Any
+
+from .contracts import ContractError, canonical_bytes
+from .runtime_bundle import (
+    HELPER_BASE, PARENTS, RUNTIME_LINK, SCHEMA, UNIT_DIR, UNITS,
+    build_manifest, load_canonical_manifest, manifest_sha256, tree_sha256,
+)
