+"""Candidate S2 machine-delegation contracts.
+
+This module verifies candidate external records against a separately supplied trusted
+configuration. It cannot create authority, issue instructions, or modify a Store.
+The authority purpose and trust configuration are not currently provisioned.
+"""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import base64
+import datetime as dt
+import hashlib
+import json
+import os
+import re
+import stat
+from collections.abc import Mapping
+from typing import Any
+
+from .contracts import ContractError, canonical_bytes
+from .execution_grant import _openssl_signature, _trusted_root_file
+
+TRUST_CONFIG_PATH = "/etc/vst-runner/machine-delegation-trust.json"
+POLICY_SCHEMA = "VST_S2_MACHINE_DELEGATION_POLICY_V1"
+POLICY_PURPOSE = "VST_S2_MACHINE_DELEGATION_POLICY_V1"
+ASSIGNMENT_SCHEMA = "VST_S2_ASSIGNMENT_AUTHORIZATION_V1"
+ASSIGNMENT_PURPOSE = "VST_S2_ASSIGNMENT_AUTHORIZATION_V1"
+TRUST_SCHEMA = "VST_S2_MACHINE_DELEGATION_TRUST_CONFIG_V1"
+ISSUER_PURPOSE = "VST_S2_DELEGATED_DISPATCH_ISSUER_V1"
+_HEX40 = re.compile(r"^[0-9a-f]{40}$")
+_HEX64 = re.compile(r"^[0-9a-f]{64}$")
+_ID = re.compile(r"^[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9_.:-]{0,127}$")
+_NONCE = re.compile(r"^[0-9a-f]{32}$")
+_SIGNATURE = re.compile(r"^[A-Za-z0-9_-]{86}$")
+
+POLICY_FIELDS = frozenset({
+    "schema", "operator_key_id", "policy_id", "project", "repository", "sprint_id", "role",
+    "machine_principal", "machine_key_id", "key_purpose", "source_head",
+    "manifest_sha256", "allowed_authorization_type", "not_before", "expires_at",
+    "revocation_id", "signature",
+})
+ASSIGNMENT_FIELDS = frozenset({
+    "schema", "authorization_id", "project", "repository", "sprint_id",
+    "manifest_sha256", "task_id", "story_id", "principal", "slot", "attempt",
+    "epoch", "lease_id", "run_id", "request_id", "policy_id", "policy_sha256",
+    "authorization_key_id", "issuer_key_id", "issuer_key_purpose", "issued_at", "expires_at",
+    "revocation_id", "signature",
+})
+TRUST_FIELDS = frozenset({"schema", "operator_authorities", "machine_principals", "revocations"})
+AUTHORITY_FIELDS = frozenset({"key_id", "purpose", "public_key_path", "revocation_id"})
+MACHINE_FIELDS = frozenset({
+    "principal", "key_id", "purpose", "public_key_path", "policy_sha256",
+    "not_before", "expires_at", "revocation_id",
+})
+REVOCATION_FIELDS = frozenset({"revocation_id", "revoked_at", "reason_code"})
+
+
+def _exact_object(value: object, fields: frozenset[str], name: str) -> dict[str, Any]:
+    if not isinstance(value, dict) or set(value) != fields:
+        raise ContractError(f"{name}: fields do not match the closed contract")
+    return value
+
+
+def _identifier(value: object, name: str) -> str:
+    if not isinstance(value, str) or not _ID.fullmatch(value):
+        raise ContractError(f"{name}: invalid identifier")
+    return value
+
+
+def _digest(value: object, name: str) -> str:
+    if not isinstance(value, str) or not _HEX64.fullmatch(value):
+        raise ContractError(f"{name}: expected lowercase SHA-256")
+    return value
+
+
+def _utc(value: object, name: str) -> dt.datetime:
+    if not isinstance(value, str):
+        raise ContractError(f"{name}: expected canonical UTC timestamp")
+    try:
+        parsed = dt.datetime.strptime(value, "%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ").replace(tzinfo=dt.timezone.utc)
+    except ValueError as exc:
+        raise ContractError(f"{name}: expected canonical YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ") from exc
+    if parsed.strftime("%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ") != value:
+        raise ContractError(f"{name}: timestamp is not canonical")
+    return parsed
+
+
+def parse_json_object(raw: bytes, *, name: str, maximum_bytes: int = 1024 * 1024) -> dict[str, Any]:
+    """Parse bounded UTF-8 JSON, rejecting duplicate keys and non-object roots."""
+    if not isinstance(raw, bytes) or len(raw) > maximum_bytes:
+        raise ContractError(f"{name}: input is not bytes or exceeds the size limit")
+
+    def unique_pairs(pairs: list[tuple[str, Any]]) -> dict[str, Any]:
+        result: dict[str, Any] = {}
+        for key, value in pairs:
+            if key in result:
+                raise ContractError(f"{name}: duplicate JSON field")
+            result[key] = value
+        return result
+
+    try:
+        value = json.loads(raw.decode("utf-8", errors="strict"), object_pairs_hook=unique_pairs,
+                           parse_constant=lambda _value: (_ for _ in ()).throw(
+                               ContractError(f"{name}: non-finite JSON number")))
+    except (UnicodeError, json.JSONDecodeError) as exc:
+        raise ContractError(f"{name}: invalid UTF-8 JSON") from exc
+    if not isinstance(value, dict):
+        raise ContractError(f"{name}: JSON root must be an object")
+    return value
+
+
+def validate_delegation_policy(value: object, *, now: dt.datetime | None = None) -> dict[str, Any]:
+    policy = _exact_object(value, POLICY_FIELDS, "delegation policy")
+    if policy["schema"] != POLICY_SCHEMA:
+        raise ContractError("delegation policy: unsupported schema")
+    for field in ("operator_key_id", "policy_id", "project", "sprint_id", "role", "machine_principal",
+                  "machine_key_id", "key_purpose", "revocation_id"):
+        _identifier(policy[field], f"delegation policy {field}")
+    if not isinstance(policy["repository"], str) or not policy["repository"].startswith("https://"):
+        raise ContractError("delegation policy repository: expected an HTTPS repository identity")
+    if policy["allowed_authorization_type"] != ASSIGNMENT_SCHEMA:
+        raise ContractError("delegation policy: unsupported authorization type")
+    if (policy["role"] != "dispatch-issuer"
+            or policy["key_purpose"] != ISSUER_PURPOSE):
+        raise ContractError("delegation policy: role and machine key purpose do not match")
+    if not isinstance(policy["source_head"], str) or not _HEX40.fullmatch(policy["source_head"]):
+        raise ContractError("delegation policy source_head: expected full lowercase Git SHA")
+    _digest(policy["manifest_sha256"], "delegation policy manifest_sha256")
+    not_before = _utc(policy["not_before"], "delegation policy not_before")
+    expires_at = _utc(policy["expires_at"], "delegation policy expires_at")
+    if expires_at <= not_before:
+        raise ContractError("delegation policy: expiry must follow not_before")
+    current = now or dt.datetime.now(dt.timezone.utc)
+    if current.tzinfo is None or current.utcoffset() != dt.timedelta(0):
+        raise ContractError("delegation policy verifier clock must be UTC")
+    if current < not_before or current >= expires_at:
+        raise ContractError("delegation policy: outside its validity window")
+    _signature_bytes(policy["signature"], "delegation policy signature")
+    return value
+
+
+def validate_assignment_authorization(value: object, *, now: dt.datetime | None = None) -> dict[str, Any]:
+    authorization = [REDACTED], ASSIGNMENT_FIELDS, "assignment authorization")
+    if authorization["schema"] != ASSIGNMENT_SCHEMA:
+        raise ContractError("assignment authorization: unsupported schema")
+    for field in ("authorization_id", "project", "sprint_id", "task_id", "story_id",
+                  "principal", "slot", "lease_id", "run_id", "policy_id",
+                  "authorization_key_id", "issuer_key_id", "issuer_key_purpose", "revocation_id"):
+        _identifier(authorization[field], f"assignment authorization {field}")
+    if not isinstance(authorization["repository"], str) or not authorization["repository"].startswith("https://"):
+        raise ContractError("assignment authorization repository: expected HTTPS identity")
+    if authorization["principal"] != "Codex":
+        raise ContractError("assignment authorization principal is not Codex")
+    if authorization["issuer_key_purpose"] != ISSUER_PURPOSE:
+        raise ContractError("assignment authorization issuer purpose is invalid")
+    for field in ("manifest_sha256", "policy_sha256"):
+        _digest(authorization[field], f"assignment authorization {field}")
+    for field in ("attempt", "epoch"):
+        if type(authorization[field]) is not int or not 1 <= authorization[field] <= 2**63 - 1:
+            raise ContractError(f"assignment authorization {field}: invalid positive integer")
+    if not isinstance(authorization["request_id"], str) or not _NONCE.fullmatch(authorization["request_id"]):
+        raise ContractError("assignment authorization request_id: expected 32 lowercase hex characters")
+    issued = _utc(authorization["issued_at"], "assignment authorization issued_at")
+    expires = _utc(authorization["expires_at"], "assignment authorization expires_at")
+    current = now or dt.datetime.now(dt.timezone.utc)
+    if current.tzinfo is None or current.utcoffset() != dt.timedelta(0):
+        raise ContractError("assignment authorization verifier clock must be UTC")
+    if issued > current or expires <= current or expires <= issued:
+        raise ContractError("assignment authorization is not currently valid")
+    _signature_bytes(authorization["signature"], "assignment authorization signature")
+    return value
+
+
+def _signature_bytes(value: object, name: str) -> bytes:
+    if not isinstance(value, str) or not _SIGNATURE.fullmatch(value):
+        raise ContractError(f"{name}: malformed Ed25519 signature")
+    try:
+        decoded = base64.urlsafe_b64decode(value + "==")
+    except (ValueError, base64.binascii.Error) as exc:
+        raise ContractError(f"{name}: malformed Ed25519 signature") from exc
+    if len(decoded) != 64 or base64.urlsafe_b64encode(decoded).decode("ascii").rstrip("=") != value:
+        raise ContractError(f"{name}: malformed Ed25519 signature")
+    return decoded
+
+
+def signing_bytes(value: Mapping[str, Any], *, domain: str, signature_field: str = "signature") -> bytes:
+    if not isinstance(value, Mapping) or signature_field not in value:
+        raise ContractError("signed object: missing signature")
+    unsigned = dict(value)
+    del unsigned[signature_field]
+    return domain.encode("ascii") + b"\0" + canonical_bytes(unsigned)
+
+
+def validate_trust_config(value: object, *, now: dt.datetime | None = None) -> dict[str, Any]:
+    config = _exact_object(value, TRUST_FIELDS, "machine delegation trust config")
+    if config["schema"] != TRUST_SCHEMA:
+        raise ContractError("machine delegation trust config: unsupported schema")
+    if not all(isinstance(config[field], list) for field in ("operator_authorities", "machine_principals", "revocations")):
+        raise ContractError("machine delegation trust config: registries must be arrays")
+    operator_ids: set[str] = set()
+    operator_purposes: set[str] = set()
+    for entry in config["operator_authorities"]:
+        _exact_object(entry, AUTHORITY_FIELDS, "operator authority")
+        key_id = _identifier(entry["key_id"], "operator authority key_id")
+        if (not isinstance(entry["purpose"], str)
+                or entry["purpose"] not in {POLICY_PURPOSE, ASSIGNMENT_PURPOSE}):
+            raise ContractError("operator authority: purpose is not allowed")
+        _identifier(entry["revocation_id"], "operator authority revocation_id")
+        if not isinstance(entry["public_key_path"], str) or not os.path.isabs(entry["public_key_path"]):
+            raise ContractError("operator authority: public key path must be absolute")
+        if key_id in operator_ids or entry["purpose"] in operator_purposes:
+            raise ContractError("operator authority: key IDs and signing purposes must be unique")
+        operator_ids.add(key_id)
+        operator_purposes.add(entry["purpose"])
+    machine_ids: set[str] = set()
+    for entry in config["machine_principals"]:
+        _exact_object(entry, MACHINE_FIELDS, "machine principal")
+        key_id = _identifier(entry["key_id"], "machine principal key_id")
+        if key_id in machine_ids or entry["purpose"] != ISSUER_PURPOSE:
+            raise ContractError("machine principal: duplicate key or unsupported purpose")
+        if not isinstance(entry["principal"], str) or not _ID.fullmatch(entry["principal"]):
+            raise ContractError("machine principal: invalid principal")
+        if not isinstance(entry["public_key_path"], str) or not os.path.isabs(entry["public_key_path"]):
+            raise ContractError("machine principal: public key path must be absolute")
+        _digest(entry["policy_sha256"], "machine principal policy_sha256")
+        start = _utc(entry["not_before"], "machine principal not_before")
+        end = _utc(entry["expires_at"], "machine principal expires_at")
+        if end <= start:
+            raise ContractError("machine principal validity window is empty")
+        _identifier(entry["revocation_id"], "machine principal revocation_id")
+        machine_ids.add(key_id)
+    revocations: set[str] = set()
+    for entry in config["revocations"]:
+        _exact_object(entry, REVOCATION_FIELDS, "revocation")
+        revocation_id = _identifier(entry["revocation_id"], "revocation_id")
+        _utc(entry["revoked_at"], "revoked_at")
+        _identifier(entry["reason_code"], "revocation reason_code")
+        if revocation_id in revocations:
+            raise ContractError("machine delegation trust config: duplicate revocation")
+        revocations.add(revocation_id)
+    return value
+
+
+def load_trust_config(path: str = TRUST_CONFIG_PATH) -> dict[str, Any]:
+    """Load the proposed trust config only from a root-controlled no-follow file."""
+    _trusted_root_file(path, private=False)
+    fd = os.open(path, os.O_RDONLY | os.O_NOFOLLOW)
+    try:
+        info = os.fstat(fd)
+        if stat.S_IMODE(info.st_mode) & 0o022:
+            raise ContractError("machine delegation trust config is group/world writable")
+        with os.fdopen(fd, "rb", closefd=False) as stream:
+            raw = stream.read(1024 * 1024 + 1)
+    finally:
+        os.close(fd)
+    config = parse_json_object(raw, name="machine delegation trust config")
+    validate_trust_config(config)
+    return config
+
+
+def _trusted_key(config: Mapping[str, Any], *, key_id: str, purpose: str,
+                 now: dt.datetime) -> str:
+    revoked = {entry["revocation_id"] for entry in config["revocations"]}
+    if purpose in {POLICY_PURPOSE, ASSIGNMENT_PURPOSE}:
+        matches = [item for item in config["operator_authorities"]
+                   if item["key_id"] == key_id and item["purpose"] == purpose]
+    elif purpose == ISSUER_PURPOSE:
+        matches = [item for item in config["machine_principals"]
+                   if item["key_id"] == key_id and item["purpose"] == purpose
+                   and _utc(item["not_before"], "machine not_before") <= now < _utc(item["expires_at"], "machine expires_at")]
+    else:
+        raise ContractError("machine authorization: unsupported signature purpose")
+    if len(matches) != 1:
+        raise ContractError("machine authorization: key is not uniquely trusted for purpose")
+    entry = matches[0]
+    if entry.get("revocation_id") in revoked:
+        raise ContractError("machine authorization: signing key is revoked")
+    path = entry["public_key_path"]
+    _trusted_root_file(path, private=False)
+    return path
+
+
+def _verify_ed25519(value: Mapping[str, Any], *, key_path: str, purpose: str,
+                    openssl_path: str) -> None:
+    signature = _signature_bytes(value["signature"], f"{purpose} signature")
+    valid = _openssl_signature(openssl_path, key_path=key_path,
+                               payload=signing_bytes(value, domain=purpose),
+                               signature=signature, private=False)
+    if valid is not True:
+        raise ContractError(f"{purpose}: signature verification failed")
+
+
+def verify_policy(policy: object, trust_config: Mapping[str, Any], *,
+                  openssl_path: str, now: dt.datetime | None = None) -> dict[str, Any]:
+    current = now or dt.datetime.now(dt.timezone.utc)
+    checked = validate_delegation_policy(policy, now=current)
+    config = validate_trust_config(trust_config, now=current)
+    key_path = _trusted_key(config, key_id=checked["operator_key_id"],
+                            purpose=POLICY_PURPOSE, now=current)
+    _verify_ed25519(checked, key_path=key_path, purpose=POLICY_PURPOSE,
+                    openssl_path=openssl_path)
+    policy_digest = hashlib.sha256(canonical_bytes(checked)).hexdigest()
+    machine = [item for item in config["machine_principals"]
+               if item["key_id"] == checked["machine_key_id"]
+               and item["principal"] == checked["machine_principal"]
+               and item["purpose"] == checked["key_purpose"]
+               and item["policy_sha256"] == policy_digest]
+    if len(machine) != 1:
+        raise ContractError("delegation policy does not match one configured machine principal")
+    if not (_utc(machine[0]["not_before"], "machine not_before") <= current
+            < _utc(machine[0]["expires_at"], "machine expires_at")):
+        raise ContractError("delegation policy machine principal is outside its validity window")
+    if (checked["revocation_id"] in {entry["revocation_id"] for entry in config["revocations"]}
+            or machine[0]["revocation_id"] in {entry["revocation_id"] for entry in config["revocations"]}):
+        raise ContractError("delegation policy machine key is revoked")
+    return {"policy": dict(checked), "policy_sha256": policy_digest,
+            "machine_principal": dict(machine[0])}
+
+
+def verify_assignment_authorization(
+    authorization: object, policy: object, trust_config: Mapping[str, Any],
+    store_snapshot: Mapping[str, Any], *,
+    openssl_path: str, expected_project: str, expected_repository: str,
+    expected_sprint_id: str, expected_manifest_sha256: str, expected_source_head: str,
+    now: dt.datetime | None = None,
+) -> dict[str, Any]:
+    """Verify a new external assignment record and compare it with one read-only Store snapshot.
+
+    `store_snapshot` is a caller-provided authenticated read result. This function performs no
+    Store I/O, mutation, task enumeration, signing, or dispatch.
+    """
+    current = now or dt.datetime.now(dt.timezone.utc)
+    record = validate_assignment_authorization(authorization, now=current)
+    config = validate_trust_config(trust_config, now=current)
+    verified_policy = verify_policy(policy, config, openssl_path=openssl_path, now=current)
+    policy_record = verified_policy["policy"]
+    for field in ("policy_id", "project", "repository", "sprint_id", "manifest_sha256",
+                  "machine_key_id", "key_purpose"):
+        assignment_field = "issuer_key_id" if field == "machine_key_id" else (
+            "issuer_key_purpose" if field == "key_purpose" else field)
+        if record[assignment_field] != policy_record[field]:
+            raise ContractError("assignment authorization does not match its signed delegation policy")
+    if (policy_record["source_head"] != expected_source_head
+            or verified_policy["policy_sha256"] != record["policy_sha256"]):
+        raise ContractError("assignment authorization source or policy digest is stale")
+    revoked = {entry["revocation_id"] for entry in config["revocations"]}
+    if record["revocation_id"] in revoked:
+        raise ContractError("assignment authorization is revoked")
+    key_path = _trusted_key(config, key_id=record["authorization_key_id"],
+                            purpose=ASSIGNMENT_PURPOSE, now=current)
+    _verify_ed25519(record, key_path=key_path, purpose=ASSIGNMENT_PURPOSE,
+                    openssl_path=openssl_path)
+    machine = [item for item in config["machine_principals"]
+               if item["key_id"] == record["issuer_key_id"]
+               and item["purpose"] == record["issuer_key_purpose"]
+               and item["policy_sha256"] == record["policy_sha256"]]
+    if len(machine) != 1:
+        raise ContractError("assignment authorization does not bind one trusted issuer policy")
+    if machine[0]["revocation_id"] in revoked:
+        raise ContractError("assignment authorization issuer policy is revoked")
+    if not isinstance(store_snapshot, Mapping):
+        raise ContractError("Store assignment snapshot must be an authenticated mapping")
+    expected = {
+        "project": expected_project, "repository": expected_repository,
+        "sprint_id": expected_sprint_id, "manifest_sha256": expected_manifest_sha256,
+        "source_head": expected_source_head,
+    }
+    expected.update({key: record[key] for key in (
+        "task_id", "story_id", "principal", "slot", "attempt", "epoch", "lease_id", "run_id",
+    )})
+    if any(record[key] != value for key, value in expected.items() if key in record):
+        raise ContractError("assignment authorization does not match the expected project scope")
+    snapshot_fields = {
+        "task_id": "task_id", "story_id": "story_id", "principal": "owner_principal",
+        "slot": "slot", "attempt": "attempt", "epoch": "owner_epoch", "lease_id": "lease_id",
+        "run_id": "run_id", "manifest_sha256": "manifest_sha256",
+    }
+    for record_field, snapshot_field in snapshot_fields.items():
+        if store_snapshot.get(snapshot_field) != record[record_field]:
+            raise ContractError("assignment authorization does not match current Store snapshot")
+    if store_snapshot.get("assignment_state") != "ASSIGNED" or store_snapshot.get("lease_state") != "LIVE":
+        raise ContractError("Store snapshot does not show one assigned task with a live lease")
+    return {"authorization": [REDACTED],
+            "authorization_sha256": [REDACTED],
+            "snapshot_match": True}

+"""Read-only S2 machine-observation candidates.
+
+The records produced here are observations, not E5 attestations. This module never signs, returns
+PASS, or integrates with the Supervisor's human E5 verifier. Full effective firewall-policy
+normalization is deliberately unsupported until its collectors and policy are reviewed.
+"""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import datetime as dt
+import hashlib
+import json
+import os
+import platform
+import re
+import subprocess
+import threading
+import time
+import uuid
+from pathlib import Path
+from typing import Any
+
+from .contracts import ContractError, canonical_bytes
+
+BUNDLE_SCHEMA = "VST_S2_MACHINE_NETWORK_OBSERVATION_BUNDLE_V1"
+RECEIPT_SCHEMA = "VST_S2_MACHINE_OBSERVATION_RECEIPT_V1"
+EVALUATION_SCHEMA = "VST_S2_MACHINE_NETWORK_EVALUATION_V1"
+MAX_COMMAND_OUTPUT = 1024 * 1024
+COMMAND_TIMEOUT_SECONDS = 5
+MAX_TOTAL_OUTPUT = 4 * 1024 * 1024
+_HEX40 = re.compile(r"^[0-9a-f]{40}$")
+_HEX64 = re.compile(r"^[0-9a-f]{64}$")
+_NONCE = re.compile(r"^[0-9a-f]{32}$")
+_UTC = "%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ"
+
+BUNDLE_FIELDS = frozenset({
+    "schema", "run_id", "nonce", "source_head", "sandbox_spec_sha256", "started_at_utc",
+    "finished_at_utc", "sources", "raw_observations", "bundle_sha256",
+})
+RECEIPT_FIELDS = frozenset({
+    "schema", "source_id", "collector_path", "collector_head", "collector_sha256", "os_id",
+    "os_build", "principal", "privilege_boundary", "observation_schema", "collected_at_utc",
+    "raw_sha256", "signature",
+})
+WINDOWS_FIELDS = frozenset({
+    "os_id", "os_build", "firewall_profiles", "effective_firewall_rules",
+    "wsl_hyperv_firewall_profiles", "effective_wsl_hyperv_firewall_rules", "wsl_distributions",
+    "wsl_network_configuration", "host_endpoints", "host_path_exposures", "collection_complete",
+    "errors", "raw_command_outputs",
+})
+WSL_FIELDS = frozenset({
+    "os_id", "os_build", "kernel_release", "nft_ruleset_raw", "ipv4_routes_raw",
+    "ipv6_routes_raw", "ipv4_rules_raw", "ipv6_rules_raw", "namespaces_raw", "interfaces_raw",
+    "mounts_raw", "windows_drive_mounts", "wsl_interop_present", "wsl_interop_enabled",
+    "container_socket_paths", "container_socket_inventory_complete", "listeners_raw", "uid", "gid",
+    "collection_complete", "errors",
+})

+def _time(value: object, name: str) -> dt.datetime:
+    if not isinstance(value, str):
+        raise ContractError(f"{name}: expected canonical UTC timestamp")
+    try:
+        parsed = dt.datetime.strptime(value, _UTC).replace(tzinfo=dt.timezone.utc)
+    except ValueError as exc:
+        raise ContractError(f"{name}: expected canonical YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ") from exc
+    if parsed.strftime(_UTC) != value:
+        raise ContractError(f"{name}: timestamp is not canonical")
+    return parsed
+
+
+def _source_sha256() -> str:
+    return hashlib.sha256(Path(__file__).read_bytes()).hexdigest()
+
+
+def _run_fixed(argv: tuple[str, ...], *, name: str,
+               windows_module_path: str | None = None) -> tuple[str, dict[str, Any] | None]:
+    """Run a constant argv with no shell and bounded time/output."""
+    if not argv or not os.path.isabs(argv[0]):
+        return "", {"command": name, "status": "UNSUPPORTED", "reason": "fixed executable unavailable"}
+    try:
+        windows = os.name == "nt"
+        process = subprocess.Popen(
+            list(argv), stdin=subprocess.DEVNULL, stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.PIPE,
+            cwd=(r"C:\Windows\System32" if windows and windows_module_path is not None else "/"),
+            env=({"SystemRoot": r"C:\Windows", "WINDIR": r"C:\Windows",
+                  "SystemDrive": "C:", "PATH": "", "TEMP": r"C:\Windows\Temp",
+                  "TMP": r"C:\Windows\Temp", "PSModulePath": windows_module_path}
+                 if windows and windows_module_path is not None
+                 else {"LC_ALL": "C", "PATH": ""}),
+            close_fds=True, creationflags=(subprocess.CREATE_NO_WINDOW if windows else 0),
+        )
+    except OSError:
+        return "", {"command": name, "status": "UNKNOWN", "reason": "command unavailable"}
+    outputs = {"stdout": bytearray(), "stderr": bytearray()}
+    overflow = threading.Event()
+
+    def drain(label: str, stream: Any) -> None:
+        assert stream is not None
+        while True:
+            chunk = stream.read(65536)
+            if not chunk:
+                return
+            buffer = outputs[label]
+            remaining = MAX_COMMAND_OUTPUT + 1 - len(buffer)
+            if remaining > 0:
+                buffer.extend(chunk[:remaining])
+            if len(chunk) > remaining or len(buffer) > MAX_COMMAND_OUTPUT:
+                overflow.set()
+
+    readers = [threading.Thread(target=drain, args=("stdout", process.stdout), daemon=True),
+               threading.Thread(target=drain, args=("stderr", process.stderr), daemon=True)]
+    for reader in readers:
+        reader.start()
+    started = time.monotonic()
+    timed_out = False
+    while process.poll() is None:
+        if overflow.is_set():
+            process.kill()
+            break
+        if time.monotonic() - started >= COMMAND_TIMEOUT_SECONDS:
+            timed_out = True
+            process.kill()
+            break
+        time.sleep(0.01)
+    try:
+        process.wait(timeout=1)
+    except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:
+        process.kill()
+        process.wait()
+    for reader in readers:
+        reader.join(timeout=1)
+    if any(reader.is_alive() for reader in readers):
+        return "", {"command": name, "status": "UNKNOWN", "reason": "output stream did not close"}
+    if overflow.is_set():
+        return "", {"command": name, "status": "UNKNOWN", "reason": "command output exceeded limit"}
+    if timed_out:
+        return "", {"command": name, "status": "UNKNOWN", "reason": "command timed out"}
+    output = outputs["stdout"].decode("utf-8", errors="replace")
+    if process.returncode != 0:
+        return output, {"command": name, "status": "UNKNOWN", "exit_code": process.returncode,
+                        "reason": "command returned nonzero exit status",
+                        "stderr": outputs["stderr"].decode("utf-8", errors="replace")}
+    return output, None
+
+
+def _read_bounded(path: str, *, limit: int = MAX_COMMAND_OUTPUT) -> tuple[str, dict[str, Any] | None]:
+    try:
+        with open(path, "rb") as stream:
+            data = stream.read(limit + 1)
+    except OSError:
+        return "", {"command": path, "status": "UNKNOWN", "reason": "read unavailable"}
+    if len(data) > limit:
+        return "", {"command": path, "status": "UNKNOWN", "reason": "file exceeds limit"}
+    return data.decode("utf-8", errors="replace"), None
+

+def _windows_raw_template() -> dict[str, Any]:
+    """Return a structurally exact but explicitly incomplete host observation."""
+    return {
+        "os_id": platform.system(), "os_build": platform.version(),
+        "firewall_profiles": [], "effective_firewall_rules": [],
+        "wsl_hyperv_firewall_profiles": [], "effective_wsl_hyperv_firewall_rules": [],
+        "wsl_distributions": [], "wsl_network_configuration": [], "host_endpoints": [],
+        "host_path_exposures": [], "collection_complete": False,
+        "errors": [{"command": "Windows effective-policy collector", "status": "UNSUPPORTED",
+                    "reason": "full ActiveStore and WSL/Hyper-V effective-rule normalization is not implemented"}],
+        "raw_command_outputs": {},
+    }

+def collect_windows_observations(*, profile: str = "windows-powershell-5") -> dict[str, Any]:
+    """Capture bounded raw Windows output using an explicitly selected PowerShell profile.
+
+    The PowerShell 7 profile is opt-in and has distinct provenance. Neither profile normalizes
+    effective policy or can produce a PASS.
+    """
+    raw = _windows_raw_template()
+    raw["raw_command_outputs"] = {"collector_profile": str(profile)}
+    if os.name != "nt":
+        raw["errors"] = [{"command": "Windows effective-policy collector", "status": "UNSUPPORTED",
+                          "reason": "collector requires Windows"}]
+        return raw
+    # This fixed read-only script obtains ActiveStore profile/rule and WSL-Hyper-V command output.
+    # It intentionally does not translate that output into complete effective rules. Filter joins,
+    # build support, endpoint/path inventories and cross-checks need a reviewed normalizer first.
+    script = r'''
+$ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'
+$snapshot = [ordered]@{}
+$snapshot.os = Get-CimInstance Win32_OperatingSystem | Select-Object Caption,Version,BuildNumber
+$snapshot.profiles = Get-NetFirewallProfile -PolicyStore ActiveStore | Select-Object Name,Enabled,DefaultInboundAction,DefaultOutboundAction,PolicyStoreSource,PolicyStoreSourceType
+$snapshot.rules = Get-NetFirewallRule -PolicyStore ActiveStore | ForEach-Object {
+  $r = $_
+  [ordered]@{ rule = ($r | Select-Object Name,DisplayName,Enabled,Direction,Action,Profile,PolicyStoreSource,PolicyStoreSourceType);
+    address = @(Get-NetFirewallAddressFilter -AssociatedNetFirewallRule $r | Select-Object LocalAddress,RemoteAddress);
+    port = @(Get-NetFirewallPortFilter -AssociatedNetFirewallRule $r | Select-Object Protocol,LocalPort,RemotePort);
+    application = @(Get-NetFirewallApplicationFilter -AssociatedNetFirewallRule $r | Select-Object Program,Package) }
+}
+if (Get-Command Get-NetFirewallHyperVVMSetting -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue) {
+  $snapshot.hypervProfiles = Get-NetFirewallHyperVVMSetting | Select-Object Name,Enabled,DefaultInboundAction,DefaultOutboundAction
+} else { $snapshot.hypervProfiles = $null }
+if (Get-Command Get-NetFirewallHyperVRule -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue) {
+  $snapshot.hypervRules = Get-NetFirewallHyperVRule | Select-Object Name,Enabled,Direction,Action,Protocol,LocalAddresses,RemoteAddresses,LocalPorts,RemotePorts
+} else { $snapshot.hypervRules = $null }
+$snapshot.wsl = & wsl.exe --list --verbose 2>&1
+$snapshot.wslExitCode = $LASTEXITCODE
+$snapshot | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 8 -Compress
+'''
+    executables = {
+        "windows-powershell-5": r"C:\Windows\System32\WindowsPowerShell\v1.0\powershell.exe",
+        "powershell-7": r"C:\Program Files\PowerShell\7\pwsh.exe",
+    }
+    module_paths = {
+        "windows-powershell-5": r"C:\Windows\System32\WindowsPowerShell\v1.0\Modules",
+        "powershell-7": (
+            r"C:\Program Files\PowerShell\7\Modules;"
+            r"C:\Windows\System32\WindowsPowerShell\v1.0\Modules"
+        ),
+    }
+    if not isinstance(profile, str) or profile not in executables:
+        raw["errors"] = [{"command": "Windows effective-policy collector",
+                          "status": "UNSUPPORTED", "reason": "unknown explicit collector profile"}]
+        return raw
+    executable = executables[profile]
+    # Keep the script fixed and use an absolute executable path for WSL. PATH remains empty.
+    script = script.replace("wsl.exe --list", r"C:\Windows\System32\wsl.exe --list")
+    output, error = _run_fixed((executable, "-NoLogo", "-NoProfile", "-NonInteractive",
+                                "-ExecutionPolicy", "Restricted", "-Command", script),
+                               name="Windows ActiveStore/WSL-HyperV read-only snapshot",
+                               windows_module_path=module_paths[profile])
+    if output:
+        raw["raw_command_outputs"] = {"collector_profile": profile, "powershell_snapshot": output}
+    else:
+        raw["raw_command_outputs"] = {"collector_profile": profile}
+    raw["errors"] = ([error] if error else []) + [{
+        "command": "Windows observation normalizer", "status": "UNKNOWN",
+        "reason": "complete effective-rule, endpoint, path and Windows-WSL correlation normalization is not implemented",
+    }]
+    return raw
+

+def _read_uid() -> int | None:
+    try:
+        return os.geteuid()
+    except AttributeError:
+        return None
+
+
+def _read_gid() -> int | None:
+    try:
+        return os.getegid()
+    except AttributeError:
+        return None

+def _collect_mounts() -> tuple[str, list[str], bool, list[dict[str, Any]]]:
+    mounts, error = _read_bounded("/proc/self/mounts")
+    errors = [error] if error else []
+    drives: list[str] = []
+    complete = error is None
+    for line in mounts.splitlines():
+        fields = line.split()
+        if len(fields) < 3:
+            complete = False
+            errors.append({"command": "/proc/self/mounts", "status": "UNKNOWN",
+                           "reason": "malformed mount row"})
+            continue
+        source, _target, filesystem = fields[:3]
+        options = fields[3] if len(fields) > 3 else ""
+        if filesystem.lower() == "drvfs" or (
+            filesystem.lower() == "9p" and re.search(r"(?:^|[;,])aname=drvfs(?:$|[;,])", options)
+        ):
+            drives.append(line)
+    return mounts, drives, complete, errors
+
+
+def collect_wsl_observations() -> dict[str, Any]:
+    """Collect bounded read-only POSIX metadata. Incomplete sources remain explicit UNKNOWN."""
+    if os.name != "posix" or not Path("/proc/sys/kernel/osrelease").exists():
+        raise ContractError("WSL collector requires a POSIX /proc environment")
+    kernel, kernel_error = _read_bounded("/proc/sys/kernel/osrelease")
+    release, release_error = _read_bounded("/etc/os-release")
+    release_values: dict[str, str] = {}
+    for line in release.splitlines():
+        key, sep, value = line.partition("=")
+        if sep:
+            release_values[key] = value.strip().strip('"')
+    errors = [item for item in (kernel_error, release_error) if item]
+    mounts, drive_mounts, mount_complete, mount_errors = _collect_mounts()
+    errors.extend(mount_errors)
+    command_outputs: dict[str, str] = {}
+    command_map = {
+        "nft_ruleset_raw": ("/usr/sbin/nft", "list", "ruleset"),
+        "ipv4_routes_raw": ("/usr/sbin/ip", "-4", "route", "show", "table", "all"),
+        "ipv6_routes_raw": ("/usr/sbin/ip", "-6", "route", "show", "table", "all"),
+        "ipv4_rules_raw": ("/usr/sbin/ip", "-4", "rule", "show"),
+        "ipv6_rules_raw": ("/usr/sbin/ip", "-6", "rule", "show"),
+        "namespaces_raw": ("/usr/bin/lsns", "--noheadings", "--output", "NS,TYPE,PATH"),
+        "interfaces_raw": ("/usr/sbin/ip", "-details", "address", "show"),
+        "listeners_raw": ("/usr/bin/ss", "-H", "-lntup"),
+    }
+    for field, argv in command_map.items():
+        output, error = _run_fixed(argv, name=field)
+        command_outputs[field] = output
+        if error:
+            errors.append(error)
+    total_output = sum(len(value.encode("utf-8")) for value in command_outputs.values())
+    if total_output > MAX_TOTAL_OUTPUT:
+        command_outputs = {key: "" for key in command_outputs}
+        errors.append({"command": "WSL observation bundle", "status": "UNKNOWN",
+                       "reason": "combined command output exceeded limit"})
+    interop_path = "/proc/sys/fs/binfmt_misc/WSLInterop"
+    interop_present = os.path.lexists(interop_path)
+    interop_enabled = False
+    if interop_present:
+        interop_text, interop_error = _read_bounded(interop_path)
+        if interop_error:
+            errors.append(interop_error)
+        else:
+            interop_enabled = "enabled" in interop_text.lower()
+    try:
+        from .preflight import _container_socket_inventory
+        socket_paths, socket_inventory_complete = _container_socket_inventory()
+    except Exception:
+        socket_paths, socket_inventory_complete = [], False
+        errors.append({"command": "container socket inventory", "status": "UNKNOWN",
+                       "reason": "bounded socket inventory failed"})
+    os_id = release_values.get("ID", "UNKNOWN")
+    os_build = release_values.get("VERSION_ID", "UNKNOWN")
+    if "microsoft" not in kernel.lower() or os_id != "ubuntu" or os_build != "24.04":
+        errors.append({"command": "OS identity", "status": "UNSUPPORTED",
+                       "reason": "expected Ubuntu 24.04 on WSL"})
+    complete = not errors and mount_complete and socket_inventory_complete
+    return {
+        "os_id": os_id, "os_build": os_build, "kernel_release": kernel.strip(),
+        "nft_ruleset_raw": command_outputs["nft_ruleset_raw"],
+        "ipv4_routes_raw": command_outputs["ipv4_routes_raw"],
+        "ipv6_routes_raw": command_outputs["ipv6_routes_raw"],
+        "ipv4_rules_raw": command_outputs["ipv4_rules_raw"],
+        "ipv6_rules_raw": command_outputs["ipv6_rules_raw"],
+        "namespaces_raw": command_outputs["namespaces_raw"],
+        "interfaces_raw": command_outputs["interfaces_raw"], "mounts_raw": mounts,
+        "windows_drive_mounts": drive_mounts, "wsl_interop_present": interop_present,
+        "wsl_interop_enabled": interop_enabled, "container_socket_paths": socket_paths,
+        "container_socket_inventory_complete": socket_inventory_complete,
+        "listeners_raw": command_outputs["listeners_raw"],
+        "uid": _read_uid(), "gid": _read_gid(), "collection_complete": complete,
+        "errors": errors,
+    }
+
+
+def _source_receipt(source_id: str, raw: dict[str, Any], *, source_head: str,
+                    observed_at: str) -> dict[str, Any]:
+    raw_digest = hashlib.sha256(canonical_bytes(raw)).hexdigest()
+    return {
+        "schema": RECEIPT_SCHEMA, "source_id": source_id,
+        "collector_path": "tools/vst/machine_observations.py", "collector_head": source_head,
+        "collector_sha256": _source_sha256(), "os_id": str(raw.get("os_id", "UNKNOWN")),
+        "os_build": str(raw.get("os_build", "UNKNOWN")),
+        "principal": str(os.getuid()) if hasattr(os, "getuid") else "UNKNOWN",
+        "privilege_boundary": "current-process identity; not an independent trust claim",
+        "observation_schema": ("VST_S2_WINDOWS_HOST_OBSERVATION_V1" if source_id == "windows-host"
+                               else "VST_S2_WSL_GUEST_OBSERVATION_V1"),
+        "collected_at_utc": observed_at, "raw_sha256": raw_digest,
+        "signature": None,
+    }
+
+
+def build_observation_bundle(run_id: str, source_head: str, sandbox_spec_sha256: str,
+                             windows_raw: dict[str, Any], wsl_raw: dict[str, Any], *,
+                             nonce: str | None = None,
+                             now: dt.datetime | None = None) -> dict[str, Any]:
+    """Bind supplied read-only observations; this does not make them trusted or complete."""
+    if not isinstance(run_id, str) or not run_id.strip():
+        raise ContractError("observation bundle run_id must be non-empty")
+    if len(run_id) > 128 or not run_id[0].isalnum() or any(
+            not (char.isalnum() or char in "_.:-") for char in run_id):
+        raise ContractError("observation bundle run_id has an invalid format")
+    if not isinstance(source_head, str) or not _HEX40.fullmatch(source_head):
+        raise ContractError("observation bundle source_head must be a full Git SHA")
+    if not isinstance(sandbox_spec_sha256, str) or not _HEX64.fullmatch(sandbox_spec_sha256):
+        raise ContractError("observation bundle sandbox digest must be SHA-256")
+    nonce = nonce or uuid.uuid4().hex
+    if not isinstance(nonce, str) or not _NONCE.fullmatch(nonce):
+        raise ContractError("observation bundle nonce must be 32 lowercase hex")
+    if not isinstance(windows_raw, dict) or set(windows_raw) != WINDOWS_FIELDS:
+        raise ContractError("Windows observation does not match its exact schema")
+    if not isinstance(wsl_raw, dict) or set(wsl_raw) != WSL_FIELDS:
+        raise ContractError("WSL observation does not match its exact schema")
+    _validate_windows_raw(windows_raw)
+    _validate_wsl_raw(wsl_raw)
+    if len(canonical_bytes(windows_raw)) + len(canonical_bytes(wsl_raw)) > MAX_TOTAL_OUTPUT:
+        raise ContractError("observation bundle exceeds the combined raw-output limit")
+    current = now or dt.datetime.now(dt.timezone.utc)
+    if current.tzinfo is None or current.utcoffset() != dt.timedelta(0):
+        raise ContractError("observation bundle clock must be UTC")
+    stamp = current.strftime(_UTC)
+    sources = [
+        _source_receipt("windows-host", windows_raw, source_head=source_head, observed_at=stamp),
+        _source_receipt("wsl-guest", wsl_raw, source_head=source_head, observed_at=stamp),
+    ]
+    unsigned = {
+        "schema": BUNDLE_SCHEMA, "run_id": run_id, "nonce": nonce,
+        "source_head": source_head, "sandbox_spec_sha256": sandbox_spec_sha256,
+        "started_at_utc": stamp, "finished_at_utc": stamp, "sources": sources,
+        "raw_observations": {"windows-host": windows_raw, "wsl-guest": wsl_raw},
+    }
+    return {**unsigned, "bundle_sha256": hashlib.sha256(canonical_bytes(unsigned)).hexdigest()}
+
+
+def validate_observation_bundle(value: object) -> dict[str, Any]:
+    if not isinstance(value, dict) or set(value) != BUNDLE_FIELDS:
+        raise ContractError("machine observation bundle fields do not match the closed schema")
+    if value["schema"] != BUNDLE_SCHEMA:
+        raise ContractError("machine observation bundle schema is unsupported")
+    if not isinstance(value["run_id"], str) or not value["run_id"].strip():
+        raise ContractError("machine observation bundle run_id is invalid")
+    if not isinstance(value["source_head"], str) or not _HEX40.fullmatch(value["source_head"]):
+        raise ContractError("machine observation bundle source_head is invalid")
+    if not isinstance(value["sandbox_spec_sha256"], str) or not _HEX64.fullmatch(value["sandbox_spec_sha256"]):
+        raise ContractError("machine observation bundle spec digest is invalid")
+    if not isinstance(value["nonce"], str) or not _NONCE.fullmatch(value["nonce"]):
+        raise ContractError("machine observation bundle nonce is invalid")
+    started = _time(value["started_at_utc"], "bundle started_at_utc")
+    finished = _time(value["finished_at_utc"], "bundle finished_at_utc")
+    if finished < started:
+        raise ContractError("machine observation bundle time order is invalid")
+    sources = value["sources"]
+    raw = value["raw_observations"]
+    if not isinstance(sources, list) or not isinstance(raw, dict) or set(raw) != {"windows-host", "wsl-guest"}:
+        raise ContractError("machine observation bundle must contain both named sources")
+    if len(sources) != 2:
+        raise ContractError("machine observation bundle must contain exactly two source receipts")
+    by_source = {}
+    for source in sources:
+        if not isinstance(source, dict) or set(source) != RECEIPT_FIELDS or source.get("schema") != RECEIPT_SCHEMA:
+            raise ContractError("machine observation source receipt fields are invalid")
+        source_id = source["source_id"]
+        if source_id not in {"windows-host", "wsl-guest"} or source_id in by_source:
+            raise ContractError("machine observation source ID is missing, duplicated, or unknown")
+        for key in ("collector_sha256", "raw_sha256"):
+            if not isinstance(source[key], str) or not _HEX64.fullmatch(source[key]):
+                raise ContractError(f"machine source receipt {key} is invalid")
+        if not isinstance(source["collector_head"], str) or not _HEX40.fullmatch(source["collector_head"]):
+            raise ContractError("machine source receipt collector_head is invalid")
+        if source["signature"] is not None:
+            raise ContractError("unsigned candidate observation receipts are required in this source scope")
+        collected = _time(source["collected_at_utc"], "source collected_at_utc")
+        if not started <= collected <= finished:
+            raise ContractError("machine source receipt timestamp falls outside bundle interval")
+        for field in ("collector_path", "os_id", "os_build", "principal", "privilege_boundary"):
+            if not isinstance(source[field], str) or not source[field]:
+                raise ContractError(f"machine source receipt {field} is invalid")
+        if source["collector_head"] != value["source_head"]:
+            raise ContractError("machine source receipt head does not match bundle source")
+        if source["raw_sha256"] != hashlib.sha256(canonical_bytes(raw[source_id])).hexdigest():
+            raise ContractError("machine source receipt does not bind the raw observation")
+        by_source[source_id] = source
+    if set(by_source) != {"windows-host", "wsl-guest"}:
+        raise ContractError("machine observation bundle is missing a source")
+    if not isinstance(raw["windows-host"], dict) or set(raw["windows-host"]) != WINDOWS_FIELDS:
+        raise ContractError("Windows raw observation fields are invalid")
+    if not isinstance(raw["wsl-guest"], dict) or set(raw["wsl-guest"]) != WSL_FIELDS:
+        raise ContractError("WSL raw observation fields are invalid")
+    _validate_windows_raw(raw["windows-host"])
+    _validate_wsl_raw(raw["wsl-guest"])
+    unsigned = {key: value[key] for key in BUNDLE_FIELDS if key != "bundle_sha256"}
+    expected = hashlib.sha256(canonical_bytes(unsigned)).hexdigest()
+    if value["bundle_sha256"] != expected:
+        raise ContractError("machine observation bundle digest is invalid")
+    return value
+
+
+def _validate_error_list(value: object, *, name: str) -> None:
+    if not isinstance(value, list):
+        raise ContractError(f"{name}: expected an array")
+    for error in value:
+        if not isinstance(error, dict) or not {"command", "status", "reason"} <= set(error):
+            raise ContractError(f"{name}: malformed collection error")
+        if set(error) - {"command", "status", "reason", "exit_code", "stderr"}:
+            raise ContractError(f"{name}: unknown collection error field")
+        if not all(isinstance(error[key], str) for key in ("command", "status", "reason")):
+            raise ContractError(f"{name}: malformed collection error value")
+        if "exit_code" in error and type(error["exit_code"]) is not int:
+            raise ContractError(f"{name}: malformed exit code")
+        if "stderr" in error and not isinstance(error["stderr"], str):
+            raise ContractError(f"{name}: malformed stderr")
+
+
+def _validate_windows_raw(value: dict[str, Any]) -> None:
+    if not all(isinstance(value[field], str) for field in ("os_id", "os_build")):
+        raise ContractError("Windows observation OS identity is invalid")
+    if type(value["collection_complete"]) is not bool:
+        raise ContractError("Windows observation collection_complete must be boolean")
+    _validate_error_list(value["errors"], name="Windows observation errors")
+    outputs = value["raw_command_outputs"]
+    if not isinstance(outputs, dict) or any(not isinstance(key, str) or not isinstance(item, str)
+                                            for key, item in outputs.items()):
+        raise ContractError("Windows observation raw command output map is invalid")
+    if sum(len(item.encode("utf-8")) for item in outputs.values()) > MAX_TOTAL_OUTPUT:
+        raise ContractError("Windows observation raw output exceeds limit")
+    for field in ("firewall_profiles", "effective_firewall_rules", "wsl_hyperv_firewall_profiles",
+                  "effective_wsl_hyperv_firewall_rules", "wsl_distributions",
+                  "wsl_network_configuration", "host_endpoints", "host_path_exposures"):
+        if not isinstance(value[field], list):
+            raise ContractError(f"Windows observation {field} must be an array")
+    if value["collection_complete"]:
+        raise ContractError("Windows effective policy normalization is not authorized in this source scope")
+
+
+def _validate_wsl_raw(value: dict[str, Any]) -> None:
+    text_fields = ("os_id", "os_build", "kernel_release", "nft_ruleset_raw", "ipv4_routes_raw",
+                   "ipv6_routes_raw", "ipv4_rules_raw", "ipv6_rules_raw", "namespaces_raw",
+                   "interfaces_raw", "mounts_raw", "listeners_raw")
+    if not all(isinstance(value[field], str) for field in text_fields):
+        raise ContractError("WSL observation text field is invalid")
+    if not all(isinstance(value[field], list) for field in ("windows_drive_mounts", "container_socket_paths")):
+        raise ContractError("WSL observation path lists are invalid")
+    if not all(isinstance(item, str) for field in ("windows_drive_mounts", "container_socket_paths")
+               for item in value[field]):
+        raise ContractError("WSL observation path list contains a non-string")
+    for field in ("wsl_interop_present", "wsl_interop_enabled", "container_socket_inventory_complete",
+                  "collection_complete"):
+        if type(value[field]) is not bool:
+            raise ContractError(f"WSL observation {field} must be boolean")
+    for field in ("uid", "gid"):
+        if value[field] is not None and (type(value[field]) is not int or value[field] < 0):
+            raise ContractError(f"WSL observation {field} is invalid")
+    _validate_error_list(value["errors"], name="WSL observation errors")
+    if value["collection_complete"] and (not value["container_socket_inventory_complete"]
+                                          or value["uid"] is None or value["gid"] is None):
+        raise ContractError("WSL collection cannot be complete with unknown identity or socket scan")
+
+
+def evaluate_observation_completeness(value: object, *, expected_run_id: str,
+                                      expected_nonce: str, expected_source_head: str,
+                                      expected_spec_sha256: str) -> dict[str, Any]:
+    """Return only metadata completeness; never an egress verdict or E5 PASS."""
+    bundle = validate_observation_bundle(value)
+    if (bundle["run_id"] != expected_run_id or bundle["nonce"] != expected_nonce
+            or bundle["source_head"] != expected_source_head
+            or bundle["sandbox_spec_sha256"] != expected_spec_sha256):
+        raise ContractError("machine observation bundle freshness or source binding mismatch")
+    missing: list[str] = []
+    for source_id, observation in bundle["raw_observations"].items():
+        if observation.get("collection_complete") is not True:
+            missing.append(source_id)
+        if observation.get("errors"):
+            missing.append(source_id + ":errors")
+    # Both source receipts are unsigned and Windows policy normalization is intentionally held.
+    # Caller-provided completeness booleans cannot authenticate either source or yield PASS.
+    if not missing:
+        missing.extend(("windows-host:unsigned-and-unparsed", "wsl-guest:unsigned-source"))
+    unsigned = {"schema": EVALUATION_SCHEMA, "bundle_sha256": bundle["bundle_sha256"],
+                "evaluator_sha256": _source_sha256(), "status": "UNKNOWN",
+                "predicates": [
+                    {"id": "both-sources-complete", "status": "UNKNOWN",
+                     "evidence": [{"source_id": "windows-host", "raw_field_path": "collection_complete"},
+                                  {"source_id": "wsl-guest", "raw_field_path": "collection_complete"}]},
+                    {"id": "authenticated-source-provenance", "status": "UNKNOWN",
+                     "evidence": [{"source_id": "windows-host", "raw_field_path": "signature"},
+                                  {"source_id": "wsl-guest", "raw_field_path": "signature"}]},
+                    {"id": "effective-network-policy", "status": "UNKNOWN",
+                     "evidence": [{"source_id": "windows-host",
+                                   "raw_field_path": "effective_firewall_rules"}]},
+                ],
+                "missing_sources": missing, "unmatched_rules": [],
+                "limitations": ["unsigned observations", "no approved network policy evaluator",
+                                "not an E5 attestation", "no comprehensive egress verdict"]}
+    return {**unsigned, "result_sha256": hashlib.sha256(canonical_bytes(unsigned)).hexdigest()}

+"""stdlib-only sandbox pre-flight inventory; no third-party packages required."""
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import hashlib
+import os
+import re
+import socket
+import time
+import uuid
+from pathlib import Path
+from typing import Any
+
+from .contracts import ContractError
+from .signing import sign
+
+PROBE_LABEL = b"vst-sandbox-probe-v2\0"
+SPEC_PATH = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2] / "docs" / "SANDBOX_SPEC.md"
+BLOCKED_EGRESS_TARGET = ("198.51.100.1", 9)
+CONTAINER_SOCKETS = (
+    "/run/docker.sock", "/var/run/docker.sock", "/run/containerd/containerd.sock",
+    "/run/podman/podman.sock",
+)

+def _container_socket_inventory() -> tuple[list[str], bool]:
+    """Enumerate known engine sockets across all runtime UIDs; unknown is unsafe."""
+    paths = list(CONTAINER_SOCKETS)
+    observed_proc_sockets: list[str] = []
+    found: list[str] = []
+    complete = True
+    def observe(path: str) -> None:
+        """Record present paths; permission/metadata errors make the scan incomplete."""
+        nonlocal complete
+        try:
+            os.lstat(path)
+        except FileNotFoundError:
+            return
+        except OSError:
+            complete = False
+            return
+        found.append(path)
+
+    # /run/user is the canonical runtime root. Do not follow it or UID entries
+    # when symlinked: they are part of the host boundary being inventoried.
+    runtime_root = "/run/user"
+    try:
+        root_stat = os.lstat(runtime_root)
+    except FileNotFoundError:
+        root_stat = None
+    except OSError:
+        root_stat = None
+        complete = False
+    if root_stat is not None:
+        if os.path.islink(runtime_root) or not os.path.isdir(runtime_root):
+            complete = False
+        else:
+            try:
+                with os.scandir(runtime_root) as entries:
+                    user_entries = list(entries)
+            except OSError:
+                user_entries = []
+                complete = False
+            for entry in user_entries:
+                if not entry.name.isdigit():
+                    complete = False
+                    continue
+                try:
+                    if entry.is_symlink() or not entry.is_dir(follow_symlinks=False):
+                        complete = False
+                        continue
+                except OSError:
+                    complete = False
+                    continue
+                user_dir = entry.path
+                for relative in ("docker.sock", "containerd/containerd.sock", "podman/podman.sock"):
+                    candidate = os.path.join(user_dir, relative)
+                    parent = os.path.dirname(candidate)
+                    if parent != user_dir:
+                        try:
+                            parent_stat = os.lstat(parent)
+                        except FileNotFoundError:
+                            continue
+                        except OSError:
+                            complete = False
+                            continue
+                        if os.path.islink(parent) or not os.path.isdir(parent):
+                            complete = False
+                            continue
+                    observe(candidate)
+
+    for path in paths:
+        observe(path)
+    try:
+        unix_sockets = Path("/proc/net/unix").read_text(encoding="utf-8").splitlines()
+        observed_proc_sockets.extend(line.split()[-1] for line in unix_sockets[1:]
+                                     if line.split() and any(token in line.split()[-1].lower()
+                                     for token in ("docker.sock", "podman.sock", "containerd.sock")))
+    except OSError:
+        complete = False
+    return sorted(set(found + observed_proc_sockets)), complete
+
+
+def _loopback_canary() -> bool:
+    server = socket.socket(socket.AF_INET, socket.SOCK_STREAM)
+    server.settimeout(2.0)
+    server.bind(("127.0.0.1", 0))
+    server.listen(1)
+    client = socket.socket(socket.AF_INET, socket.SOCK_STREAM)
+    client.settimeout(2.0)
+    try:
+        client.connect(server.getsockname())
+        accepted, _ = server.accept()
+        accepted.close()
+        return True
+    except OSError:
+        return False
+    finally:
+        client.close()
+        server.close()
+
+
+def _blocked_egress() -> bool:
+    probe = socket.socket(socket.AF_INET, socket.SOCK_STREAM)
+    probe.settimeout(1.0)
+    try:
+        probe.connect(BLOCKED_EGRESS_TARGET)
+    except OSError:
+        return True
+    finally:
+        probe.close()
+    return False
+

+def collect_inventory(run_id: str, nonce: str | None = None, *,
+                      network_policy_attestation: dict[str, Any] | None = None) -> dict[str, Any]:
+    if not isinstance(run_id, str) or not run_id.strip():
+        raise ContractError("run_id must be non-empty")
+    if os.name != "posix" or not hasattr(os, "geteuid"):
+        raise ContractError("sandbox probe requires a POSIX sandbox")
+    nonce = nonce or uuid.uuid4().hex
+    mounts = Path("/proc/self/mounts").read_text(encoding="utf-8", errors="replace")
+    interop_path = Path("/proc/sys/fs/binfmt_misc/WSLInterop")
+    interop_present = interop_path.exists()
+    interop_enabled = False
+    if interop_present:
+        try:
+            interop_enabled = "enabled" in interop_path.read_text(encoding="ascii", errors="ignore").lower()
+        except OSError:
+            interop_enabled = True  # unknown is unsafe
+    windows_drive_mounts = []
+    for line in mounts.splitlines():
+        fields = line.split()
+        if len(fields) < 3:
+            continue
+        source, _target, filesystem = fields[:3]
+        options = fields[3] if len(fields) >= 4 else ""
+        wsl_drvfs_9p = filesystem.lower() == "9p" and re.search(
+            r"(?:^|[;,])aname=drvfs(?:$|[;,])", options
+        ) is not None
+        # WSL exposes automounted Windows volumes as drvfs mounts, either
+        # directly or through 9p with aname=drvfs. Other /mnt mounts such as
+        # WSLg are not evidence of Windows-drive automount.
+        if (filesystem.lower() == "drvfs" or wsl_drvfs_9p) and re.fullmatch(
+            r"[A-Za-z]:\\?", source
+        ):
+            windows_drive_mounts.append(line)
+    sockets, socket_inventory_complete = _container_socket_inventory()
+    attestation = network_policy_attestation
+    attestation_valid_shape = isinstance(attestation, dict) and set(attestation) == {
+        "run_id", "spec_sha256", "nonce", "environment_id", "policy_sha256",
+        "evidence_sha256", "empty_external_allowlist", "no_container_socket",
+        "no_unapproved_host_paths", "signature",
+    } and attestation.get("run_id") == run_id and attestation.get("spec_sha256") == hashlib.sha256(
+        SPEC_PATH.read_bytes()
+    ).hexdigest() and attestation.get("nonce") == nonce
+    uid = os.geteuid()
+    checks = {
+        "automount_disabled": not windows_drive_mounts,
+        "interop_disabled": not interop_enabled,
+        "no_container_socket": socket_inventory_complete and not sockets and attestation_valid_shape
+            and attestation.get("no_container_socket") is True,
+        "non_root": uid != 0,
+        "external_egress_blocked": _blocked_egress(),  # limited smoke probe only
+        "loopback_canary": _loopback_canary(),
+        "empty_external_allowlist": attestation_valid_shape and attestation.get("empty_external_allowlist") is True,
+    }
+    spec_bytes = SPEC_PATH.read_bytes()
+    return {
+        "run_id": run_id,
+        "spec_sha256": hashlib.sha256(spec_bytes).hexdigest(),
+        "nonce": nonce,
+        "checked_properties": checks,
+        "result": "PASS" if all(checks.values()) else "FAIL",
+        "inventory": {
+            "mount_table": mounts.splitlines(),
+            "windows_drive_mounts": windows_drive_mounts,
+            "wsl_interop_present": interop_present,
+            "wsl_interop_enabled": interop_enabled,
+            "uid": uid,
+            "gid": os.getegid(),
+            "container_socket_paths_present": sockets,
+            "container_socket_inventory_complete": socket_inventory_complete,
+            "blocked_egress_target": list(BLOCKED_EGRESS_TARGET),
+            "blocked_egress_probe_scope": "single reserved-target smoke probe; does not prove egress policy",
+            "network_policy_attestation": attestation,
+            "environment_variable_names": sorted(os.environ.keys()),
+            "observed_at_monotonic_ns": time.monotonic_ns(),
+        },
+    }
+

+def sign_inventory(inventory: dict[str, Any], runner_key: bytes) -> dict[str, Any]:
+    required = {"run_id", "spec_sha256", "nonce", "checked_properties", "result", "inventory"}
+    if not isinstance(inventory, dict) or set(inventory) != required:
+        raise ContractError("probe inventory fields do not match contract")
+    signed = dict(inventory)
+    signed["signature"] = sign(inventory, runner_key, PROBE_LABEL)
+    return signed

+def sign_network_policy_attestation(attestation: dict[str, Any], operator_key: bytes) -> dict[str, Any]:
+    """Operator-side helper; keep the operator root outside runner/worker processes."""
+    from .signing import OPERATOR_NETWORK_POLICY_LABEL, sign
+    required = {"run_id", "spec_sha256", "nonce", "environment_id", "policy_sha256",
+                "evidence_sha256", "empty_external_allowlist", "no_container_socket",
+                "no_unapproved_host_paths"}
+    if not isinstance(attestation, dict) or set(attestation) != required:
+        raise ContractError("network policy attestation fields do not match contract")
+    signed = dict(attestation)

+    return signed

+def sign_inventory_with_service(inventory: dict[str, Any], *, signer_socket: str) -> dict[str, Any]:
+    """Return an inventory signed by the authenticated runner-only signer."""
+    from .signer import sign_probe_over_socket
+    required = {"run_id", "spec_sha256", "nonce", "checked_properties", "result", "inventory"}
+    if not isinstance(inventory, dict) or set(inventory) != required:
+        raise ContractError("probe inventory fields do not match contract")
+    signed = dict(inventory)
+    signed["signature"] = sign_probe_over_socket(signer_socket, inventory["nonce"], inventory)
+    return signed

+def verify_fresh_probe(probe: dict[str, Any], *, run_id: str, spec_sha256: str, nonce: str, key: bytes) -> bool:
+    from .signing import verify
+    if not isinstance(probe, dict):
+        return False
+    checks = probe.get("checked_properties")
+    expected_checks = {
+        "automount_disabled", "interop_disabled", "no_container_socket", "non_root",
+        "external_egress_blocked", "loopback_canary", "empty_external_allowlist",
+    }
+    return (
+        probe.get("run_id") == run_id and probe.get("spec_sha256") == spec_sha256
+        and probe.get("nonce") == nonce and probe.get("result") == "PASS"
+        and isinstance(checks, dict) and set(checks) == expected_checks
+        and all(value is True for value in checks.values())
+        and isinstance(probe.get("inventory"), dict)
+        and probe["inventory"].get("container_socket_inventory_complete") is True
+        and isinstance(probe["inventory"].get("network_policy_attestation"), dict)
+        and verify(probe, key, PROBE_LABEL)
+    )
+

+def verify_network_policy_attestation(attestation: object, *, run_id: str, spec_sha256: str,
+                                      nonce: str, key: bytes) -> bool:
+    from .signing import OPERATOR_NETWORK_POLICY_LABEL, verify
+    fields = {"run_id", "spec_sha256", "nonce", "environment_id", "policy_sha256",
+              "evidence_sha256", "empty_external_allowlist", "no_container_socket",
+              "no_unapproved_host_paths", "signature"}
+    if not isinstance(attestation, dict) or set(attestation) != fields:
+        return False
+    import re
+    return (attestation.get("run_id") == run_id and attestation.get("spec_sha256") == spec_sha256
+            and attestation.get("nonce") == nonce
+            and isinstance(attestation.get("environment_id"), str) and bool(attestation["environment_id"].strip())
+            and all(isinstance(attestation.get(k), str) and re.fullmatch(r"[0-9a-f]{64}", attestation[k])
+                    for k in ("policy_sha256", "evidence_sha256"))
+            and all(attestation.get(k) is True for k in
+                    ("empty_external_allowlist", "no_container_socket", "no_unapproved_host_paths"))
+            and verify(attestation, key, OPERATOR_NETWORK_POLICY_LABEL))

+"""Default-off root-bound signer for the unchanged dispatch-instruction v1 wire format."""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import base64
+import hashlib
+import json
+import os
+import stat
+from datetime import datetime, timezone
+from typing import Any
+
+from .contracts import ContractError, canonical_bytes
+from .dispatch_instruction import DISPATCH_INSTRUCTION_PURPOSE
+from .dispatch_issuance import (
+    canonical_sha256, freeze_issuance_intent, validate_key_binding,
+)
+from .execution_grant import _openssl_signature
+
+_ISSUANCE_PROOF_SEAL = object()
+
+
+class VerifiedDispatchIssuance:
+    """In-process root verification result bound to one immutable envelope and signer."""
+
+    __slots__ = ("_intent", "_envelope", "fingerprint", "_seal")
+
+    def __init__(self, seal: object, intent: dict, envelope: dict, fingerprint: str):
+        if seal is not _ISSUANCE_PROOF_SEAL:
+            raise ContractError("dispatch issuance proof must be created by the root verifier")
+        object.__setattr__(self, "_intent", canonical_bytes(intent))
+        object.__setattr__(self, "_envelope", canonical_bytes(envelope))
+        object.__setattr__(self, "fingerprint", fingerprint)
+        object.__setattr__(self, "_seal", seal)
+
+    def __setattr__(self, name, value):
+        raise AttributeError("verified dispatch proof is immutable")
+
+    @property
+    def intent(self) -> dict:
+        return json.loads(self._intent)
+
+    @property
+    def envelope(self) -> dict:
+        return json.loads(self._envelope)
+
+
+def verify_issued_instruction(store: Any, envelope: dict, *, key_id: str,
+                              public_key_path: str, fingerprint: str,
+                              openssl_path: str) -> VerifiedDispatchIssuance:
+    """Verify the exact completed journal envelope outside SQL and return a sealed context."""
+    from .dispatch_instruction import dispatch_instruction_signing_bytes
+    def verify(signer: dict, payload: bytes, signature: bytes) -> bool:
+        return (
+            signer == {"key_id": key_id, "key_class": "DELEGATED_V1",
+                       "purpose": DISPATCH_INSTRUCTION_PURPOSE,
+                       "public_key_fingerprint": fingerprint}
+            and public_key_fingerprint(public_key_path) == fingerprint
+            and _openssl_signature(openssl_path, key_path=public_key_path,
+                                   payload=payload, signature=signature, private=False) is True
+        )
+
+    verified = store.dispatch_issuance_for_envelope(envelope, verify)
+    if verified["state"] != "COMPLETED":
+        raise ContractError("dispatch instruction lacks a verified issuance completion")
+    intent = verified["intent"]
+    if (intent["signer"]["key_id"] != key_id
+            or intent["signer"]["public_key_fingerprint"] != fingerprint
+            or dispatch_instruction_signing_bytes(envelope) !=
+            b"VST_S2_DISPATCH_INSTRUCTION_V1\0" + canonical_bytes(
+                {k: v for k, v in envelope.items() if k != "signature"})):
+        raise ContractError("dispatch issuance context does not bind the exact envelope")
+    return VerifiedDispatchIssuance(_ISSUANCE_PROOF_SEAL, intent, envelope, fingerprint)
+
+
+def is_verified_issuance_context(value: Any) -> bool:
+    return isinstance(value, VerifiedDispatchIssuance) and value._seal is _ISSUANCE_PROOF_SEAL
+

+def public_key_fingerprint(path: str) -> str:
+    """Fingerprint the exact root-pinned public-key file bytes."""
+    try:
+        fd = os.open(path, os.O_RDONLY | os.O_NOFOLLOW)
+        try:
+            info = os.fstat(fd)
+            if (not stat.S_ISREG(info.st_mode) or info.st_uid != 0
+                    or info.st_mode & 0o022 or info.st_size < 1 or info.st_size > 65536):
+                raise ContractError("dispatch signer public key file is unsafe")
+            chunks = []
+            remaining = 65537
+            while remaining:
+                chunk = os.read(fd, remaining)
+                if not chunk:
+                    break
+                chunks.append(chunk)
+                remaining -= len(chunk)
+            data = b"".join(chunks)
+        finally:
+            os.close(fd)
+    except OSError as exc:
+        raise ContractError("dispatch signer public key is unavailable") from exc
+    if not data or len(data) > 65536:
+        raise ContractError("dispatch signer public key file is invalid")
+    return hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest()
+

+def issue_frozen_dispatch(store: Any, *, handoff: dict, policy: dict,
+                          policy_sha256: str, authority_expires_at_utc: str,
+                          signer: dict, private_key_path: str, public_key_path: str,
+                          openssl_path: str, issuer_max_ttl_seconds: int,
+                          minimum_safety_slack_seconds: int, now,
+                          authority_provider=None, before_sign=None) -> dict:
+    """Reserve, claim, sign once, verify and durably complete one frozen intent."""
+    binding = validate_key_binding(signer)
+    if (binding["purpose"] != DISPATCH_INSTRUCTION_PURPOSE
+            or binding["public_key_fingerprint"] != public_key_fingerprint(public_key_path)):
+        raise ContractError("dispatch signer fingerprint does not match the root public key")
+    frozen = store.existing_dispatch_issuance(handoff["assignment_operation_id"])
+    if frozen is None:
+        frozen = freeze_issuance_intent(
+            handoff, policy={"policy": policy, "policy_sha256": policy_sha256}, signer=binding,
+            expires_at=_bounded_expiry(now, issuer_max_ttl_seconds, authority_expires_at_utc,
+                                       policy["expires_at_utc"], handoff["expires_at_utc"]),
+            authority_expires_at_utc=authority_expires_at_utc,
+            issuer_max_ttl_seconds=issuer_max_ttl_seconds,
+            minimum_safety_slack_seconds=minimum_safety_slack_seconds, now=now,
+        )
+    else:
+        if (frozen["handoff"] != handoff or frozen["policy"] != policy
+                or frozen["signer"] != binding
+                or frozen["issuer_max_ttl_seconds"] != issuer_max_ttl_seconds
+                or frozen["minimum_safety_slack_seconds"] != minimum_safety_slack_seconds
+                or frozen["unsigned"]["expires_at"] > min(
+                    authority_expires_at_utc, policy["expires_at_utc"], handoff["expires_at_utc"],
+                )):
+            raise ContractError("existing issuance identity or current authority changed")
+        stored_expiry = datetime.strptime(
+            frozen["unsigned"]["expires_at"], "%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ",
+        ).replace(tzinfo=timezone.utc)
+        if stored_expiry <= now:
+            raise ContractError("existing dispatch issuance is expired")
+    if authority_provider is None:
+        raise ContractError("fresh root authority provider is required")
+    authority = authority_provider(frozen)
+    state = store.reserve_dispatch_issuance(frozen, authority_snapshot=authority)
+    def verify(exact_signer: dict, payload: bytes, signed: bytes) -> bool:
+        return (
+            exact_signer == binding
+            and public_key_fingerprint(public_key_path) == binding["public_key_fingerprint"]
+            and _openssl_signature(openssl_path, key_path=public_key_path,
+                                   payload=payload, signature=signed, private=False) is True
+        )
+
+    if state["state"] == "VERIFY_REQUIRED":
+        return store.verify_dispatch_issuance_completion(frozen["operation_key"], verify)["envelope"]
+    if state["state"] != "PENDING":
+        raise ContractError("dispatch issuance is not safely signable")
+    intent_digest = canonical_sha256(frozen)
+    authority = authority_provider(frozen)
+    store.start_dispatch_issuance(
+        frozen["operation_key"], intent_digest, authority_snapshot=authority,
+    )
+    try:
+        latest_authority = authority_provider(frozen)
+        store.assert_dispatch_issuance_authority(frozen, authority_snapshot=latest_authority)
+        if (public_key_fingerprint(public_key_path) != binding["public_key_fingerprint"]
+                or before_sign is None or before_sign(frozen) is not True):
+            raise ContractError("current root authority changed before signer entry")
+        signature = _openssl_signature(
+            openssl_path, key_path=private_key_path,
+            payload=b"VST_S2_DISPATCH_INSTRUCTION_V1\0" + canonical_bytes(frozen["unsigned"]),
+            private=True,
+        )
+        if not isinstance(signature, bytes) or len(signature) != 64:
+            raise ContractError("dispatch signer returned malformed Ed25519 output")
+        envelope = {
+            **frozen["unsigned"],
+            "signature": base64.urlsafe_b64encode(signature).decode("ascii").rstrip("="),
+        }
+
+        completion_authority = authority_provider(frozen)
+        completed = store.complete_dispatch_issuance(
+            frozen["operation_key"], intent_digest, envelope, verify,
+            authority_snapshot=completion_authority,
+        )
+        return completed["envelope"]
+    except BaseException as exc:
+        try:
+            store.mark_dispatch_issuance_unknown(
+                frozen["operation_key"], intent_digest, type(exc).__name__,
+            )
+        finally:
+            raise
+
+
+def _bounded_expiry(now, maximum_ttl: int, *authorities: str) -> str:
+    from datetime import datetime, timedelta, timezone
+    if (type(maximum_ttl) is not int or maximum_ttl <= 0 or now.tzinfo is None
+            or now.utcoffset() != timezone.utc.utcoffset(now)):
+        raise ContractError("dispatch issuer requires finite positive TTL and UTC clock")
+    prepared = now.replace(microsecond=0)
+    try:
+        ttl_end = prepared + timedelta(seconds=maximum_ttl)
+    except OverflowError as exc:
+        raise ContractError("dispatch issuer TTL is out of bounds") from exc
+    limits = [ttl_end]
+    for value in authorities:
+        try:
+            parsed = datetime.strptime(value, "%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ").replace(tzinfo=timezone.utc)
+        except (TypeError, ValueError) as exc:
+            raise ContractError("dispatch issuer authority expiry is malformed") from exc
+        limits.append(parsed)
+    return min(limits).strftime("%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ")

+@contextmanager
+def _posix_cgroup_process_lock(deadline: float):
+    """Serialize cgroup admission across runner processes and reconcile leftovers."""
+    if os.name == "nt":
+        yield
+        return
+    try:
+        import fcntl
+    except ImportError as exc:
+        raise OSError("POSIX cgroup admission requires flock support") from exc
+
+    runtime_dir = _POSIX_CGROUP_RUNTIME_DIR
+    dir_stat = os.stat(runtime_dir, follow_symlinks=False)
+    if not stat.S_ISDIR(dir_stat.st_mode) or dir_stat.st_uid != os.geteuid():
+        raise OSError("runner runtime directory must be a real directory owned by the runner")
+    if dir_stat.st_mode & (stat.S_IRGRP | stat.S_IWGRP | stat.S_IRWXO):
+        raise OSError("runner runtime directory must deny group read/write and all other access")
+
+    lock_path = os.path.join(runtime_dir, "cgroup-admission.lock")
+    flags = os.O_CREAT | os.O_RDWR | getattr(os, "O_CLOEXEC", 0)
+    flags |= getattr(os, "O_NOFOLLOW", 0)
+    fd = os.open(lock_path, flags, 0o600)
+    try:
+        lock_stat = os.fstat(fd)
+        if (
+            not stat.S_ISREG(lock_stat.st_mode)
+            or lock_stat.st_uid != os.geteuid()
+            or lock_stat.st_mode & (stat.S_IRWXG | stat.S_IRWXO)
+        ):
+            raise OSError("runner cgroup admission lock must be a private runner-owned regular file")
+        while True:
+            try:
+                fcntl.flock(fd, fcntl.LOCK_EX | fcntl.LOCK_NB)
+                break
+            except BlockingIOError:
+                remaining = deadline - time.monotonic()
+                if remaining <= 0:
+                    raise TimeoutError("runner cgroup admission lock deadline expired")
+                time.sleep(min(0.02, remaining))
+        _DelegatedCgroup.reconcile_stale(deadline)
+        yield
+    finally:
+        os.close(fd)
