+def _serialize_distinct_uid_launch(function: Callable) -> Callable:
+    """Serialize distinct-UID workers without exceeding their admission budget."""
+    @functools.wraps(function)
+    def wrapped(*args, **kwargs):
+        if (
+            os.name != "nt"
+            and kwargs.get("worker_uid") is not None
+            and kwargs.get("worker_gid") is not None
+        ):
+            requested_limit = args[2] if len(args) > 2 else kwargs["limit_sec"]
+            deadline = kwargs.get("_deadline_at")
+            if deadline is None:
+                deadline = time.monotonic() + max(0.0, float(requested_limit))
+            remaining = deadline - time.monotonic()
+            if remaining <= 0 or not _POSIX_CGROUP_RUN_LOCK.acquire(timeout=remaining):
+                return EXIT_TIMEOUT, "", {
+                    "stdout_truncated": False,
+                    "stderr_truncated": False,
+                    "timed_out": True,
+                    "capture_incomplete": False,
+                    "job_object": False,
+                    "skipped_by_deadline": True,
+                    "admission_wait_expired": True,
+                }
+            try:
+                remaining = deadline - time.monotonic()
+                if remaining <= 0:
+                    return EXIT_TIMEOUT, "", {
+                        "stdout_truncated": False,
+                        "stderr_truncated": False,
+                        "timed_out": True,
+                        "capture_incomplete": False,
+                        "job_object": False,
+                        "skipped_by_deadline": True,
+                        "admission_wait_expired": True,
+                    }
+                kwargs["_deadline_at"] = deadline
+                process_lock = _posix_cgroup_process_lock(deadline)
+                try:
+                    process_lock.__enter__()
+                except TimeoutError:
+                    return EXIT_TIMEOUT, "", {
+                        "stdout_truncated": False,
+                        "stderr_truncated": False,
+                        "timed_out": True,
+                        "capture_incomplete": False,
+                        "job_object": False,
+                        "skipped_by_deadline": True,
+                        "admission_wait_expired": True,
+                    }
+                except OSError as exc:
+                    return EXIT_CAPTURE_INCOMPLETE, "", {
+                        "stdout_truncated": False,
+                        "stderr_truncated": False,
+                        "timed_out": False,
+                        "capture_incomplete": True,
+                        "job_object": False,
+                        "posix_cgroup_refused": str(exc),
+                    }
+                try:
+                    return function(*args, **kwargs)
+                finally:
+                    process_lock.__exit__(None, None, None)
+            finally:
+                _POSIX_CGROUP_RUN_LOCK.release()
+        return function(*args, **kwargs)
+    return wrapped

+def _write_pipe_before_deadline(fd: int, data: bytes, deadline: float, proc) -> None:
+    """Send gate environment data without blocking beyond command admission time."""
+    os.set_blocking(fd, False)
+    view = memoryview(data)
+    while view:
+        if proc.poll() is not None:
+            raise OSError("POSIX exec gate exited before environment handoff")
+        remaining = deadline - time.monotonic()
+        if remaining <= 0:
+            raise subprocess.TimeoutExpired("POSIX exec gate", 0)
+        _readable, writable, _exceptional = select.select([], [fd], [], min(remaining, 0.05))
+        if not writable:
+            continue
+        try:
+            written = os.write(fd, view[:65536])
+        except BlockingIOError:
+            continue
+        if written <= 0:
+            raise OSError("POSIX exec gate environment pipe closed")
+        view = view[written:]

+class _DelegatedCgroup:
+    """A unique kill scope below the runner's delegated cgroup-v2 subtree."""
+
+    def __init__(self, path: str) -> None:
+        self.path = path
+        self._closed = False
+
+    @staticmethod
+    def _runner_parent() -> str:
+        with open("/proc/self/cgroup", encoding="ascii") as stream:
+            entries = [line.rstrip("\n").split(":", 2) for line in stream]
+        unified = next(
+            (entry[2] for entry in entries
+             if len(entry) == 3 and entry[:2] == ["0", ""]),
+            None,
+        )
+        if not unified or ".." in unified.split("/"):
+            raise OSError("unified cgroup-v2 delegation is unavailable")
+        parent = os.path.realpath(os.path.join("/sys/fs/cgroup", unified.lstrip("/")))
+        root = os.path.realpath("/sys/fs/cgroup")
+        if os.path.commonpath((root, parent)) != root:
+            raise OSError("runner cgroup path escaped the cgroup-v2 mount")
+        return parent
+
+    @classmethod
+    def reconcile_stale(cls, deadline: float) -> None:
+        """Remove only provably empty stale scopes; never kill or adopt them."""
+        parent = cls._runner_parent()
+        try:
+            entries = list(os.scandir(parent))
+        except OSError as exc:
+            raise OSError("cannot enumerate delegated cgroup before worker admission") from exc
+        for entry in entries:
+            if not entry.name.startswith("vst-command-"):
+                continue
+            if not re.fullmatch(r"vst-command-[0-9]+-[0-9a-f]{32}", entry.name):
+                raise OSError("unrecognized runner command cgroup blocks worker admission")
+            if entry.is_symlink() or not entry.is_dir(follow_symlinks=False):
+                raise OSError("runner command cgroup is not a real child cgroup")
+            path = os.path.realpath(entry.path)
+            if os.path.dirname(path) != parent or os.path.basename(path) != entry.name:
+                raise OSError("runner command cgroup escaped its delegated parent")
+            if time.monotonic() >= deadline:
+                raise OSError("stale-scope reconciliation deadline expired")
+            try:
+                with open(os.path.join(path, "cgroup.events"), encoding="ascii") as stream:
+                    events = dict(line.split() for line in stream if line.strip())
+                with open(os.path.join(path, "cgroup.procs"), encoding="ascii") as stream:
+                    pids = [line.strip() for line in stream if line.strip()]
+            except (OSError, ValueError) as exc:
+                raise OSError("stale command scope emptiness cannot be verified") from exc
+            if events.get("populated") != "0" or pids:
+                raise OSError("unknown or populated stale command scope blocks worker admission")
+            try:
+                os.rmdir(path)
+            except OSError as exc:
+                raise OSError("verified empty stale command scope could not be removed") from exc
+
+    @classmethod
+    def create(cls) -> "_DelegatedCgroup":
+        parent = cls._runner_parent()
+        path = os.path.join(parent, f"vst-command-{os.getpid()}-{uuid.uuid4().hex}")
+        os.mkdir(path, 0o700)
+        scope = cls(path)
+        try:
+            for name in ("cgroup.procs", "cgroup.events", "cgroup.kill"):
+                if not os.path.isfile(os.path.join(path, name)):
+                    raise OSError(f"delegated cgroup control is missing: {name}")
+            for name in ("cgroup.procs", "cgroup.kill"):
+                fd = os.open(os.path.join(path, name), os.O_WRONLY)
+                os.close(fd)
+        except BaseException:
+            try:
+                os.rmdir(path)
+            except OSError:
+                pass
+            raise
+        return scope
+
+    def attach(self, pid: int) -> None:
+        with open(os.path.join(self.path, "cgroup.procs"), "w", encoding="ascii") as stream:
+            stream.write(f"{pid}\n")
+
+    def kill_and_remove(self, timeout: float = 10.0) -> bool:
+        if self._closed:
+            return True
+        try:
+            with open(os.path.join(self.path, "cgroup.kill"), "w", encoding="ascii") as stream:
+                stream.write("1\n")
+            deadline = time.monotonic() + timeout
+            while time.monotonic() < deadline:
+                with open(os.path.join(self.path, "cgroup.events"), encoding="ascii") as stream:
+                    events = dict(line.split() for line in stream if line.strip())
+                if events.get("populated") == "0":
+                    os.rmdir(self.path)
+                    self._closed = True
+                    return True
+                time.sleep(0.02)
+        except (OSError, ValueError):
+            _POSIX_CGROUP_CLEANUP_FAILED.set()
+            return False
+        _POSIX_CGROUP_CLEANUP_FAILED.set()
+        return False

+def _resume_suspended_primary_thread(pid: int) -> bool:
+    """Resume a CREATE_SUSPENDED process using documented Win32 APIs.
+
+    The process has not executed user code and cannot create threads yet, so
+    its Toolhelp thread snapshot identifies the primary thread without using
+    CPython's private Popen handles or undocumented Windows APIs. The pinned
+    Python 3.14 subprocess implementation closes the CreateProcess thread
+    handle, so public Popen methods cannot resume it directly.
+    """
+    api = _win_api()
+    if api is None:
+        return False
+    k32 = api.k32
+    invalid_handle = api.ctypes.c_void_p(-1).value
+    snapshot = k32.CreateToolhelp32Snapshot(0x00000004, 0)  # TH32CS_SNAPTHREAD
+    if not snapshot or snapshot == invalid_handle:
+        return False
+    thread = None
+    try:
+        entry = api.ThreadEntry32()
+        entry.dwSize = api.ctypes.sizeof(entry)
+        more = bool(k32.Thread32First(snapshot, api.ctypes.byref(entry)))
+        while more:
+            if entry.th32OwnerProcessID == pid:
+                thread = k32.OpenThread(0x0002, False, entry.th32ThreadID)  # THREAD_SUSPEND_RESUME
+                break
+            more = bool(k32.Thread32Next(snapshot, api.ctypes.byref(entry)))
+        if not thread:
+            return False
+        # The process was created with exactly one suspend count. Any other
+        # result means it did not enter the expected state; fail closed.
+        return k32.ResumeThread(thread) == 1
+    except Exception:  # noqa: BLE001 - strict callers refuse on API failure
+        return False
+    finally:
+        if thread:
+            k32.CloseHandle(thread)
+        k32.CloseHandle(snapshot)
+

+def _git_bytes(cwd: str, *args: str) -> bytes:
+    try:
+        result = subprocess.run(
+            ["git", *args], cwd=cwd, stdin=subprocess.DEVNULL,
+            stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.PIPE, shell=False,
+            timeout=10, check=False,
+        )
+    except (OSError, subprocess.TimeoutExpired) as exc:
+        raise ContractError(f"cannot derive repository evidence: {exc}") from exc
+    if result.returncode != 0:
+        raise ContractError("git evidence command failed")
+    return result.stdout

+def _derive_head(cwd: str) -> str:

+def _diff_paths(cwd: str, base_head: str) -> tuple[bytes, list[str], list[tuple[str, str]], list[str]]:
+    raw = _git_bytes(cwd, "diff", "--binary", "--find-renames", base_head, "--")
+    ordinary_raw = _git_bytes(cwd, "ls-files", "--others", "--exclude-standard", "-z")
+    ignored_raw = _git_bytes(cwd, "ls-files", "--others", "--ignored", "--exclude-standard", "-z")
+    # Inventory both classes explicitly: ignored files remain part of the diff evidence.
+    ordinary = ordinary_raw.decode("utf-8", "surrogateescape").split("\0")
+    ignored = ignored_raw.decode("utf-8", "surrogateescape").split("\0")
+    untracked = sorted({path for path in (*ordinary, *ignored) if path})
+    for path in untracked:
+        full_path = os.path.join(cwd, path)
+        if os.path.islink(full_path):
+            continue
+        if not os.path.isfile(full_path):
+            raise ContractError("untracked candidate contains a non-regular filesystem object")
+        mode = os.stat(full_path, follow_symlinks=False).st_mode & 0o777
+        raw += b"\0VST-UNTRACKED\0" + path.encode("utf-8", "surrogateescape") + b"\0"
+        raw += mode.to_bytes(2, "big")
+        with open(full_path, "rb") as handle:
+            data = handle.read()
+        raw += hashlib.sha256(data).digest() + len(data).to_bytes(8, "big") + data
+    names = _git_bytes(cwd, "diff", "--name-status", "-z", "--find-renames", base_head, "--")
+    fields = names.decode("utf-8", "surrogateescape").split("\0")
+    changed: list[str] = list(untracked)
+    renames: list[tuple[str, str]] = []
+    i = 0
+    while i < len(fields) and fields[i]:
+        status = fields[i]
+        i += 1
+        if status.startswith("R") or status.startswith("C"):
+            if i + 1 >= len(fields):
+                raise ContractError("malformed git rename evidence")
+            source, target = fields[i], fields[i + 1]
+            i += 2
+            changed.append(target)
+            renames.append((source, target))
+        else:
+            if i >= len(fields):
+                raise ContractError("malformed git path evidence")
+            changed.append(fields[i])
+            i += 1
+    raw_names = _git_bytes(cwd, "diff", "--raw", "-z", "--find-renames", base_head, "--")
+    raw_fields = raw_names.decode("utf-8", "surrogateescape").split("\0")
+    symlinks: set[str] = set()
+    i = 0
+    while i < len(raw_fields) and raw_fields[i]:
+        metadata = raw_fields[i].split()
+        i += 1
+        if len(metadata) < 5 or i >= len(raw_fields):
+            raise ContractError("malformed raw git mode evidence")
+        first = raw_fields[i]
+        i += 1
+        second = None
+        if metadata[4].startswith(("R", "C")):
+            if i >= len(raw_fields):
+                raise ContractError("malformed raw git rename evidence")
+            second = raw_fields[i]
+            i += 1
+        if metadata[0].lstrip(":") == "120000" or metadata[1] == "120000":
+            symlinks.add(first)
+            if second is not None:
+                symlinks.add(second)
+    symlinks.update(path for path in changed if os.path.islink(os.path.join(cwd, path)))
+    return raw, changed, renames, sorted(symlinks)

+    for name, value in (("slot", slot), ("resolved_model", resolved_model),

+        raise ContractError("cwd must be an existing repository directory")
+    if os.name != "posix":
+        raise ContractError("v2 worker execution requires a POSIX identity boundary")
+    if (not isinstance(worker_uid, int) or isinstance(worker_uid, bool) or worker_uid < 1 or
+            not isinstance(worker_gid, int) or isinstance(worker_gid, bool) or worker_gid < 1):
+        raise ContractError("worker_uid and worker_gid must be positive POSIX ids")
+    if (worker_uid, worker_gid) != (999, 989) or (os.geteuid(), os.getegid()) != (997, 988):
+        raise ContractError("POSIX manifest execution requires the fixed vst-runner to vst-worker helper")
+    if (not isinstance(worker_exec_helper_path, str)
+            or not _POSIX_WORKER_EXEC_HELPER_PATH.fullmatch(worker_exec_helper_path)
+            or not isinstance(worker_exec_helper_head, str)
+            or not _POSIX_WORKER_EXEC_HELPER_HEAD.fullmatch(worker_exec_helper_head)
+            or worker_exec_helper_path != _POSIX_WORKER_EXEC_HELPER_PREFIX + worker_exec_helper_head
+            or not callable(verify_worker_exec_helper)):
+        raise ContractError("manifest execution requires the exact helper path for its full configured build head")
+    require_distinct_worker_identity(worker_uid)
+    require_runner_can_access_signer(signer_socket)
+    require_worker_cannot_access_signer(signer_socket, worker_uid=worker_uid, worker_gid=worker_gid)
+    _req_int(attempt, "attempt", 1, MAX_COUNTER)
+    _req_int(epoch, "epoch", 1, MAX_COUNTER)
+    if prev_receipt_sha256 is not None:
+        _req_hex(prev_receipt_sha256, "prev_receipt_sha256", 64)
+    if attempt == 1 and prev_receipt_sha256 is not None:
+        raise ContractError("prev_receipt_sha256 must be null when attempt == 1")
+    slot_types = {entry["slot"]: entry["receipt_type"] for entry in valid["required_receipts"]}
+    if slot_types.get(slot) != "TestRun":
+        raise ContractError("slot is not a TestRun slot in the manifest")
+    manifest_hash = manifest_sha256(valid)
+    pinned = [item for item in valid["mandatory_commands"] if item["slot"] == slot]
+    if not pinned:
+        raise ContractError("manifest has no mandatory commands for this slot")
+    argvs = [item["argv"] for item in pinned]
+    required_ids = sorted(item["test_id"] for item in valid["required_tests"] if item["slot"] == slot)
+    acceptance = sorted({a for item in valid["required_tests"] if item["slot"] == slot for a in item["acceptance"]})
+    limit = valid["timeout_sec"]
+    per_command = limit if timeout_sec is None else _req_int(timeout_sec, "timeout_sec", 1, limit)
+    deadline = limit if deadline_sec is None else _req_int(deadline_sec, "deadline_sec", 1, limit)
+    _req_int(max_output_bytes, "max_output_bytes", 1, MAX_OUTPUT_BYTES_LIMIT)
+    paths = [] if artifact_paths is None else artifact_paths
+    _req_str_list(paths, "artifact_paths", unique=True)
+    for path in paths:
+        _validate_repo_path(path, f"artifact_paths[{path!r}]")
+        if contained_artifact_path(cwd, path) is None:
+            raise ContractError(f"artifact path escapes run directory: {path!r}")
+    env = build_environment(_check_env(extra_env))
+    request_id = execution_authority.grant.get("request_id")
+    _req_str(request_id, "authorized request_id")
+    replay = execution_authority.authorize_and_claim({
+        "manifest_sha256": manifest_hash, "task_id": valid["task_id"], "slot": slot,
+        "attempt": attempt, "epoch": epoch, "run_id": run_id,
+        "invocation_id": invocation_id, "request_id": request_id,
+        "runner_id": runner_id, "resolved_model": resolved_model,
+        "model_provenance_sha256": model_provenance_sha256,
+        "execution_deadline_sec": deadline,
+        "service_generation": execution_authority.service_generation,
+    })
+    if replay is not None:
+        return validate_receipt(replay)
+    authorize_runner_over_socket(signer_socket, grant=execution_authority.grant)
+    deadline_at = time.monotonic() + deadline
+    commands: list[dict] = []
+    parser_results: list[dict] = []
+    infos: list[dict] = []
+    stop_after_capture_incomplete = False
+    reservation_confirmed = False
+    command_launch_deadline = deadline_at
+
+    def verify_and_reserve_before_spawn() -> None:
+        nonlocal reservation_confirmed
+        if time.monotonic() >= command_launch_deadline:
+            raise ContractError("command deadline expired before child launch")
+        if not reservation_confirmed:
+            execution_authority.reserve()
+            reservation_confirmed = True
+        if time.monotonic() >= command_launch_deadline:
+            raise ContractError("command deadline expired after launch reservation")
+        verify_worker_exec_helper()
+
+    for item in pinned:
+        parser_key = (item["parser_id"], item["parser_version"], item["parser_sha256"])
+        parser = TRUSTED_PARSER_CATALOG.get(parser_key)
+        if parser is None:
+            raise ContractError("manifest parser is not present in trusted built-in catalog")
+        now = time.monotonic()
+        remaining = deadline_at - now
+        if stop_after_capture_incomplete:
+            exit_code, stdout = EXIT_CAPTURE_INCOMPLETE, ""
+            info = {
+                "stdout_truncated": False, "stderr_truncated": False,
+                "timed_out": False, "capture_incomplete": True,
+                "job_object": False, "skipped_by_deadline": False,
+                "skipped_after_capture_incomplete": True,
+            }
+        elif remaining <= 0:
+            exit_code, stdout = EXIT_TIMEOUT, ""
+            info = {"stdout_truncated": False, "stderr_truncated": False, "timed_out": False,
+                    "capture_incomplete": False, "job_object": False, "skipped_by_deadline": True}
+        else:
+            command_launch_deadline = min(deadline_at, now + float(per_command))
+            exit_code, stdout, info = _run_one(
+                item["argv"], cwd, min(float(per_command), remaining), env,
+                max_output_bytes, require_job_object=True,
+                worker_uid=worker_uid, worker_gid=worker_gid,
+                worker_exec_helper_path=worker_exec_helper_path,
+                _deadline_at=min(deadline_at, now + float(per_command)),
+                _before_spawn=verify_and_reserve_before_spawn,
+            )
+            if not info.get("admission_wait_expired"):
+                info["skipped_by_deadline"] = False
+        parsed = parser(stdout)
+        if (not isinstance(parsed, tuple) or len(parsed) != 3 or
+                any(not isinstance(group, list) or any(not isinstance(x, str) for x in group) for group in parsed)):
+            raise ContractError("trusted parser returned invalid typed results")
+        executed, skipped, xfail = parsed
+        commands.append({"argv": list(item["argv"]), "exit_code": exit_code})
+        parser_results.append({
+            "argv": list(item["argv"]), "parser_id": item["parser_id"],
+            "parser_version": item["parser_version"], "parser_sha256": item["parser_sha256"],
+            "parser_result": {"executed_test_ids": executed, "skipped_test_ids": skipped,
+                              "xfail_test_ids": xfail},
+        })
+        infos.append(info)
+        if exit_code == EXIT_CAPTURE_INCOMPLETE or info["capture_incomplete"]:
+            stop_after_capture_incomplete = True
+    if not reservation_confirmed:
+        raise ContractError(
+            "no command reached its launch path before the deadline; refusing an unreserved receipt"
+        )
+    candidate_head = _derive_head(cwd)
+    executed_all = [test_id for result in parser_results for test_id in result["parser_result"]["executed_test_ids"]]
+    skipped_all = [test_id for result in parser_results for test_id in result["parser_result"]["skipped_test_ids"]]
+    xfail_all = [test_id for result in parser_results for test_id in result["parser_result"]["xfail_test_ids"]]
+    digests = _hash_artifacts(paths, cwd)
+    diff_bytes, changed, renames, symlinks = _diff_paths(cwd, valid["base_head"])
+    diff = git_diff_evidence(cwd, valid, candidate_head, diff_bytes, changed,
+                             symlink_paths=symlinks, rename_pairs=renames)
+    diff["signature"] = sign_diff_over_socket(
+        signer_socket, f"{request_id}:diff", {k: v for k, v in diff.items()},
+        execution_grant=execution_authority.grant,
+    )
+    request = {
+        "request_id": request_id, "task_id": valid["task_id"], "slot": slot,
+        "attempt": attempt, "epoch": epoch, "manifest_sha256": manifest_hash,
+        "candidate_head": candidate_head, "commands": commands,
+        "parser_results": parser_results, "artifact_digests": digests,
+    }
+    request_sig = sign_over_socket(
+        signer_socket, request, execution_grant=execution_authority.grant
+    )
+    receipt = {
+        "contract_version": 2,
+        "receipt_id": f"{valid['task_id']}:{slot}:{attempt}:{invocation_id}",
+        "receipt_type": "TestRun", "task_id": valid["task_id"],
+        "manifest_sha256": manifest_hash, "slot": slot, "attempt": attempt,
+        "prev_receipt_sha256": prev_receipt_sha256, "candidate_head": candidate_head,
+        "epoch": epoch, "runner_id": runner_id, "role_sha256": valid["role_sha256"],
+        "resolved_model": resolved_model, "invocation_id": invocation_id,
+        "result": "FAIL", "created_at": created_at, "expected_test_ids": required_ids,
+        "executed_test_ids": executed_all, "skipped_test_ids": skipped_all,
+        "xfail_test_ids": xfail_all, "commands": commands,
+        "covered_acceptance": acceptance, "artifact_digests": digests,
+        "parser_results": parser_results, "diff_gate": diff,
+        "runner_attestation": {"request": request, "signature": request_sig},
+        "signature": request_sig,
+    }
+    receipt["result"] = derive_result(receipt)
+    validated_receipt = validate_receipt(receipt)
+    execution_authority.complete(validated_receipt)
+    if report is not None:
+        report["commands"] = infos
+        report["capture_incomplete"] = any(info["capture_incomplete"] for info in infos)
+        report["candidate_head"] = candidate_head
+        report["diff_gate"] = diff
+    return validated_receipt

+"""Root-only systemd predecessor fence for the persistent runner unit.
+
+The helper is intended for a fixed root-owned ExecStartPre/ExecStopPost wrapper.
+It never kills a process. Unknown or populated scopes leave the ledger
+UNVERIFIED and prevent the next generation from starting.
+"""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import fcntl
+import hashlib
+import json
+import os
+import re
+import signal
+import socket
+import stat
+import subprocess
+import sys
+import time
+from datetime import datetime, timezone
+from typing import Any
+
+from .contracts import ContractError, canonical_bytes
+
+DEFAULT_CONFIG = "/etc/vst-runner/fence.json"
+_COMMAND_SCOPE = re.compile(r"^vst-command-[0-9]+-[0-9a-f]{32}$")
+_UNIT_NAME = re.compile(r"^[A-Za-z0-9_.@:-]+\.service$")
+_RECORD_FIELDS = frozenset({
+    "version", "state", "unit", "invocation_id", "control_group",
+    "cgroup_device", "cgroup_inode", "lock_device", "lock_inode",
+    "generation", "predecessor_outcome", "sequence", "recorded_at",
+    "previous_record_sha256", "record_sha256",
+})
+
+
+def _unique_pairs(pairs: list[tuple[str, Any]]) -> dict[str, Any]:
+    result: dict[str, Any] = {}
+    for key, value in pairs:
+        if key in result:
+            raise ContractError("duplicate JSON key in runner fence record")
+        result[key] = value
+    return result
+
+
+def _load_root_json(path: str, max_bytes: int = 65536) -> dict:
+    if os.name != "posix" or not os.path.isabs(path):
+        raise ContractError("runner fence config path must be absolute on POSIX")
+    parent = os.path.dirname(path)
+    while True:
+        info = os.stat(parent, follow_symlinks=False)
+        if not stat.S_ISDIR(info.st_mode) or info.st_uid != 0 or info.st_mode & 0o022:
+            raise ContractError("runner fence config directory is not root-controlled")
+        if parent == "/":
+            break
+        parent = os.path.dirname(parent)
+    fd = os.open(path, os.O_RDONLY | os.O_NOFOLLOW)
+    try:
+        info = os.fstat(fd)
+        if (not stat.S_ISREG(info.st_mode) or info.st_uid != 0
+                or info.st_mode & 0o022 or info.st_size > max_bytes):
+            raise ContractError("runner fence config is not a bounded root-owned regular file")
+        raw = bytearray()
+        while len(raw) <= max_bytes:
+            part = os.read(fd, min(65536, max_bytes + 1 - len(raw)))
+            if not part:
+                break
+            raw.extend(part)
+        if len(raw) > max_bytes:
+            raise ContractError("runner fence config exceeds its size limit")
+    finally:
+        os.close(fd)
+    value = json.loads(raw, object_pairs_hook=_unique_pairs)
+    if not isinstance(value, dict):
+        raise ContractError("runner fence config must be a JSON object")
+    return value
+
+
+def _validate_config(config: dict) -> None:
+    required = {
+        "unit_name", "systemctl_path", "ledger_path", "runtime_dir", "daemon_uid",
+        "daemon_gid", "dispatcher_uid", "dispatcher_gid", "worker_uid", "worker_gid",
+        "control_group", "generation_record_path",
+    }
+    if set(config) != required:
+        raise ContractError("runner fence configuration fields do not match its schema")
+    if config["unit_name"] != "vst-runner.service":
+        raise ContractError("runner fence accepts only the fixed vst-runner.service unit")
+    for name in ("systemctl_path", "ledger_path", "runtime_dir", "generation_record_path"):
+        if not isinstance(config[name], str) or not os.path.isabs(config[name]):
+            raise ContractError(f"runner fence {name} must be an absolute path")
+    if not isinstance(config["control_group"], str):
+        raise ContractError("runner fence cgroup identity is invalid")
+    group = config["control_group"]
+    if (not group.startswith("/") or group == "/" or ".." in group.split("/")
+            or os.path.normpath(group) != group):
+        raise ContractError("runner fence cgroup identity is not normalized")
+    if group != "/system.slice/vst-runner.service" or config["systemctl_path"] != "/usr/bin/systemctl":
+        raise ContractError("runner fence manager and service cgroup must match the fixed unit")
+    ids = [config[name] for name in (
+        "daemon_uid", "daemon_gid", "dispatcher_uid", "dispatcher_gid", "worker_uid", "worker_gid",
+    )]
+    if any(type(value) is not int or value < 1 for value in ids):
+        raise ContractError("runner fence role identities must be positive integers")
+    if len({config["daemon_uid"], config["dispatcher_uid"], config["worker_uid"]}) != 3:
+        raise ContractError("runner fence role UIDs must be distinct")
+    if config["generation_record_path"] == config["ledger_path"]:
+        raise ContractError("runner fence public snapshot and private ledger must be separate")
+    for path in (config["systemctl_path"], config["ledger_path"],
+                 config["generation_record_path"]):
+        parent = os.path.dirname(path)
+        while True:
+            info = os.stat(parent, follow_symlinks=False)
+            if not stat.S_ISDIR(info.st_mode) or info.st_uid != 0 or info.st_mode & 0o022:
+                raise ContractError("runner fence privileged path has an uncontrolled directory")
+            if parent == "/":
+                break
+            parent = os.path.dirname(parent)
+
+
+def _ensure_root_directory(path: str, *, mode: int = 0o700) -> None:
+    info = os.stat(path, follow_symlinks=False)
+    if (not stat.S_ISDIR(info.st_mode) or info.st_uid != 0
+            or stat.S_IMODE(info.st_mode) != mode):
+        raise ContractError("runner fence state directory has unsafe owner or mode")
+
+
+def _manager_unit(config: dict, *, allow_inactive: bool = False) -> tuple[str, str]:
+    executable = config["systemctl_path"]
+    info = os.stat(executable, follow_symlinks=False)
+    if (not stat.S_ISREG(info.st_mode) or info.st_uid != 0 or info.st_mode & 0o022
+            or not info.st_mode & 0o111):
+        raise ContractError("systemctl executable is not root-controlled")
+    parent = os.path.dirname(executable)
+    while True:
+        directory = os.stat(parent, follow_symlinks=False)
+        if (not stat.S_ISDIR(directory.st_mode) or directory.st_uid != 0
+                or directory.st_mode & 0o022):
+            raise ContractError("systemctl executable path has an uncontrolled directory")
+        if parent == "/":
+            break
+        parent = os.path.dirname(parent)
+    try:
+        result = subprocess.run(
+            [executable, "show", config["unit_name"], "--property=InvocationID",
+             "--property=ControlGroup", "--no-pager"],
+            cwd="/", env={"LC_ALL": "C", "PATH": ""}, stdin=subprocess.DEVNULL,
+            stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.DEVNULL, close_fds=True,
+            timeout=5, check=False,
+        )
+    except (OSError, subprocess.SubprocessError) as exc:
+        raise ContractError("systemd manager identity query failed") from exc
+    if result.returncode != 0:
+        raise ContractError("systemd manager refused unit identity query")
+    values: dict[str, str] = {}
+    try:
+        for line in result.stdout.decode("ascii").splitlines():
+            name, value = line.split("=", 1)
+            if name in values or name not in {"InvocationID", "ControlGroup"}:
+                raise ValueError("unexpected manager property")
+            values[name] = value
+    except (UnicodeDecodeError, ValueError) as exc:
+        raise ContractError("systemd manager returned malformed unit identity") from exc
+    invocation = values.get("InvocationID", "")
+    control_group = values.get("ControlGroup", "")
+    if allow_inactive and invocation == "" and control_group == "":
+        return invocation, control_group
+    if (not re.fullmatch(r"[0-9a-f]{32}", invocation)
+            or not control_group.startswith("/") or ".." in control_group.split("/")):
+        raise ContractError("systemd unit has no valid invocation or cgroup identity")
+    return invocation, control_group
+
+
+def _cgroup_path(control_group: str) -> str:
+    root = os.path.realpath("/sys/fs/cgroup")
+    path = os.path.realpath(os.path.join(root, control_group.lstrip("/")))
+    if os.path.commonpath((root, path)) != root:
+        raise ContractError("systemd cgroup escaped the unified hierarchy")
+    info = os.stat(path, follow_symlinks=False)
+    if not stat.S_ISDIR(info.st_mode):
+        raise ContractError("systemd ControlGroup is not a cgroup directory")
+    return path
+
+
+def _current_cgroup() -> str:
+    with open("/proc/self/cgroup", encoding="ascii") as stream:
+        rows = [line.rstrip("\n").split(":", 2) for line in stream]
+    path = next((row[2] for row in rows if len(row) == 3 and row[:2] == ["0", ""]), None)
+    if not path or ".." in path.split("/"):
+        raise ContractError("runner fence helper is not in a unified cgroup")
+    return os.path.normpath(path)
+
+
+def _read_populated(path: str) -> tuple[str, list[str]]:
+    try:
+        with open(os.path.join(path, "cgroup.events"), encoding="ascii") as stream:
+            events = dict(line.split() for line in stream if line.strip())
+        with open(os.path.join(path, "cgroup.procs"), encoding="ascii") as stream:
+            pids = [line.strip() for line in stream if line.strip()]
+    except (OSError, ValueError) as exc:
+        raise ContractError("runner cgroup population cannot be verified") from exc
+    populated = events.get("populated")
+    if populated not in {"0", "1"}:
+        raise ContractError("runner cgroup population record is malformed")
+    if any(not pid.isdecimal() or int(pid) < 1 for pid in pids) or len(pids) != len(set(pids)):
+        raise ContractError("runner cgroup process inventory is malformed")
+    return populated, pids
+
+
+def _child_cgroup_directories(path: str) -> list[os.DirEntry[str]]:
+    try:
+        entries = list(os.scandir(path))
+    except OSError as exc:
+        raise ContractError("runner cgroup children cannot be inventoried") from exc
+    children = []
+    for entry in entries:
+        if entry.is_symlink():
+            raise ContractError("runner cgroup contains an unexpected symlink")
+        if entry.is_dir(follow_symlinks=False):
+            children.append(entry)
+    return children
+
+
+def _remove_empty_command_scopes(parent: str, current_pid: int) -> None:
+    populated, pids = _read_populated(parent)
+    if str(current_pid) not in pids or any(pid != str(current_pid) for pid in pids):
+        raise ContractError("runner service cgroup has unknown processes")
+    for entry in _child_cgroup_directories(parent):
+        if not _COMMAND_SCOPE.fullmatch(entry.name):
+            raise ContractError("unknown child cgroup blocks runner lifecycle admission")
+        if entry.is_symlink() or not entry.is_dir(follow_symlinks=False):
+            raise ContractError("runner command scope is not a real cgroup")
+        scope = os.path.join(parent, entry.name)
+        if os.path.dirname(os.path.realpath(scope)) != parent:
+            raise ContractError("runner command scope escaped its unit cgroup")
+        scope_populated, scope_pids = _read_populated(scope)
+        if scope_populated != "0" or scope_pids:
+            raise ContractError("populated runner command scope blocks restart; no process was killed")
+        try:
+            os.rmdir(scope)
+        except OSError as exc:
+            raise ContractError("empty runner command scope could not be removed") from exc
+    if populated != "1":
+        raise ContractError("runner lifecycle helper is missing from the unit cgroup")
+
+
+def _hash_record(record_without_hash: dict) -> str:
+    return hashlib.sha256(canonical_bytes(record_without_hash)).hexdigest()
+
+
+def _read_records(path: str) -> list[dict]:
+    try:
+        fd = os.open(path, os.O_RDONLY | os.O_NOFOLLOW)
+    except FileNotFoundError:
+        return []
+    except OSError as exc:
+        raise ContractError("runner fence ledger is unavailable") from exc
+    try:
+        info = os.fstat(fd)
+        if (not stat.S_ISREG(info.st_mode) or info.st_uid != 0
+                or stat.S_IMODE(info.st_mode) != 0o600 or info.st_size > 4 * 1024 * 1024):
+            raise ContractError("runner fence ledger has unsafe owner, mode, or size")
+        chunks = bytearray()
+        while len(chunks) <= 4 * 1024 * 1024:
+            part = os.read(fd, min(65536, 4 * 1024 * 1024 + 1 - len(chunks)))
+            if not part:
+                break
+            chunks.extend(part)
+        if len(chunks) > 4 * 1024 * 1024 or (chunks and not chunks.endswith(b"\n")):
+            raise ContractError("runner fence ledger is oversized or has a partial tail")
+    finally:
+        os.close(fd)
+    records = []
+    previous_hash = "0" * 64
+    for expected_sequence, line in enumerate(chunks.splitlines(), start=1):
+        record = json.loads(line, object_pairs_hook=_unique_pairs)
+        if not isinstance(record, dict) or set(record) != _RECORD_FIELDS:
+            raise ContractError("runner fence ledger record has unknown or missing fields")
+        body = {key: value for key, value in record.items() if key != "record_sha256"}
+        if (record.get("sequence") != expected_sequence
+                or record.get("previous_record_sha256") != previous_hash
+                or record.get("record_sha256") != _hash_record(body)):
+            raise ContractError("runner fence ledger hash chain is invalid")
+        if record.get("state") not in {"BOOTSTRAP_EMPTY", "RUNNING", "STOPPED_EMPTY", "UNVERIFIED"}:
+            raise ContractError("runner fence ledger contains an unknown lifecycle state")
+        records.append(record)
+        previous_hash = record["record_sha256"]
+    return records
+
+
+def _append_record(path: str, record: dict) -> dict:
+    previous = _read_records(path)
+    previous_hash = "0" * 64 if not previous else previous[-1]["record_sha256"]
+    body = {**record, "sequence": len(previous) + 1,
+            "previous_record_sha256": previous_hash}
+    full = {**body, "record_sha256": _hash_record(body)}
+    encoded = canonical_bytes(full) + b"\n"
+    fd = os.open(path, os.O_WRONLY | os.O_APPEND | os.O_CREAT | os.O_NOFOLLOW, 0o600)
+    try:
+        info = os.fstat(fd)
+        if (not stat.S_ISREG(info.st_mode) or info.st_uid != 0
+                or stat.S_IMODE(info.st_mode) != 0o600):
+            raise ContractError("runner fence ledger is not root-only")
+        view = memoryview(encoded)
+        while view:
+            written = os.write(fd, view)
+            if written <= 0:
+                raise ContractError("runner fence ledger append was incomplete")
+            view = view[written:]
+        os.fsync(fd)
+    finally:
+        os.close(fd)
+    return full
+
+
+def _publish_generation(config: dict, record: dict) -> None:
+    """Atomically publish a read-only generation snapshot to the runner UID."""
+    path = config["generation_record_path"]
+    parent = os.path.dirname(path)
+    current = parent
+    while True:
+        info = os.stat(current, follow_symlinks=False)
+        if not stat.S_ISDIR(info.st_mode) or info.st_uid != 0 or info.st_mode & 0o022:
+            raise ContractError("runner generation directory is not root-controlled")
+        if current == "/":
+            break
+        current = os.path.dirname(current)
+    temp_path = f"{path}.tmp-{os.getpid()}"
+    fd = os.open(temp_path, os.O_WRONLY | os.O_CREAT | os.O_EXCL | os.O_NOFOLLOW, 0o644)
+    try:
+        os.fchown(fd, 0, 0)
+        os.fchmod(fd, 0o644)
+        data = canonical_bytes(record)
+        view = memoryview(data)
+        while view:
+            written = os.write(fd, view)
+            if written <= 0:
+                raise ContractError("runner generation snapshot write was incomplete")
+            view = view[written:]
+        os.fsync(fd)
+    except BaseException:
+        os.close(fd)
+        try:
+            os.unlink(temp_path)
+        except OSError:
+            pass
+        raise
+    else:
+        os.close(fd)
+    os.replace(temp_path, path)
+    dir_fd = os.open(parent, os.O_RDONLY | getattr(os, "O_DIRECTORY", 0))
+    try:
+        os.fsync(dir_fd)
+    finally:
+        os.close(dir_fd)
+
+
+def _lock_path(path: str):
+    lock_path = path + ".lock"
+    fd = os.open(lock_path, os.O_RDWR | os.O_CREAT | os.O_NOFOLLOW, 0o600)
+    info = os.fstat(fd)
+    if (not stat.S_ISREG(info.st_mode) or info.st_uid != 0
+            or stat.S_IMODE(info.st_mode) != 0o600):
+        os.close(fd)
+        raise ContractError("runner fence lock is not root-only")
+    fcntl.flock(fd, fcntl.LOCK_EX)
+    return fd
+
+
+def _base_record(config: dict, *, state: str, invocation: str, control_group: str,
+                 cgroup_stat: os.stat_result | None, lock_stat: os.stat_result | None,
+                 generation: str, predecessor: str) -> dict:
+    return {
+        "version": 1, "state": state, "unit": config["unit_name"],
+        "invocation_id": invocation, "control_group": control_group,
+        "cgroup_device": -1 if cgroup_stat is None else cgroup_stat.st_dev,
+        "cgroup_inode": -1 if cgroup_stat is None else cgroup_stat.st_ino,
+        "lock_device": -1 if lock_stat is None else lock_stat.st_dev,
+        "lock_inode": -1 if lock_stat is None else lock_stat.st_ino,
+        "generation": generation, "predecessor_outcome": predecessor,
+        "recorded_at": datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(),
+    }
+
+
+def _ensure_runtime_and_lock(config: dict) -> os.stat_result:
+    runtime = config["runtime_dir"]
+    info = os.stat(runtime, follow_symlinks=False)
+    if (not stat.S_ISDIR(info.st_mode) or info.st_uid != config["daemon_uid"]
+            or info.st_gid not in {config["daemon_gid"], config["dispatcher_gid"]}
+            or stat.S_IMODE(info.st_mode) not in {0o700, 0o710}):
+        raise ContractError("runner runtime directory identity or mode is invalid")
+    os.chown(runtime, config["daemon_uid"], config["dispatcher_gid"])
+    os.chmod(runtime, 0o710)
+    lock_path = os.path.join(runtime, "cgroup-admission.lock")
+    fd = os.open(lock_path, os.O_RDWR | os.O_CREAT | os.O_NOFOLLOW, 0o600)
+    try:
+        os.fchown(fd, config["daemon_uid"], config["daemon_gid"])
+        os.fchmod(fd, 0o600)
+        lock_stat = os.fstat(fd)
+        if not stat.S_ISREG(lock_stat.st_mode) or lock_stat.st_uid != config["daemon_uid"]:
+            raise ContractError("runner admission lock identity is invalid")
+        return lock_stat
+    finally:
+        os.close(fd)
+
+
+def _capture_manager_identity(config: dict) -> tuple[str, str, str, os.stat_result]:
+    invocation, cgroup = _manager_unit(config)
+    if _current_cgroup() != cgroup:
+        raise ContractError("runner fence helper is not executing inside the manager ControlGroup")
+    cgroup_path = _cgroup_path(cgroup)
+    _remove_empty_command_scopes(cgroup_path, os.getpid())
+    lock_stat = _ensure_runtime_and_lock(config)
+    return invocation, cgroup, cgroup_path, lock_stat
+
+
+def _transition(config: dict, operation: str) -> dict:
+    ledger = config["ledger_path"]
+    _ensure_root_directory(os.path.dirname(ledger))
+    lock_fd = _lock_path(ledger)
+    try:
+        prior = _read_records(ledger)
+        invocation = "UNKNOWN"
+        control_group = "UNKNOWN"
+        cgroup_stat = None
+        lock_stat = None
+        try:
+            invocation, control_group, cgroup_path, lock_stat = _capture_manager_identity(config)
+            cgroup_stat = os.stat(cgroup_path, follow_symlinks=False)
+            if os.geteuid() != 0:
+                raise ContractError("runner lifecycle helper must run as root")
+            if operation == "start":
+                if not prior or prior[-1]["state"] not in {"BOOTSTRAP_EMPTY", "STOPPED_EMPTY"}:
+                    raise ContractError("runner predecessor is not verified empty")
+                if prior[-1]["unit"] != config["unit_name"]:
+                    raise ContractError("runner fence ledger belongs to a different unit")
+                if prior[-1]["state"] == "STOPPED_EMPTY":
+                    if (prior[-1]["lock_device"] != lock_stat.st_dev
+                            or prior[-1]["lock_inode"] != lock_stat.st_ino):
+                        raise ContractError("runner admission lock identity changed across restart")
+                if prior[-1]["generation"] == invocation:
+                    raise ContractError("runner service generation must change for every restart")
+                record = _append_record(
+                    ledger, _base_record(
+                        config, state="RUNNING", invocation=invocation,
+                        control_group=control_group, cgroup_stat=cgroup_stat,
+                        lock_stat=lock_stat, generation=invocation,
+                        predecessor=prior[-1]["state"],
+                    ),
+                )
+                _publish_generation(config, record)
+                return record
+            if operation != "stop":
+                raise ContractError("runner fence operation is unsupported")
+            if (not prior or prior[-1]["state"] != "RUNNING"
+                    or prior[-1]["invocation_id"] != invocation
+                    or prior[-1]["generation"] != invocation
+                    or prior[-1]["unit"] != config["unit_name"]):
+                raise ContractError("ExecStopPost has no exact matching RUNNING predecessor")
+            if (prior[-1]["lock_device"] != lock_stat.st_dev
+                    or prior[-1]["lock_inode"] != lock_stat.st_ino):
+                raise ContractError("runner lock identity changed during one service generation")
+            record = _append_record(
+                ledger, _base_record(
+                    config, state="STOPPED_EMPTY", invocation=invocation,
+                    control_group=control_group, cgroup_stat=cgroup_stat,
+                    lock_stat=lock_stat, generation=invocation,
+                    predecessor="RUNNING",
+                ),
+            )
+            _publish_generation(config, record)
+            return record
+        except BaseException:
+            # An UNVERIFIED append can only make restart more restrictive. If it
+            # fails, the preceding RUNNING/STOPPED state still prevents a false
+            # clean transition on the next start.
+            try:
+                unverified = _append_record(
+                    ledger, _base_record(
+                        config, state="UNVERIFIED", invocation=invocation,
+                        control_group=control_group, cgroup_stat=cgroup_stat,
+                        lock_stat=lock_stat, generation=invocation,
+                        predecessor="UNKNOWN" if not prior else prior[-1]["state"],
+                    ),
+                )
+                _publish_generation(config, unverified)
+            except BaseException:
+                pass
+            raise
+    finally:
+        os.close(lock_fd)
+
+
+def bootstrap_empty(config_path: str = DEFAULT_CONFIG) -> dict:
+    """Create the one-time baseline only after process and cgroup inventory is empty."""
+    config = _load_root_json(config_path)
+    _validate_config(config)
+    if os.geteuid() != 0:
+        raise ContractError("runner bootstrap inventory must run as root")
+    ledger = config["ledger_path"]
+    _ensure_root_directory(os.path.dirname(ledger))
+    lock_fd = _lock_path(ledger)
+    try:
+        if _read_records(ledger):
+            raise ContractError("runner bootstrap refuses a non-empty lifecycle ledger")
+        systemctl = config["systemctl_path"]
+        try:
+            status = subprocess.run(
+                [systemctl, "is-active", config["unit_name"]], cwd="/",
+                env={"LC_ALL": "C", "PATH": ""}, stdin=subprocess.DEVNULL,
+                stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.DEVNULL,
+                close_fds=True, timeout=5, check=False,
+            )
+        except (OSError, subprocess.SubprocessError) as exc:
+            raise ContractError("systemd unit state cannot be inventoried") from exc
+        if status.returncode != 3 or status.stdout.strip() != b"inactive":
+            raise ContractError("runner bootstrap refuses an active unit")
+        process_ids = []
+        for entry in os.scandir("/proc"):
+            if not entry.name.isdecimal():
+                continue
+            pid = int(entry.name)
+            if pid == os.getpid():
+                continue
+            try:
+                with open(os.path.join(entry.path, "status"), encoding="ascii") as stream:
+                    uid_line = next(line for line in stream if line.startswith("Uid:"))
+                uids = [int(value) for value in uid_line.split()[1:5]]
+            except FileNotFoundError:
+                continue
+            except (OSError, StopIteration, ValueError) as exc:
+                raise ContractError("runner bootstrap could not inventory every process identity") from exc
+            if len(uids) != 4:
+                raise ContractError("runner bootstrap found a malformed process UID record")
+            if any(uid in {config["daemon_uid"], config["dispatcher_uid"], config["worker_uid"]}
+                   for uid in uids):
+                process_ids.append(pid)
+        if process_ids:
+            raise ContractError("runner bootstrap inventory found processes in reserved identities")
+        invocation, cgroup, cgroup_path = "BOOTSTRAP", config["control_group"], None
+        current_invocation, current_cgroup = _manager_unit(config, allow_inactive=True)
+        if current_invocation or current_cgroup:
+            raise ContractError("inactive runner unit returned a live manager identity")
+        try:
+            cgroup_path = _cgroup_path(cgroup)
+        except FileNotFoundError:
+            cgroup_path = None
+        if cgroup_path is not None:
+            populated, pids = _read_populated(cgroup_path)
+            if populated != "0" or pids:
+                raise ContractError("runner bootstrap cgroup inventory is populated")
+            if _child_cgroup_directories(cgroup_path):
+                raise ContractError("runner bootstrap cgroup contains unexplained child scopes")
+        cgroup_stat = None if cgroup_path is None else os.stat(cgroup_path, follow_symlinks=False)
+        record = _append_record(
+            ledger, _base_record(
+                config, state="BOOTSTRAP_EMPTY", invocation=invocation,
+                control_group=cgroup, cgroup_stat=cgroup_stat, lock_stat=None,
+                generation="BOOTSTRAP", predecessor="NONE",
+            ),
+        )
+        _publish_generation(config, record)
+        return record
+    finally:
+        os.close(lock_fd)
+
+
+def main() -> None:
+    if os.geteuid() != 0:
+        raise ContractError("runner fence helper must run as root")
+    if len(sys.argv) != 2 or sys.argv[1] not in {"start", "stop", "bootstrap"}:
+        raise ContractError("runner fence helper accepts start, stop, or bootstrap")
+    config = _load_root_json(DEFAULT_CONFIG)
+    _validate_config(config)
+    if sys.argv[1] == "bootstrap":
+        bootstrap_empty(DEFAULT_CONFIG)
+    else:
+        _transition(config, sys.argv[1])
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    main()

+    validate_task_manifest,
+)

+MAX_RUNNER_REQUEST_BYTES = 1024 * 1024
+MAX_RUNNER_RESPONSE_BYTES = 8 * 1024 * 1024
+MAX_DISPATCH_TIMEOUT_SEC = 1900.0
+DEFAULT_CONFIG_PATH = "/etc/vst-runner/runner-service.json"
+_HEADER = struct.Struct("!I")
+_WORKER_EXEC_HELPER_PREFIX = "/usr/local/libexec/vst-s4-worker-exec-"
+_SHA256 = re.compile(r"^[0-9a-f]{64}$")
+_GIT_HEAD = re.compile(r"^[0-9a-f]{40}$")

+def _unique_json_object(pairs: list[tuple[str, Any]]) -> dict[str, Any]:
+    result: dict[str, Any] = {}
+    for key, value in pairs:
+        if key in result:
+            raise ContractError("duplicate JSON object key")
+        result[key] = value
+    return result
+
+
+def _read_root_controlled_json(path: str, *, max_bytes: int) -> dict:
+    if os.name != "posix" or not os.path.isabs(path):
+        raise ContractError("runner trusted files require absolute POSIX paths")
+    current = os.path.dirname(path)
+    while True:
+        try:
+            directory = os.stat(current, follow_symlinks=False)
+        except OSError as exc:
+            raise ContractError("runner trusted-file directory is unavailable") from exc
+        if (not stat.S_ISDIR(directory.st_mode) or directory.st_uid != 0
+                or directory.st_mode & 0o022):
+            raise ContractError("runner trusted-file directory is not root-controlled")
+        if current == "/":
+            break
+        current = os.path.dirname(current)
+    try:
+        fd = os.open(path, os.O_RDONLY | os.O_NOFOLLOW)
+    except OSError as exc:
+        raise ContractError("runner trusted file is unavailable") from exc
+    try:
+        info = os.fstat(fd)
+        if (not stat.S_ISREG(info.st_mode) or info.st_uid != 0
+                or info.st_mode & 0o022 or info.st_size > max_bytes):
+            raise ContractError("runner trusted file has unsafe type, owner, mode, or size")
+        content = bytearray()
+        while len(content) <= max_bytes:
+            chunk = os.read(fd, min(65536, max_bytes + 1 - len(content)))
+            if not chunk:
+                break
+            content.extend(chunk)
+        if len(content) > max_bytes:
+            raise ContractError("runner trusted file exceeds its size limit")
+    finally:
+        os.close(fd)
+    try:
+        value = json.loads(content, object_pairs_hook=_unique_json_object)
+    except (ValueError, TypeError, UnicodeDecodeError) as exc:
+        raise ContractError("runner trusted file is malformed JSON") from exc
+    if not isinstance(value, dict):
+        raise ContractError("runner trusted file must contain a JSON object")
+    return value
+
+
+def read_service_generation_record(config: "RunnerServiceConfig") -> dict:
+    """Read the exact manager generation established by the root lifecycle helper."""
+    record = _read_root_controlled_json(config.generation_record_path, max_bytes=65536)
+    required = {
+        "version", "state", "unit", "invocation_id", "control_group",
+        "cgroup_device", "cgroup_inode", "lock_device", "lock_inode",
+        "generation", "predecessor_outcome", "sequence", "recorded_at",
+        "previous_record_sha256", "record_sha256",
+    }
+    if set(record) != required:
+        raise ContractError("runner lifecycle record fields do not match the service contract")
+    body = {key: value for key, value in record.items() if key != "record_sha256"}
+    expected_hash = hashlib.sha256(canonical_bytes(body)).hexdigest()
+    if record["record_sha256"] != expected_hash:
+        raise ContractError("runner lifecycle record hash is invalid")
+    try:
+        file_stat = os.stat(config.generation_record_path, follow_symlinks=False)
+    except OSError as exc:
+        raise ContractError("runner lifecycle record identity is unavailable") from exc
+    if (file_stat.st_uid != 0 or stat.S_IMODE(file_stat.st_mode) != 0o644
+            or not stat.S_ISREG(file_stat.st_mode)):
+        raise ContractError("runner lifecycle record must be root-owned and read-only")
+    invocation_id = os.environ.get("INVOCATION_ID")
+    if (type(record["version"]) is not int or record["version"] != 1
+            or record["state"] != "RUNNING" or record["unit"] != config.unit_name
+            or not isinstance(invocation_id, str) or not invocation_id
+            or record["invocation_id"] != invocation_id or record["generation"] != invocation_id
+            or record["control_group"] != config.service_cgroup
+            or record["predecessor_outcome"] not in {"BOOTSTRAP_EMPTY", "STOPPED_EMPTY"}
+            or type(record["sequence"]) is not int or record["sequence"] < 1):
+        raise ContractError("runner lifecycle record does not authorize this manager invocation")
+    for field in ("cgroup_device", "cgroup_inode", "lock_device", "lock_inode"):
+        if type(record[field]) is not int or record[field] < 0:
+            raise ContractError("runner lifecycle record identity is malformed")
+    cgroup_path = os.path.realpath(os.path.join("/sys/fs/cgroup", config.service_cgroup.lstrip("/")))
+    cgroup_root = os.path.realpath("/sys/fs/cgroup")
+    if os.path.commonpath((cgroup_root, cgroup_path)) != cgroup_root:
+        raise ContractError("runner lifecycle cgroup escaped the unified hierarchy")
+    try:
+        cgroup_stat = os.stat(cgroup_path, follow_symlinks=False)
+        lock_stat = os.stat(
+            os.path.join(config.runtime_dir, "cgroup-admission.lock"), follow_symlinks=False,
+        )
+    except OSError as exc:
+        raise ContractError("runner lifecycle resource identity is unavailable") from exc
+    if (cgroup_stat.st_dev != record["cgroup_device"]
+            or cgroup_stat.st_ino != record["cgroup_inode"]
+            or lock_stat.st_dev != record["lock_device"]
+            or lock_stat.st_ino != record["lock_inode"]):
+        raise ContractError("runner lifecycle cgroup or lock identity changed")
+    return record
+
+
+def read_service_generation(config: "RunnerServiceConfig") -> str:
+    return str(read_service_generation_record(config)["generation"])
+
